```sql
--       public.skip_order_email（return_refund_pending_shop はその返品の返金待ちが0の時だけ superseded にできる。ほかの返品の種類は断る）、public.request_order_email_resend（新しい種類は RESEND_NOT_ALLOWED）、
--       割引の割り振りの関数（交換の品の行を外す）、public.get_popular_items（交換の品の行を外す）、
--       public.admin_create_fulfillment（手数料待ちの交換の品の行を FULFILLMENT_EXCHANGE_ON_HOLD で断る）、
--       public.load_order_refund_materials（発送済みの数を refundable_after_shipment にし、行に exchange_paid_amount を足す。P22）
```

- Produces（移行 C の列・制約）: `public.order_refunds.return_fee_deduction integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (return_fee_deduction >= 0)`。作る時に確定し、指紋には入れない（P26）。
- Produces（変更する既存の呼出し契約）:
  - `private.apply_return_refund_outcome(_refund_id uuid, _from_status text) RETURNS boolean`（P25・P26）、`private.return_exchange_item_id(_receipt_id uuid, _return_line_id uuid, _method text) RETURNS uuid`（版4・変種8）、`public.mark_order_refund_error(_refund_id uuid, _reason text, _raise_exception boolean) RETURNS TABLE (outcome text, order_id uuid, exception_id uuid)`（署名は保持）。
  - `private.enqueue_order_email(_order_id uuid, _kind text, _variant text DEFAULT NULL, _fulfillment_id uuid DEFAULT NULL, _refund_id uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS boolean`。署名を変更せず、返品の参照列を返金と受け取りから得る。
  - `public.claim_order_email(_lease_seconds integer) RETURNS TABLE (email_id uuid, order_id uuid, kind text, variant text, origin text, attempts integer, lease_token uuid, subject text, body_text text, payment_expired_sent boolean, fulfillment_id uuid, refund_id uuid, return_id uuid, return_receipt_id uuid)`。
  - `public.list_order_email_history(_order_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE (email_id uuid, kind text, variant text, origin text, requested_by_email text, status text, attempts integer, last_error_code text, delivery_status text, delivery_event_at timestamptz, created_at timestamptz, sent_at timestamptz, finished_at timestamptz, has_body boolean, body_erased boolean, fulfillment_id uuid, fulfillment_number integer, refund_id uuid, return_id uuid, return_receipt_id uuid)`。
  - `public.skip_order_email(_email_id uuid, _lease_token uuid, _reason text) RETURNS boolean`、`public.request_order_email_resend(_order_id uuid, _kind text, _actor_id uuid, _fulfillment_id uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid`。
  - `private.order_line_discounts(_order_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE (order_item_id uuid, line_discount integer)`、`public.get_popular_items(limit_count integer DEFAULT 4) RETURNS TABLE (id bigint, name text, description text, category text, image_url text, price integer, purchase_count bigint)`。
  - この節だけの新しい内部関数 `private.return_units_amount(_order_item_id uuid, _quantity integer, _offset integer DEFAULT 0) RETURNS integer`。Task 2 の `private.return_refund_amount` に注文の商品の値と前に返した数を渡す包み。直接の実行権限は与えない。

- Produces（保留 SQL の許可表）: 既存の関数の署名・トリガー・全額返金の不変条件を保持し、`OLD.status = 'shipped' AND NEW.status = 'paid'` かつ `app.order_change_reason = 'return_exchange_added'` の遷移だけを追加する。pending のまま維持し、適用済みの成果物として扱わない。

- [ ] **Step 1: 失敗する受け取りと状態遷移のテストを書く**

`tests/integration/db/order_return_receipts.integration.test.ts` の全内容。通常は取引を戻す。競合の試験だけ確定した行を使い、終了後 controller が DB を作り直す。期待する SQL のエラーには SAVEPOINT を置き、壊れた取引を次の確認へ持ち込まない。Step 1b に示す既存テストの更新と追加（hardening の単体と DB 結合も含む）も、この RED の前に反映する。このファイルの試験は62件（test.each の展開後。今回の直し前57件）。Task 4 の R1〜R4 と同じ入力で同じ額（値 A）、同じ商品を複数の返品行で受け取る時の Task 2 の商品ごとの見込みとの一致も確かめる。

```ts
/** @jest-environment node */
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { connectLocalDb, describeLocalDb, type PgClient } from './helpers/local-db';
import { PRICE, createCatalogFixture, insertOrderWithLines, variantStock, uniqueSuffix, revisionsOf } from './helpers/order-fixtures';
jest.setTimeout(30000);
type Row = Record<string, any>;
type Fx = { orderId:string; itemId:string; variantId:number; returnId:string; lineId:string; actor:string };
async function fails(db:PgClient,work:()=>Promise<unknown>,message:string) {
  await db.query('savepoint expected_error');
  try { await expect(work()).rejects.toMatchObject({message}); }
  finally { await db.query('rollback to savepoint expected_error'); }
}
async function fixture(db:PgClient,o:{quantity?:number;returnQuantity?:number;exchange?:boolean;method?:string;stock?:number;fee?:number;shippingFee?:number;percent?:number;discount?:number;paymentIntent?:string|null;paid?:number|null}={}):Promise<Fx> {
  // 空の返送先では返品作成が止まるため、試験用の住所を取引の中だけ設定する。
  await db.query(`update public.shop_return_settings set return_address_name='試験店舗',return_address_postal_code='1500001',
    return_address_line='東京都渋谷区神宮前1-1-1',return_address_phone='0311112222',
    restocking_fee_enabled=true,exchange_fees_enabled=true,inspection_enabled=true where id=1`);
  const q=o.quantity??1;
  const actor=(await db.query(`insert into auth.users(id,email,raw_user_meta_data,created_at,updated_at)
    values(gen_random_uuid(),$1,'{}',now(),now()) returning id`,[`returns-${uniqueSuffix()}@example.com`])).rows[0].id;
  const cat=await createCatalogFixture(db,{stock:q+(o.stock??1)});
  const order=await insertOrderWithLines(db,{status:'paid',lines:[{itemId:cat.itemId,variantId:cat.variantId,quantity:q,fulfillmentType:'stock'}],
    discountAmount:o.discount??0,paidAmount:o.paid===undefined?PRICE*q-(o.discount??0):o.paid,paymentIntentId:o.paymentIntent===undefined?`pi_fx_${uniqueSuffix()}`:o.paymentIntent});
  const ship=(await db.query(`select * from public.admin_create_fulfillment($1,$2,$3,'yamato','TEST-1',false,$4::jsonb)`,
    [order.orderId,actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{order_item_id:order.orderItemIds[0],quantity:q}])])).rows[0];
  const ret=(await db.query(`select * from public.admin_create_return($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb,$5,'customer',null,null,$6,$7,$8,0,null,false)`,
    [order.orderId,actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{fulfillment_id:ship.fulfillment_id,order_item_id:order.orderItemIds[0],quantity:o.returnQuantity??q,reason:'unknown',reason_note:null,
    resolution:o.exchange?'exchange':'refund',exchange_variant_id:o.exchange?cat.variantId:null,exchange_method:o.exchange?(o.method??'stock'):null}]),
    o.shippingFee?'shop_label':'customer_ships',o.shippingFee??0,o.percent??0,o.fee??0])).rows[0];
  const line=(await db.query('select id from public.order_return_lines where return_id=$1',[ret.return_id])).rows[0];
  return {orderId:order.orderId,itemId:order.orderItemIds[0],variantId:cat.variantId,returnId:ret.return_id,lineId:line.id,actor};
}
async function receive(db:PgClient,f:Fx,o:Row={}):Promise<Row> {
  return (await db.query(`select * from public.admin_receive_return($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6::jsonb,$7,$8,0,null,$9,$10,null,null)`,
    [f.returnId,f.actor,o.can??true,o.key??randomUUID(),JSON.stringify(o.units??[{return_line_id:f.lineId,disposition:o.disposition??'restocked',quantity:o.quantity??1}]),
    JSON.stringify(o.overrides??[]),o.choice??'consult',o.amount??null,o.notify??true,o.message??null])).rows[0];
}
async function refund(db:PgClient,f:Fx,amount:number|null=null,key=randomUUID()):Promise<Row> {
  return (await db.query('select * from public.admin_refund_return($1,$2,$3,$4,0,null,true)',[f.returnId,f.actor,key,amount])).rows[0];
}
async function result(db:PgClient,id:string,status:string) {
  return (await db.query(`select * from public.record_order_refund_result($1,$2,$3,null,$4,null,'card',null,null)`,
    [id,`re_${id.replace(/-/g,'')}`,status,status==='failed'?'lost_or_stolen_card':null])).rows[0];
}
async function progress(db:PgClient,f:Fx) {return (await db.query('select * from private.order_return_line_progress($1)',[f.returnId])).rows[0];}
// 同じ商品の2点を、同じ色・サイズへの交換（在庫から）の2行に分けた返品。在庫は受け取りの前に stock 点。
// lineId・secondLineId は list_order_returns の lines の並び（DB が在庫を割り当てる順・画面が数える順）の1つ目と2つ目
async function twoExchangeLines(db:PgClient,stock:number,discount=0):Promise<Fx&{secondLineId:string}> {
  await db.query(`update public.shop_return_settings set return_address_name='試験店舗',return_address_postal_code='1500001',
    return_address_line='東京都渋谷区神宮前1-1-1',return_address_phone='0311112222' where id=1`);
  const actor=(await db.query(`insert into auth.users(id,email,raw_user_meta_data,created_at,updated_at)
    values(gen_random_uuid(),$1,'{}',now(),now()) returning id`,[`returns-two-${uniqueSuffix()}@example.com`])).rows[0].id as string;
  const cat=await createCatalogFixture(db,{stock:2+stock});
  const order=await insertOrderWithLines(db,{status:'paid',discountAmount:discount,paidAmount:PRICE*2-discount,paymentIntentId:`pi_fx_${uniqueSuffix()}`,
    lines:[{itemId:cat.itemId,variantId:cat.variantId,quantity:2,fulfillmentType:'stock'}]});
  const ship=(await db.query(`select * from public.admin_create_fulfillment($1,$2,$3,'yamato','TEST-T',false,$4::jsonb)`,
    [order.orderId,actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{order_item_id:order.orderItemIds[0],quantity:2}])])).rows[0];
  const line={fulfillment_id:ship.fulfillment_id,order_item_id:order.orderItemIds[0],quantity:1,reason:'unknown',reason_note:null,
    resolution:'exchange',exchange_variant_id:cat.variantId,exchange_method:'stock'};
  const ret=(await db.query(`select * from public.admin_create_return($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb,'customer_ships','customer',null,null,0,0,0,0,null,false)`,
    [order.orderId,actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([line,line])])).rows[0];
  const ids=(await db.query('select public.list_order_returns($1) as returns',[order.orderId])).rows[0].returns[0].lines.map((l:Row)=>l.id as string);
  return {orderId:order.orderId,itemId:order.orderItemIds[0],variantId:cat.variantId,returnId:ret.return_id,lineId:ids[0],secondLineId:ids[1],actor};
}

async function markError(db:PgClient,id:string,raise=false):Promise<Row> {
  return (await db.query('select * from public.mark_order_refund_error($1,$2,$3)',[id,raise?'not_found_in_stripe':'stripe_rejected',raise])).rows[0];
}
async function returnFees(db:PgClient,f:Fx):Promise<Row> {
  return (await db.query('select fee_pending_deduction,fee_due_amount from public.order_returns where id=$1',[f.returnId])).rows[0];
}
async function deductionOf(db:PgClient,id:string):Promise<number> {
  return (await db.query('select return_fee_deduction from public.order_refunds where id=$1',[id])).rows[0].return_fee_deduction;
}

describeLocalDb('返品の受け取りと返金（移行 C）',getDb=>{
  const db=()=>getDb();
  beforeEach(async()=>{
    await db().query('begin');await db().query('delete from private.order_email_outbox');
    await db().query('update public.shop_return_settings set restocking_fee_enabled=true,exchange_fees_enabled=true,inspection_enabled=true');
    await db().query(`update public.shop_return_reason_settings set out_of_stock_exchange='decline' where reason='unknown'`);
  });
  afterEach(async()=>{await db().query('rollback');});
  test.each(['restocked','not_restocked','pending_inspection','sent_back'])('状態 %s の数と台帳を残す',async disposition=>{
    const f=await fixture(db());const r=await receive(db(),f,{disposition,choice:disposition==='sent_back'?'none':'consult',message:disposition==='sent_back'?'付属品をご確認ください。':null});
    expect((await db().query('select disposition,quantity from public.order_return_receipt_lines where receipt_id=$1',[r.receipt_id])).rows).toEqual([{disposition,quantity:1}]);
    expect(await variantStock(db(),f.variantId)).toBe(disposition==='restocked'?2:1);
    expect((await progress(db(),f)).refund_waiting).toBe(disposition==='sent_back'?0:1);
    expect(r.refund_id).toBeNull();
  });
  test('一部を検品待ちで受け取り、検品を終えて残りを受け取り、返金すると閉じる',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db(),{quantity:2});await receive(db(),f,{disposition:'pending_inspection'});
    expect(await progress(db(),f)).toMatchObject({unprocessed:1,pending_inspection:1});
    await db().query('select * from public.admin_inspect_return($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb)',[f.returnId,f.actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{return_line_id:f.lineId,restocked:1,not_restocked:0}])]);
    await receive(db(),f,{disposition:'not_restocked'});const r=await refund(db(),f);await result(db(),r.refund_id,'succeeded');
    expect((await db().query('select status from public.order_returns where id=$1',[f.returnId])).rows[0].status).toBe('closed');
  });
  test.each([['stock',1,'stock'],['make',0,'backorder'],['stock',0,'backorder']])('交換 %s 在庫%s は %s の行を作り、発送後に shipped へ進む',async(method,stock,expected)=>{
    await db().query(`update public.shop_return_reason_settings set out_of_stock_exchange='make' where reason='unknown'`);
    const f=await fixture(db(),{exchange:true,method:String(method),stock:Number(stock)});
    const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'none',disposition:'not_restocked'});
    const line=(await db().query('select * from public.order_items where id=$1',[r.exchange_order_item_ids[0]])).rows[0];
    expect(line).toMatchObject({fulfillment_type:expected,item_price:0,line_total:0,line_kind:'exchange',exchange_return_line_id:f.lineId,exchange_paid_amount:PRICE});
    const actual=(await db().query('select resolution,exchange_method from public.order_return_receipt_lines where receipt_id=$1',[r.receipt_id])).rows;
    expect(actual).toEqual([{resolution:'exchange',exchange_method:expected==='stock'?'stock':'make'}]);
    expect((await db().query('select exchange_method from public.order_return_lines where id=$1',[f.lineId])).rows[0].exchange_method).toBe(method);
    expect(await variantStock(db(),f.variantId)).toBe(0);
    expect((await db().query('select status,shipped_at,shipping_carrier,tracking_number from public.orders where id=$1',[f.orderId])).rows[0]).toEqual({status:'paid',shipped_at:null,shipping_carrier:null,tracking_number:null});
    expect(await revisionsOf(db(),f.orderId)).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({reason:'return_exchange_added',changedBy:f.actor}));
    if(expected==='backorder') await db().query('select * from public.admin_record_completion($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb)',[f.orderId,f.actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{order_item_id:line.id,quantity:1}])]);
    await db().query(`select * from public.admin_create_fulfillment($1,$2,$3,'yamato','TEST-2',false,$4::jsonb)`,[f.orderId,f.actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{order_item_id:line.id,quantity:1}])]);
    expect((await db().query('select status from public.orders where id=$1',[f.orderId])).rows[0].status).toBe('shipped');
  });
  test.each(['make','refund'])('在庫不足 decline は店長の %s だけ受ける',async action=>{
    const f=await fixture(db(),{exchange:true,stock:0});
    await fails(db(),()=>receive(db(),f,{choice:'none',disposition:'not_restocked'}),'RETURN_EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK');
    await fails(db(),()=>receive(db(),f,{can:false,overrides:[{return_line_id:f.lineId,action}]}),'RETURN_FORBIDDEN');
    const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:action==='refund'?'consult':'none',disposition:'not_restocked',overrides:[{return_line_id:f.lineId,action}]});
    expect(r.exchange_order_item_ids).toHaveLength(action==='make'?1:0);
    expect((await db().query('select resolution,exchange_method from public.order_return_receipt_lines where receipt_id=$1',[r.receipt_id])).rows)
      .toEqual([{resolution:action==='refund'?'refund':'exchange',exchange_method:action==='make'?'make':null}]);
    expect((await db().query('select resolution,exchange_method from public.order_return_lines where id=$1',[f.lineId])).rows[0])
      .toEqual({resolution:'exchange',exchange_method:'stock'});
    expect((await progress(db(),f)).refund_waiting).toBe(action==='refund'?1:0);
  });
  test('通信切断の再送は元の返金番号を返し、在庫とメールも一度だけ（Review Focus 1）',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db());const key=randomUUID();const a=await receive(db(),f,{key,choice:'now'});

    await fails(db(),()=>receive(db(),f,{key,choice:'consult'}),'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH');

    expect(await variantStock(db(),f.variantId)).toBe(2);
    expect((await db().query('select count(*)::int n from public.order_return_receipts where return_id=$1',[f.returnId])).rows[0].n).toBe(1);
    expect((await db().query('select kind,variant,return_id,return_receipt_id from private.order_email_outbox where order_id=$1',[f.orderId])).rows).toEqual([{kind:'refund',variant:'return',return_id:f.returnId,return_receipt_id:a.receipt_id}]);
  });
  test('交換の再送も同じ交換の行を返し、確保を増やさない',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db(),{exchange:true});const key=randomUUID();const a=await receive(db(),f,{key,choice:'none',disposition:'not_restocked'});
    expect((await receive(db(),f,{key,choice:'none',disposition:'not_restocked'})).exchange_order_item_ids).toEqual(a.exchange_order_item_ids);
    expect(await variantStock(db(),f.variantId)).toBe(0);
  });
  test('サポートは店への知らせを一度だけ作り、店長が額を直して返す（Review Focus 5）',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db());const key=randomUUID();
    await fails(db(),()=>receive(db(),f,{can:false,choice:'now'}),'RETURN_FORBIDDEN');
    await fails(db(),()=>receive(db(),f,{can:false,amount:1}),'RETURN_FORBIDDEN');
    expect((await receive(db(),f,{can:false,key})).shop_notice_enqueued).toBe(true);
    expect((await receive(db(),f,{can:false,key})).replayed).toBe(true);
    expect((await db().query(`select count(*)::int n from private.order_email_outbox where kind='return_refund_pending_shop' and return_id=$1`,[f.returnId])).rows[0].n).toBe(1);
    const r=await refund(db(),f,4000);await result(db(),r.refund_id,'succeeded');
    expect((await db().query('select kind,variant from private.order_email_outbox where refund_id=$1',[r.refund_id])).rows).toEqual([{kind:'refund',variant:'return'}]);
  });
  test('相談の手数料と額の上限を守り、返金の再送で二度引かない',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db(),{shippingFee:600,percent:10});await receive(db(),f);
    expect((await db().query('select fee_pending_deduction from public.order_returns where id=$1',[f.returnId])).rows[0].fee_pending_deduction).toBe(1100);
    await fails(db(),()=>refund(db(),f,5001),'RETURN_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID');
    const key=randomUUID();const r=await refund(db(),f,3800,key);expect(r.amount).toBe(3800);
    expect((await refund(db(),f,3800,key)).replayed).toBe(true);
    await fails(db(),()=>refund(db(),f,3799,key),'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH');
    expect((await db().query('select fee_pending_deduction,fee_due_amount from public.order_returns where id=$1',[f.returnId])).rows[0]).toEqual({fee_pending_deduction:0,fee_due_amount:0});
    expect((await db().query('select adjustment_amount from public.order_refunds where id=$1',[r.refund_id])).rows[0].adjustment_amount).toBe(-1200);
  });
  test('今返金は返送料を最初だけ引き、部分受け取りの返品手数料は毎回計算する',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db(),{quantity:2,shippingFee:600,percent:10});const a=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'now'});
    expect(a.refund_amount).toBe(3900);await result(db(),a.refund_id,'succeeded');
    expect((await receive(db(),f,{choice:'now'})).refund_amount).toBe(4500);
  });
  test('返金なしの交換の手数料は支払い待ちで発送を止め、支払い記録後に送れる',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db(),{exchange:true,fee:600,shippingFee:400});const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'none',disposition:'not_restocked'});
    expect(r.fee_due_amount).toBe(1000);const lines=JSON.stringify([{order_item_id:r.exchange_order_item_ids[0],quantity:1}]);
    await fails(db(),()=>db().query(`select * from public.admin_create_fulfillment($1,$2,$3,'yamato','TEST-3',false,$4::jsonb)`,[f.orderId,f.actor,randomUUID(),lines]),'FULFILLMENT_EXCHANGE_ON_HOLD');
    await db().query('select * from public.admin_record_return_fee_payment($1,$2,null,false)',[f.returnId,f.actor]);

  });
  test('返金失敗で rw が戻るが closed を巻き戻さず、受け取りの在庫を動かさない',async()=>{
    const f=await fixture(db());const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'now'});expect(r.return_status).toBe('closed');
    await result(db(),r.refund_id,'pending');await result(db(),r.refund_id,'failed');expect((await progress(db(),f)).refund_waiting).toBe(1);

  });

describeLocalDb('最後の1点の購入と受け取りの競合（Review Focus 2）',getDb=>{
  test.each(['make','decline'])('購入が先に1点を確保した時 %s の設定を守る',async policy=>{
    const setup=getDb();
    // この試験は確定した行を使う。変える設定を先に読み、最後に戻す（同じ実行で後に動く試験が、設定の最初の値を見るため）
    const saved=(await setup.query(`select return_address_name,return_address_postal_code,return_address_line,return_address_phone,
      restocking_fee_enabled,exchange_fees_enabled,inspection_enabled from public.shop_return_settings where id=1`)).rows[0];
    const savedPolicy=(await setup.query(`select out_of_stock_exchange from public.shop_return_reason_settings where reason='unknown'`)).rows[0].out_of_stock_exchange;
    const purchase=await connectLocalDb();const receipt=await connectLocalDb();
    try {
      await setup.query('begin');const f=await fixture(setup,{exchange:true,stock:1});
      await setup.query(`update public.shop_return_reason_settings set out_of_stock_exchange=$1 where reason='unknown'`,[policy]);await setup.query('commit');
      await purchase.query('begin');await receipt.query('begin');
      await purchase.query('select id from public.item_variants where id=$1 for update',[f.variantId]);
      await purchase.query(`insert into public.stock_movements(variant_id,delta,reason,note) values($1,-1,'purchase','別注文の確保')`,[f.variantId]);
      const pid=(await receipt.query('select pg_backend_pid() pid')).rows[0].pid;
      const waiting=receive(receipt,f,{choice:'none',disposition:'not_restocked'}).then(value=>({value,error:null}),error=>({value:null,error}));
      // 受け取りが色・サイズの鍵を待つまで待つ（最大5秒。E-2 の waitUntilBlocked と同じ間隔）
      let blocked=false;
      for(let i=0;i<50;i++) {
        if((await setup.query('select cardinality(pg_blocking_pids($1))>0 blocked',[pid])).rows[0].blocked){blocked=true;break;}
        await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,100));
      }
      expect(blocked).toBe(true);await purchase.query('commit');const outcome=await waiting;
      if(policy==='make') {
        expect(outcome.error).toBeNull();expect((await receipt.query('select fulfillment_type from public.order_items where id=$1',[outcome.value!.exchange_order_item_ids[0]])).rows[0].fulfillment_type).toBe('backorder');await receipt.query('commit');
      } else {
        expect(outcome.error).toMatchObject({message:'RETURN_EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK'});await receipt.query('rollback');
        expect((await setup.query('select count(*)::int n from public.order_return_receipts where return_id=$1',[f.returnId])).rows[0].n).toBe(0);
      }
      expect(await variantStock(setup,f.variantId)).toBe(0);
    } finally {
      // 途中で落ちた取引を閉じてから、確定した設定を元に戻す
      await setup.query('rollback');await purchase.query('rollback');await receipt.query('rollback');await purchase.end();await receipt.end();
      await setup.query(`update public.shop_return_settings set return_address_name=$1,return_address_postal_code=$2,return_address_line=$3,
        return_address_phone=$4,restocking_fee_enabled=$5,exchange_fees_enabled=$6,inspection_enabled=$7 where id=1`,
        [saved.return_address_name,saved.return_address_postal_code,saved.return_address_line,saved.return_address_phone,
         saved.restocking_fee_enabled,saved.exchange_fees_enabled,saved.inspection_enabled]);
      await setup.query(`update public.shop_return_reason_settings set out_of_stock_exchange=$1 where reason='unknown'`,[savedPolicy]);
    }
  });
});

describeLocalDb('Task 4 の見込みの例 R1〜R4 と同じ入力で、受け取りが同じ額を記録する（値 A）',getDb=>{
  const db=()=>getDb();
  beforeEach(async()=>{
    await db().query('begin');await db().query('delete from private.order_email_outbox');
    await db().query(`update public.shop_return_settings set return_address_name='試験店舗',return_address_postal_code='1500001',
      return_address_line='東京都渋谷区神宮前1-1-1',return_address_phone='0311112222' where id=1`);
  });
  afterEach(async()=>{await db().query('rollback');});
  // 値 A（E-2・Task 4 と同じ）: X 3000円×2・Y 1000円×3、割引 1000・送料 500、受け取った額 8500。割り振った割引は X 667・Y 333
  async function valueA(db:PgClient,o:{item:'X'|'Y';quantity:number;resolution:'refund'|'exchange';method:'customer_ships'|'shop_label';
      returnShippingFee:number;percent:number;exchangeFee:number;exchangeShippingFee:number}):Promise<Fx> {
    const actor=(await db.query(`insert into auth.users(id,email,raw_user_meta_data,created_at,updated_at)
      values(gen_random_uuid(),$1,'{}',now(),now()) returning id`,[`returns-a-${uniqueSuffix()}@example.com`])).rows[0].id as string;
    const x=await createCatalogFixture(db,{stock:3});const y=await createCatalogFixture(db,{stock:4});
    const order=await insertOrderWithLines(db,{status:'paid',shippingAmount:500,discountAmount:1000,paidAmount:8500,paymentIntentId:`pi_fx_${uniqueSuffix()}`,
      lines:[{itemId:x.itemId,variantId:x.variantId,quantity:2,fulfillmentType:'stock',itemPrice:3000,createdAt:'2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'},
             {itemId:y.itemId,variantId:y.variantId,quantity:3,fulfillmentType:'stock',itemPrice:1000,createdAt:'2026-10-12T00:00:01Z'}]});
    const [xItem,yItem]=order.orderItemIds;
    const ship=(await db.query(`select * from public.admin_create_fulfillment($1,$2,$3,'yamato','TEST-A',false,$4::jsonb)`,
      [order.orderId,actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{order_item_id:xItem,quantity:2},{order_item_id:yItem,quantity:3}])])).rows[0];
    const target=o.item==='X'?{itemId:xItem,variantId:x.variantId}:{itemId:yItem,variantId:y.variantId};
    const ret=(await db.query(`select * from public.admin_create_return($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb,$5,'customer',null,null,$6,$7,$8,$9,null,false)`,
      [order.orderId,actor,randomUUID(),JSON.stringify([{fulfillment_id:ship.fulfillment_id,order_item_id:target.itemId,quantity:o.quantity,reason:'unknown',
        reason_note:null,resolution:o.resolution,exchange_variant_id:o.resolution==='exchange'?target.variantId:null,
        exchange_method:o.resolution==='exchange'?'stock':null}]),
       o.method,o.returnShippingFee,o.percent,o.exchangeFee,o.exchangeShippingFee])).rows[0];
    const line=(await db.query('select id from public.order_return_lines where return_id=$1',[ret.return_id])).rows[0].id as string;
    return {orderId:order.orderId,itemId:target.itemId,variantId:target.variantId,returnId:ret.return_id,lineId:line,actor};
  }
  // 画面の見込みの元（Task 2 の list_order_returns の refund_amounts_by_count）
  const amountsOf=async(f:Fx)=>(await db().query('select public.list_order_returns($1) as returns',[f.orderId])).rows[0].returns[0].lines[0].refund_amounts_by_count;
  const refundRowOf=async(id:string)=>(await db().query('select amount,adjustment_amount from public.order_refunds where id=$1',[id])).rows[0];
  test('R1 手数料なし: X を1点 → 2666',async()=>{
    const f=await valueA(db(),{item:'X',quantity:1,resolution:'refund',method:'customer_ships',returnShippingFee:0,percent:0,exchangeFee:0,exchangeShippingFee:0});
    expect(await amountsOf(f)).toEqual([2666]);
    const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'now'});
    expect(r).toMatchObject({refund_amount:2666,refund_status:'awaiting_response',fee_due_amount:0});
    expect(await refundRowOf(r.refund_id)).toEqual({amount:2666,adjustment_amount:0});
  });
  test('R2 返送料 800（最初の受け取り）と返品の手数料 10%: X を2点 → 5333 − (800 + 533) = 4000',async()=>{
    const f=await valueA(db(),{item:'X',quantity:2,resolution:'refund',method:'shop_label',returnShippingFee:800,percent:10,exchangeFee:0,exchangeShippingFee:0});
    expect(await amountsOf(f)).toEqual([2666,5333]);
    const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'now',quantity:2});
    expect(r).toMatchObject({refund_amount:4000,fee_due_amount:0});
    expect(await refundRowOf(r.refund_id)).toEqual({amount:4000,adjustment_amount:-1333});
  });
  test('R3 交換だけ（返送料 800・交換の手数料 500・交換の送料 300）→ 返金なし、お支払い待ち 1600',async()=>{
    const f=await valueA(db(),{item:'X',quantity:1,resolution:'exchange',method:'shop_label',returnShippingFee:800,percent:0,exchangeFee:500,exchangeShippingFee:300});
    const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'none',disposition:'not_restocked'});
    expect(r).toMatchObject({refund_id:null,refund_amount:null,refund_status:null,fee_due_amount:1600});
    expect((await db().query('select exchange_paid_amount from public.order_items where id=$1',[r.exchange_order_item_ids[0]])).rows[0].exchange_paid_amount).toBe(2666);
  });
  test('R4 手数料が商品の額を超える: Y を1点（889）、返送料 800 と 20%（177）→ 返金なし（waived）、お支払い待ち 88',async()=>{
    const f=await valueA(db(),{item:'Y',quantity:1,resolution:'refund',method:'shop_label',returnShippingFee:800,percent:20,exchangeFee:0,exchangeShippingFee:0});
    expect(await amountsOf(f)).toEqual([889]);
    const r=await receive(db(),f,{choice:'now'});
    expect(r).toMatchObject({refund_id:null,refund_amount:0,refund_status:'waived',fee_due_amount:88});
    expect((await db().query('select count(*)::int n from public.order_refunds where order_id=$1',[f.orderId])).rows[0].n).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
describeLocalDb('E-3: E-2 の返金開始の署名と返品の上限',db=>{
  beforeEach(async()=>{await db().query('begin');});

  test('public の13引数と既定値と権限を保持し、core は15引数で直接実行できない',async()=>{
    const rows=await db().query(`select n.nspname,p.proname,p.pronargs,p.pronargdefaults,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig
      from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
      where (n.nspname='public' and p.proname='begin_order_refund')
         or (n.nspname='private' and p.proname='begin_order_refund_core') order by n.nspname`);
    expect(rows.rows).toEqual([
      {nspname:'private',proname:'begin_order_refund_core',pronargs:15,pronargdefaults:0,prosecdef:false,proconfig:['search_path=""']},
      {nspname:'public',proname:'begin_order_refund',pronargs:13,pronargdefaults:1,prosecdef:true,proconfig:['search_path=""']},
    ]);
    for(const role of ['anon','authenticated','service_role']) {
      const allowed=await db().query(`select has_function_privilege($1,'public.begin_order_refund(uuid,text,uuid,jsonb,boolean,integer,integer,text,text,text,boolean,uuid,integer)','execute') as api,
        has_function_privilege($1,'private.begin_order_refund_core(uuid,text,uuid,jsonb,boolean,integer,integer,text,text,text,boolean,uuid,integer,uuid,integer)','execute') as core`,[role]);
      expect(allowed.rows[0]).toEqual({api:role==='service_role',core:false});

  test('返品が受付中の品は普通の返金に出さず、core も REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_SHIPPED で断る',async()=>{
    const actor=await createActor(db());

    await db().query(`update public.shop_return_settings set return_address_name='試験店舗',return_address_postal_code='1500001',
```

3. `tests/integration/db/order_refund_results.integration.test.ts` の末尾に次の describe 全体を追加する。新しい種類の取出し・履歴・再送禁止・取りやめの条件（店への知らせは返金待ち0の時だけ許す）を、E-2 のリースの道で確かめる。

```ts
describeLocalDb('E-3: 返品のメールも既存のリースと履歴で扱う',db=>{
  beforeEach(async()=>{await db().query('begin');await db().query('delete from private.order_email_outbox');});
  afterEach(async()=>{await db().query('rollback');});
  test.each(['return_accepted','return_received','return_sent_back','return_refund_pending_shop'])('%s の参照列を返し、手の再送を断り、superseded の条件を守る',async kind=>{
    const actor=await createActor(db());const order=await createOrder(db(),{lines:[{quantity:1}]});
    const ret=(await db().query(`insert into public.order_returns(order_id,number,source,status,request_key,request_fingerprint,
      return_method,return_shipping_payer,notify_customer,approved_at,approved_by,created_by)
      values($1,1,'shop','open',gen_random_uuid(),'fixture','customer_ships','customer',false,now(),$2,$2) returning id`,[order.orderId,actor.id])).rows[0].id;
    const receipt=kind==='return_accepted'?null:(await db().query(`insert into public.order_return_receipts(return_id,request_key,request_fingerprint,kind,refund_choice,actor_id,actor_can_refund)
      values($1,gen_random_uuid(),'fixture','receive','consult',$2,false) returning id`,[ret,actor.id])).rows[0].id;
    expect((await db().query('select private.enqueue_return_email($1,$2,$3,$4) enqueued',[order.orderId,kind,ret,receipt])).rows[0].enqueued).toBe(true);
    expect((await db().query('select private.enqueue_return_email($1,$2,$3,$4) enqueued',[order.orderId,kind,ret,receipt])).rows[0].enqueued).toBe(false);
    const claim=(await db().query('select * from public.claim_order_email(300)')).rows[0];
    expect(claim).toMatchObject({order_id:order.orderId,kind,return_id:ret,return_receipt_id:receipt,refund_id:null,fulfillment_id:null});
    expect(Object.keys(claim).slice(-3)).toEqual(['refund_id','return_id','return_receipt_id']);
    const history=(await db().query('select * from public.list_order_email_history($1)',[order.orderId])).rows[0];
    expect(history).toMatchObject({kind,return_id:ret,return_receipt_id:receipt});
    expect(Object.keys(history).slice(-3)).toEqual(['refund_id','return_id','return_receipt_id']);
    await expectRejected(db(),'select public.request_order_email_resend($1,$2,$3)',[order.orderId,kind,actor.id],{code:'22023',message:'RESEND_NOT_ALLOWED'});
    if(kind==='return_refund_pending_shop') {
      // この参照列の試験は返品の行が無いので返金待ちは0。店への知らせだけ取りやめられる（06-5）。
      expect((await db().query("select public.skip_order_email($1,$2,'superseded') skipped",[claim.email_id,claim.lease_token])).rows[0].skipped).toBe(true);
    } else {
      await expectRejected(db(),"select public.skip_order_email($1,$2,'superseded')",[claim.email_id,claim.lease_token],{code:'22023',message:'SUPERSEDE_NOT_ALLOWED'});
      expect((await db().query("select public.skip_order_email($1,$2,'no_recipient') skipped",[claim.email_id,claim.lease_token])).rows[0].skipped).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
      values($1,$2,$3,'交換の品',0,3,0,'backorder','exchange',$4,14999) returning id`,[order.orderId,cat.itemId,cat.variantId,rl])).rows[0].id;

  });
});
```

7. `tests/unit/migrations/order-state-transition-hardening.test.ts` を次の全内容で置き換える。既存4件の検証を保持し、`return_exchange_added` が `shipped → paid` に限定された条件であることを確認する。RED は理由の許可がまだ無い pending SQL、GREEN は Step 3a の更新後の pending SQL。

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const ADDITIVE_PATH = path.join(
  process.cwd(),
  'supabase/migrations/20260925000218_add_order_state_transition_rpcs.sql',
);
const HARDENING_PATH = path.join(
  process.cwd(),
  'supabase/pending/harden_order_state_transitions.sql',
);
const FULFILLMENT_PATH = path.join(
  process.cwd(),
  'supabase/migrations/20261010122320_fulfillment_order_emails.sql',
);

const REFUND_RESULTS_PATH = path.join(
  process.cwd(),
  'supabase/migrations/20261011223453_order_refund_results.sql',
);

describe('order state transition migrations', () => {
  it('defines narrow service-role-only RPCs with fixed search paths and CAS projection', () => {
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(ADDITIVE_PATH, 'utf8');

    for (const name of [
      'admin_cancel_failed_order',
      'admin_ship_paid_order',
      'apply_order_refund_projection',
    ]) {
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(`CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public\\.${name}`, 'i'));
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(
        `REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public\\.${name}[\\s\\S]+FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated`,
        'i',
      ));
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(
        `GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public\\.${name}[\\s\\S]+TO service_role`,
        'i',
      ));
    }

    expect(sql.match(/SECURITY DEFINER/gi)).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(sql.match(/SET search_path = ''/gi)).toHaveLength(6);
    expect(sql).toContain("current_setting('app.order_actor_id', true)");
    expect(sql).toMatch(/o\.status = _expected_status[\s\S]+o\.refunded_amount = _expected_refunded_amount/i);
    expect(sql).toContain('o.payment_status_updated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _expected_payment_status_updated_at');
    expect(sql).toMatch(/o\.status <> 'cancelled'[\s\S]+o\.refunded_amount >= o\.total_amount/i);
  });

  it('revokes direct updates and installs payment-state invariants', () => {
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(HARDENING_PATH, 'utf8');

    expect(sql).toMatch(/REVOKE UPDATE ON TABLE public\.orders FROM anon, authenticated/i);
    expect(sql).toMatch(/DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "admin orders manage by permission update"/i);
    expect(sql).toMatch(/CREATE TRIGGER enforce_order_payment_invariants/i);
    expect(sql).toContain("OLD.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')");
    // 全額の判定は、受け取った額（空なら注文の合計）。支払額が合計と違う注文でも、返せる額の全部を返せば取消になる（グループ E-2 設計書 11-4）
    expect(sql).toContain('NEW.refunded_amount < COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.paid_amount, 0), NEW.total_amount)');
    expect(sql).toContain('OLD.refunded_amount >= COALESCE(NULLIF(OLD.paid_amount, 0), OLD.total_amount)');
    expect(sql).toContain("OLD.status = 'cancelled'");
    expect(sql).toContain("NEW.status = 'cancelled'");
    expect(sql).toMatch(/REVOKE INSERT, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON TABLE public\.orders FROM anon, authenticated/i);
    expect(sql).toMatch(/REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON TABLE public\.order_items FROM anon, authenticated/i);
    expect(sql).toContain('ORDER_STATUS_CHANGE_REQUIRES_REASON');
    expect(sql).toContain('ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED');
    // 発送の取消で未発送の品が戻った注文だけ、発送済みから決済完了へ戻せる（グループ E-1 設計書 7-3・12-3）
    expect(sql).toContain("(OLD.status = 'shipped' AND NEW.status = 'paid'");
    expect(sql).toContain("pg_catalog.current_setting('app.order_change_reason', true) = 'admin_cancel_fulfillment'");
    // 返金の失敗で、発送前に返金した品が戻った注文も、発送済みから支払い済みへ戻せる（グループ E-2 設計書 4-7。入金済みから発送済みへは元から通る）
    expect(sql).toContain("pg_catalog.current_setting('app.order_change_reason', true) = 'refund_failed_reopened'");
    // 交換品を足して未発送ができた時だけ戻せる理由を追加し、発送済みからの自由な巻き戻しを許さない。
    expect(sql).toMatch(/\(OLD\.status = 'shipped' AND NEW\.status = 'paid'\s+AND pg_catalog\.current_setting\('app\.order_change_reason', true\) = 'return_exchange_added'\)/);

  });

  it('replaces the ship RPC with service-role-only fulfillment RPCs that record the change reason', () => {
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(FULFILLMENT_PATH, 'utf8');

    for (const name of ['admin_create_fulfillment', 'admin_cancel_fulfillment']) {
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(`REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public\\.${name}\\([^)]*\\)\\s+FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated`, 'i'));
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(`GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public\\.${name}\\([^)]*\\) TO service_role`, 'i'));
      const body = sql.split(`CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.${name}(`)[1]?.split('$$;')[0];
      expect(body).toBeDefined();
      expect(body).toContain('SECURITY DEFINER');
      expect(body).toContain("SET search_path = ''");
      expect(body).toContain(`'app.order_change_reason', '${name}'`);
    }
    expect(sql).toContain('DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_ship_paid_order(uuid, uuid, text, text, boolean);');
  });

  it('replaces the refund projection RPC with service-role-only refund result RPCs that record the change reason', () => {
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(REFUND_RESULTS_PATH, 'utf8');

    for (const name of [
      'record_order_refund_result',
      'record_external_order_refund',
      'mark_order_refund_error',
      'list_order_refund_summaries',
      'resolve_payment_exception_by_system',
    ]) {
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(`REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public\\.${name}\\([^)]*\\)\\s+FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated`, 'i'));
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(`GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public\\.${name}\\([^)]*\\)\\s+TO service_role`, 'i'));
      const body = sql.split(`CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.${name}(`)[1]?.split('$$;')[0];
      expect(body).toBeDefined();
      expect(body).toContain('SECURITY DEFINER');
      expect(body).toContain("SET search_path = ''");
    }

    // 注文の状態を変える所は、変更の理由を付けてから更新する（保留の守りが、その理由で遷移を通す）
    const stateBody = sql.split('CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.apply_order_refund_state(')[1]?.split('$$;')[0];
    expect(stateBody).toBeDefined();
    expect(stateBody).toContain("'app.order_change_reason'");
    for (const reason of ['refund_projection', 'refund_completed_order', 'refund_failed_reopened']) {
      expect(stateBody).toContain(`'${reason}'`);
    }
    expect(sql).toContain('DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.apply_order_refund_projection(');
    expect(sql).toContain('DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS private.enqueue_order_email(uuid, text, text, uuid);');
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 完全な移行 C を書く**

`supabase/migrations/20261012100200_order_return_receipts.sql` の全内容。注文 → 返品 → 返金 → バリアントの昇順で鍵を取る。追記専用の受け取りの返金番号は INSERT 時に決め、FK の検査だけを取引の終わりへ遅らせる。制約名が計画の冒頭で固定されていない所はカタログから列と参照先を照合して取得する。

```sql
BEGIN;
-- 受け取りの行は追記専用なので、返金番号を INSERT 時に確定する。
-- 同じ取引に入る返金の番号を先に書き、確定時に参照先の実在を検査する。
DO $$
DECLARE v_name text;
BEGIN
  SELECT c.conname INTO STRICT v_name FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS c
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attname='refund_id'
  WHERE c.conrelid='public.order_return_receipts'::regclass AND c.contype='f'
    AND c.confrelid='public.order_refunds'::regclass AND c.conkey=ARRAY[a.attnum];
  EXECUTE pg_catalog.format('ALTER TABLE public.order_return_receipts ALTER CONSTRAINT %I DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED',v_name);
END;
$$;

-- 返品の返金で引いた手数料（P26）。受け取りの今返金は min(付いた手数料, 商品の額)、額を決めて返金は
-- min(fee_pending_deduction, 商品の額)。返金がエラー・失敗になった時に、返品の fee_pending_deduction へ戻す。
-- 引いた手数料は0以上。ほかの道の記録は0。列を省いた直接 INSERT も既定の0になる。道と結ぶ CHECK は作らない。
-- 作った後は変えない（E-2 の守りが、ほかの列と同じに止める）
ALTER TABLE public.order_refunds
  ADD COLUMN return_fee_deduction integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (return_fee_deduction >= 0);

-- 交換の行を割引の分母と最後の行の判定から外す。JOIN する既存の読出しのため、交換の行にも割引0の1行を返す。
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_line_discounts(_order_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (order_item_id uuid, line_discount integer)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  WITH lines AS (
    SELECT oi.id,
           pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (ORDER BY oi.created_at, oi.id) AS line_no,
           pg_catalog.count(*) OVER () AS line_count,
           (pg_catalog.sum(oi.line_total) OVER (
             ORDER BY oi.created_at, oi.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ))::bigint AS running_total,
           (pg_catalog.sum(oi.line_total) OVER ())::bigint AS lines_total
    FROM public.order_items AS oi
    WHERE oi.order_id = _order_id AND oi.line_kind = 'order'
  ),
  rounded AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           l.line_no,
           CASE
             WHEN l.lines_total = 0 THEN
               CASE WHEN l.line_no = l.line_count THEN o.discount_amount::bigint ELSE 0::bigint END
             ELSE (2 * o.discount_amount::bigint * l.running_total + l.lines_total) / (2 * l.lines_total)
           END AS cumulative_discount
    FROM lines AS l
    CROSS JOIN public.orders AS o
    WHERE o.id = _order_id
  )
  SELECT r.id,
         (r.cumulative_discount - pg_catalog.lag(r.cumulative_discount, 1, 0::bigint) OVER (ORDER BY r.line_no))::integer
  FROM rounded AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT oi.id, 0 FROM public.order_items AS oi
  WHERE oi.order_id = _order_id AND oi.line_kind = 'exchange'
$$;

-- 返金の数と割引、交換の元の支払額の額。式は Task 2 の private.return_refund_amount（画面の見込み refund_amounts_by_count と
-- 同じ式。P8）を使い、ここは注文の商品の値と、前に返した数（返事待ち・保留・成功）に呼ぶ側の数を足した数を渡すだけ
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.return_units_amount(_order_item_id uuid,_quantity integer,_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = '' AS $$
  SELECT private.return_refund_amount(oi.line_kind, oi.item_price, oi.quantity, d.line_discount, oi.exchange_paid_amount,
           f.refunded_before_shipment + f.refunded_after_shipment + _offset, _quantity)
  FROM public.order_items AS oi
  JOIN private.order_line_fulfillment(oi.order_id) AS f ON f.order_item_id=oi.id
  JOIN private.order_line_discounts(oi.order_id) AS d ON d.order_item_id=oi.id
  WHERE oi.id=_order_item_id
$$;

-- E-2 の public の引数・戻り値を保ったまま、検証と INSERT を1か所に集める。
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.begin_order_refund_core(
  _order_id uuid,
  _source text,
  _request_key uuid,
  _lines jsonb,
  _restock boolean,
  _shipping_amount integer,
  _amount integer,
  _note text,
  _stripe_reason text,
  _cancel_reason text,
  _notify_customer boolean,
  _actor_id uuid,
  _received_amount integer,
  _return_id uuid,
  _return_fee_deduction integer
)
RETURNS TABLE (refund_id uuid, amount integer, status text, replayed boolean)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_is_admin boolean;
  v_is_auto boolean;
  v_is_cancel boolean;
  v_restock boolean;
  v_notify boolean;
  v_note text;
  v_stripe_reason text;
  v_cancel_reason text;
  v_actor uuid;
  v_fingerprint text;
  v_order public.orders;
  v_existing public.order_refunds;
  v_refundable integer;
  v_refundable_shipping integer;
  v_shipped_total integer;
  v_unshipped_total integer;
  v_resolved jsonb;
  v_included integer;
  v_shipping integer;
  v_amount integer;
  v_priced jsonb;
  v_lines_amount integer;
  v_refund_id uuid;
  v_constraint text;
BEGIN
  -- 1. 引数
  IF _order_id IS NULL
     OR _source IS NULL
     OR _source NOT IN ('admin', 'order_cancel', 'auto_cancelled_order_payment', 'auto_amount_mismatch', 'return')
     OR ((_source = 'return') IS DISTINCT FROM (_return_id IS NOT NULL))
     OR (_source = 'return' AND (_return_fee_deduction IS NULL OR _return_fee_deduction < 0))
     OR (_source <> 'return' AND _return_fee_deduction IS NOT NULL)
     OR _lines IS NULL
     OR _restock IS NULL
     OR _notify_customer IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(_lines) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  v_is_admin := _source IN ('admin', 'return');
  v_is_auto := _source IN ('auto_cancelled_order_payment', 'auto_amount_mismatch');
  v_is_cancel := _source IN ('order_cancel', 'auto_amount_mismatch');

  -- 商品の行を渡してよいのはアだけ（イ・オは DB が残りの未発送を全部入れ、エは行なし）。ア・イには二重防止の番号と実行した人が要る
  IF (NOT v_is_admin AND pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(_lines) > 0)
     OR (NOT v_is_auto AND (_request_key IS NULL OR _actor_id IS NULL))
     OR (_note IS NOT NULL AND pg_catalog.char_length(_note) > 500)
     OR (_stripe_reason IS NOT NULL AND _stripe_reason NOT IN ('requested_by_customer', 'duplicate', 'fraudulent')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- アの送料と額は呼ぶ側が決める。「うち送料」が額を超える返金は作らない
  IF v_is_admin AND (
       _shipping_amount IS NULL OR _shipping_amount < 0
       OR _amount IS NULL OR _amount < 1
       OR _shipping_amount > _amount
       OR _cancel_reason IS NOT NULL
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- イの取消の理由は今の4つ。「その他」はメモも要る（未入金の取消の CANCEL_NOTE_REQUIRED と同じ決まり）
  IF _source = 'order_cancel' AND (
       _cancel_reason IS NULL
       OR _cancel_reason NOT IN ('stock_unavailable', 'customer_request', 'suspected_fraud', 'other')
       OR (_cancel_reason = 'other' AND NULLIF(pg_catalog.btrim(_note), '') IS NULL)
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 自動の返金（エ・オ）は、呼ぶ側の値を使わず DB が決める。知らせる・Stripe に理由を伝えない。
  -- オは在庫に戻し、取消の理由は other、メモは決まった文。実行した人は空
  v_restock := CASE WHEN _source = 'auto_amount_mismatch' THEN true ELSE _restock END;
  v_notify := CASE WHEN v_is_auto THEN true ELSE _notify_customer END;
  v_note := CASE _source
    WHEN 'auto_amount_mismatch' THEN '支払額の違いの自動の取消'
    WHEN 'auto_cancelled_order_payment' THEN NULL
    ELSE _note
  END;
  v_stripe_reason := CASE WHEN v_is_auto THEN NULL ELSE _stripe_reason END;
  v_cancel_reason := CASE _source
    WHEN 'order_cancel' THEN _cancel_reason
    WHEN 'auto_amount_mismatch' THEN 'other'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
  v_actor := CASE WHEN v_is_auto THEN NULL ELSE _actor_id END;

  -- 二重防止の指紋（本計画 P2）: 呼ぶ側が渡した入力を、渡されたままの値で決まった順に並べた JSON の md5。
  -- 行は商品の番号・発送前かの順に並べ替えるので、並びだけが違う送り直しは同じ中身。
  -- DB が決める値（イ・オの行、DB が使わない送料と額）は入れない。イ・オの行は渡された '[]' のまま
  IF _request_key IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_fingerprint := pg_catalog.md5(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'order_id', _order_id,
        'source', _source,
        'lines', COALESCE((
          SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
                   pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                     'order_item_id', p.order_item_id,
                     'before_shipment', p.before_shipment,
                     'quantity', p.quantity
                   )
                   ORDER BY p.order_item_id, p.before_shipment
                 )
          FROM private.parse_refund_lines(_lines) AS p
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'restock', _restock,
        'shipping_amount', _shipping_amount,
        'amount', _amount,
        'note', _note,
        'stripe_reason', _stripe_reason,
        'cancel_reason', _cancel_reason,
        'notify_customer', _notify_customer,
        'received_amount', _received_amount
      )::text
    );
  END IF;

  -- 2. 注文の行の鍵。返金・発送・仕上がり・発送の取消は、この鍵で1つずつ進む
  --    （同時に押されても、後の方は前の操作の後の数で確かめる。設計書 11-2）
  SELECT o.* INTO v_order FROM public.orders AS o WHERE o.id = _order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- 返品の入力の指紋は、受け取りは追記済みの受け取り、単独の返金は入力そのものを使う。
  -- _received_amount は return の内部呼出しだけ、計算前の任意の額（NULLも含む）を保持する。
  IF _source = 'return' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.order_returns AS r WHERE r.id=_return_id AND r.order_id=_order_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RETURN_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
    SELECT rr.request_fingerprint INTO v_fingerprint FROM public.order_return_receipts AS rr
    WHERE rr.request_key=_request_key AND rr.return_id=_return_id AND rr.kind='receive';
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      v_fingerprint:=pg_catalog.md5(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('return_id',_return_id,'amount',_received_amount,
        'shipping_amount',_shipping_amount,'note',_note,'notify_customer',_notify_customer)::text);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 3. 同じ二重防止の番号の送り直し（通信が切れた後の「もう一度確かめる」）。同じ中身なら前の記録を返し、
  --    注文の状態や数が変わっていても確かめ直さない。中身が違えば断る
  IF _request_key IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT r.* INTO v_existing FROM public.order_refunds AS r WHERE r.request_key = _request_key;
    IF FOUND THEN
      IF v_existing.order_id <> _order_id OR v_existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM v_fingerprint THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE=CASE WHEN _source='return' THEN 'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH' ELSE 'REFUND_REQUEST_MISMATCH' END, ERRCODE='22023';
      END IF;
      RETURN QUERY SELECT v_existing.id, v_existing.amount, v_existing.status, true;
      RETURN;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 4. エは取り消した注文だけ。受け取った額が空なら、入金を見つけた額を注文に書く（空の時だけ。書いた額が全額になる）
  IF _source = 'auto_cancelled_order_payment' THEN
    IF v_order.status <> 'cancelled'::public.order_status THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    IF v_order.paid_amount IS NULL THEN
      IF _received_amount IS NULL OR _received_amount < 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
      END IF;
      -- 前の取引の値が残らないように、操作した人と元の知らせの番号は空にする
      PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('app.order_actor_id', '', true);
      PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('app.order_change_reason', 'record_cancelled_order_payment', true);
      PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config('app.order_source_event_id', '', true);
      UPDATE public.orders AS o SET paid_amount = _received_amount WHERE o.id = _order_id;
      v_order.paid_amount := _received_amount;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 5. 返金できる状態: 支払い済み・発送済み・取り消した注文で、受け取った額がある
  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('paid'::public.order_status, 'shipped'::public.order_status, 'cancelled'::public.order_status)
     OR v_order.paid_amount IS NULL
     OR v_order.paid_amount < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 6. 返事待ちの返金がある注文には、新しい返金を作れない（確かめ直しだけ。毎時の見回りが片付ける）
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.order_refunds AS r
    WHERE r.order_id = _order_id
      AND r.status = 'awaiting_response'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AWAITING_REFUND_EXISTS' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(l.shipped), 0)::integer, COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(l.unshipped), 0)::integer
  INTO v_shipped_total, v_unshipped_total
  FROM private.order_line_fulfillment(_order_id) AS l;

  -- 7. キャンセルは、支払い済みで1つも発送していない注文だけ（Shopify も一部を発送した後はできない）
  IF v_is_cancel AND (v_order.status <> 'paid'::public.order_status OR v_shipped_total > 0) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 8. 返せる額 = 受け取った額 − 返事待ち・保留・成功の返金。0なら何も返せない
  SELECT a.refundable_amount, a.refundable_shipping INTO v_refundable, v_refundable_shipping
  FROM private.order_refund_amounts(_order_id) AS a;
  IF v_refundable IS NULL OR v_refundable < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 9. 商品の行。イ・オは残りの未発送を全部、発送前の行に入れる。エは行なし
  IF v_is_admin THEN
    v_resolved := _lines;
  ELSIF v_is_cancel THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(
             pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
               pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('order_item_id', l.order_item_id, 'before_shipment', true, 'quantity', l.unshipped)
               ORDER BY l.order_item_id
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           )
    INTO v_resolved
    FROM private.order_line_fulfillment(_order_id) AS l
    WHERE l.unshipped > 0;
  ELSE
    v_resolved := '[]'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM private.parse_refund_lines(v_resolved) AS p
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items AS oi WHERE oi.id = p.order_item_id AND oi.order_id = _order_id
    )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_LINE_NOT_IN_ORDER' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM private.parse_refund_lines(v_resolved) AS p
    JOIN private.order_line_fulfillment(_order_id) AS l ON l.order_item_id = p.order_item_id
    WHERE p.before_shipment
      AND p.quantity > l.unshipped
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_UNSHIPPED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM private.parse_refund_lines(v_resolved) AS p
    JOIN private.order_line_return_counts(_order_id) AS l ON l.order_item_id = p.order_item_id
    WHERE NOT p.before_shipment AND _source <> 'return'
      AND p.quantity > l.refundable_after_shipment
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_SHIPPED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 返品の返金は、受け取った返金の品で覆われていない数まで。発送前には使わせない。
  IF _source='return' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM private.parse_refund_lines(v_resolved) AS p
    WHERE p.before_shipment OR p.quantity > COALESCE((
      SELECT pg_catalog.sum(g.refund_waiting)::integer
      FROM private.order_return_line_progress(_return_id) AS g
      JOIN public.order_return_lines AS rl ON rl.id=g.return_line_id
      WHERE rl.order_item_id=p.order_item_id
    ),0)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RETURN_RECEIPT_EXCEEDS' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;

  -- 10. 送料と額。アは呼ぶ側の値。イ・エ・オは返せる額の全部で、送料はイ・オだけ返せる送料の全部
  --     （手で額を減らした返金が前にあっても、「うち送料」が額を超えないようにする）
  IF v_is_admin THEN
    v_shipping := _shipping_amount;
    v_amount := _amount;
  ELSE
    v_amount := v_refundable;
    v_shipping := CASE
      WHEN _source = 'auto_cancelled_order_payment' THEN 0
      ELSE LEAST(v_refundable_shipping, v_refundable)
    END;
  END IF;
  IF v_shipping > v_refundable_shipping THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_SHIPPING_EXCEEDS' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_amount > v_refundable THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 11. 全額の時の決まり（アだけ。イ・オは上で残りを全部入れ、エは取り消した注文で確保が戻し済み）。
  --     全額になるのに未発送が残ると、取り消した注文に確保が残り続ける（R-16）ので断る。
  --     1つも発送していない注文で残りを全部返すのに、送料か額が全部でなければ、全額に届かずキャンセルにならない注文が残るので断る。
  --     全部の送料は min(返せる送料, 返せる額): 前の返金で額を手で増やして、返せる額が返せる送料より小さい注文でも、
  --     「送料 ≤ 額」を守ったまま残りを返せる（イ・オと同じ）。取り消した注文（取消の後の入金）でも同じ決まり（本計画 P28）
  IF v_is_admin THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(p.quantity) FILTER (WHERE p.before_shipment), 0)::integer INTO v_included
    FROM private.parse_refund_lines(v_resolved) AS p;

    IF v_amount = v_refundable AND v_unshipped_total - v_included > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_MUST_INCLUDE_UNSHIPPED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    IF v_shipped_total = 0
       AND v_included > 0
       AND v_unshipped_total - v_included = 0
       AND (v_shipping <> LEAST(v_refundable_shipping, v_refundable) OR v_amount <> v_refundable) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 12. 商品ごとの額（設計書 4-5）。今回の k 個の額 = 単価 × k − (disc(b + k) − disc(b))。b は前に返した数
  --     （その商品の発送前と発送後を合わせた、返事待ち・保留・成功の数）。同じ返金に同じ商品の発送前と発送後の行がある時は、
  --     発送前の行を先に数える: 発送前の行の b = 前に返した数、発送後の行の b = 前に返した数 + 発送前の行の数
  --     （窓関数の PARTITION BY 商品 ORDER BY before_shipment DESC。入力の並びには依らない）。商品どうしの割り振りは独立。
  --     在庫に戻すのは、発送前・在庫の品・チェックありの行だけ
  SELECT COALESCE(
           pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
             pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
               'order_item_id', q.order_item_id,
               'before_shipment', q.before_shipment,
               'quantity', q.quantity,
               'restock_type', CASE
                 WHEN _source='return' THEN 'return'::text
                 WHEN q.before_shipment AND q.fulfillment_type = 'stock' AND v_restock THEN 'cancel'::text
                 ELSE 'no_restock'::text
               END,
               'amount', private.return_units_amount(q.order_item_id,q.quantity,q.earlier_in_refund)
             )
             ORDER BY q.order_item_id, q.before_shipment DESC
           ),
           '[]'::jsonb
         )
  INTO v_priced
  FROM (
    SELECT p.order_item_id,
           p.before_shipment,
           p.quantity,
           l.fulfillment_type,
           oi.item_price,
           oi.quantity AS ordered,
           d.line_discount,
           l.refunded_before_shipment + l.refunded_after_shipment AS already_refunded,
           COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(p.quantity) OVER (
             PARTITION BY p.order_item_id
             ORDER BY p.before_shipment DESC
             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ), 0)::integer AS earlier_in_refund
    FROM private.parse_refund_lines(v_resolved) AS p
    JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.id = p.order_item_id
    JOIN private.order_line_fulfillment(_order_id) AS l ON l.order_item_id = p.order_item_id
    JOIN private.order_line_discounts(_order_id) AS d ON d.order_item_id = p.order_item_id
  ) AS q;

  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(x.amount), 0)::integer INTO v_lines_amount
  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_to_recordset(v_priced)
    AS x(order_item_id uuid, before_shipment boolean, quantity integer, restock_type text, amount integer);

  -- 13. 記録。計算との差 = 返金額 − （行の額の合計 + 送料）。行の無い返金では返金額そのもの
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.order_refunds AS r
      (id, return_id, order_id, source, request_key, request_fingerprint, status, amount, shipping_amount, adjustment_amount,
       note, stripe_reason, cancel_reason, notify_customer, actor_id, return_fee_deduction)
    VALUES
      (COALESCE((SELECT rr.refund_id FROM public.order_return_receipts AS rr WHERE rr.return_id=_return_id AND rr.request_key=_request_key),pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid()),
       _return_id, _order_id, _source, _request_key, v_fingerprint, 'awaiting_response', v_amount, v_shipping,
       v_amount - (v_lines_amount + v_shipping), v_note, v_stripe_reason, v_cancel_reason, v_notify, v_actor, COALESCE(_return_fee_deduction, 0))
    RETURNING r.id INTO v_refund_id;
  EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    -- 同じ番号をほかの注文の返金が同時に使った（同じ注文の送り直しは、鍵の後の確かめで前の記録を返している）
    GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_constraint = CONSTRAINT_NAME;
    IF v_constraint = 'order_refunds_request_key_key' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE=CASE WHEN _source='return' THEN 'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH' ELSE 'REFUND_REQUEST_MISMATCH' END, ERRCODE='22023';
    END IF;
    RAISE;
  END;

  INSERT INTO public.order_refund_lines (refund_id, order_item_id, quantity, before_shipment, restock_type, amount)
  SELECT v_refund_id, x.order_item_id, x.quantity, x.before_shipment, x.restock_type, x.amount
  FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_to_recordset(v_priced)
    AS x(order_item_id uuid, before_shipment boolean, quantity integer, restock_type text, amount integer);

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_refund_id, v_amount, 'awaiting_response'::text, false;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.begin_order_refund(
  _order_id uuid, _source text, _request_key uuid, _lines jsonb, _restock boolean,
  _shipping_amount integer, _amount integer, _note text, _stripe_reason text, _cancel_reason text,
  _notify_customer boolean, _actor_id uuid, _received_amount integer DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS TABLE (refund_id uuid, amount integer, status text, replayed boolean)
LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $$
  SELECT * FROM private.begin_order_refund_core(_order_id,_source,_request_key,_lines,_restock,_shipping_amount,
    _amount,_note,_stripe_reason,_cancel_reason,_notify_customer,_actor_id,_received_amount,NULL::uuid,NULL::integer)
$$;


-- 画面に渡す数と core の上限が同じになるよう、返品の数の関数を使う。
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.load_order_refund_materials(_order_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (
  order_id uuid,
  order_status public.order_status,
  total_amount integer,
  shipping_amount integer,
  discount_amount integer,
  paid_amount integer,
  succeeded_amount integer,
  open_amount integer,
  refundable_amount integer,
  refunded_shipping integer,
  refundable_shipping integer,
  shipped_total integer,
  unshipped_total integer,
  awaiting_refund_id uuid,
  awaiting_refund_amount integer,
  awaiting_refund_created_at timestamptz,
  lines jsonb
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  SELECT o.id,
         o.status,
         o.total_amount,
         o.shipping_amount,
         o.discount_amount,
         a.paid_amount,
         a.succeeded_amount,
         a.open_amount,
         a.refundable_amount,
         a.refunded_shipping,
         a.refundable_shipping,
         c.shipped_total,
         c.unshipped_total,
         w.id,
         w.amount,
         w.created_at,
         c.lines
  FROM public.orders AS o
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL private.order_refund_amounts(o.id) AS a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(f.shipped), 0)::integer AS shipped_total,
           COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(f.unshipped), 0)::integer AS unshipped_total,
           COALESCE(
             pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
               pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'order_item_id', f.order_item_id,
                 'fulfillment_type', f.fulfillment_type,
                 'item_price', oi.item_price,
                 'quantity', f.quantity,
                 'line_total', oi.line_total,
                 'exchange_paid_amount', oi.exchange_paid_amount,
                 'shipped', f.shipped,
                 'unshipped', f.unshipped,
                 'refunded_before_shipment', f.refunded_before_shipment,
                 'refunded_after_shipment', f.refunded_after_shipment,
                 'shipped_refundable', rc.refundable_after_shipment,
                 -- 在庫に戻せる数は、確保している数まで。確保の記録が無い古い商品（R-41）と受注生産は0
                 'restockable', CASE
                   WHEN f.fulfillment_type = 'stock' THEN LEAST(f.unshipped, GREATEST(r.reserved - f.shipped, 0))
                   ELSE 0
                 END,
                 'line_discount', d.line_discount,
                 'refunded_units', f.refunded_before_shipment + f.refunded_after_shipment
               )
               ORDER BY oi.created_at, oi.id
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS lines
    FROM private.order_line_fulfillment(o.id) AS f
    JOIN private.order_line_return_counts(o.id) AS rc ON rc.order_item_id=f.order_item_id
    JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.id = f.order_item_id
    JOIN private.order_line_reservations(o.id) AS r ON r.order_item_id = f.order_item_id
    JOIN private.order_line_discounts(o.id) AS d ON d.order_item_id = f.order_item_id
  ) AS c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ar.id, ar.amount, ar.created_at
    FROM public.order_refunds AS ar
    WHERE ar.order_id = o.id
      AND ar.status = 'awaiting_response'
    ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC, ar.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS w ON true
  WHERE o.id = _order_id
$$;

-- 引数は E-2 の5つのまま。返品番号と同時受け取りの番号は返金から引く。
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_order_email(
  _order_id uuid,
  _kind text,
  _variant text DEFAULT NULL,
  _fulfillment_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  _refund_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE v_return uuid; v_receipt uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT r.return_id INTO v_return FROM public.order_refunds AS r WHERE r.id=_refund_id;
  SELECT rr.id INTO v_receipt FROM public.order_return_receipts AS rr WHERE rr.refund_id=_refund_id;
  IF _kind = 'shipped' THEN
    INSERT INTO private.order_email_outbox (order_id, kind, variant, origin, fulfillment_id, refund_id, return_id, return_receipt_id)
    VALUES (_order_id, _kind, _variant, 'auto', _fulfillment_id, _refund_id, v_return, v_receipt)
    ON CONFLICT (fulfillment_id) WHERE origin = 'auto' AND kind = 'shipped' DO NOTHING;
  ELSIF _refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO private.order_email_outbox (order_id, kind, variant, origin, fulfillment_id, refund_id, return_id, return_receipt_id)
    VALUES (_order_id, _kind, _variant, 'auto', _fulfillment_id, _refund_id, v_return, v_receipt)
    ON CONFLICT (refund_id, kind) WHERE origin = 'auto' AND refund_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING;
  ELSE
    INSERT INTO private.order_email_outbox (order_id, kind, variant, origin, fulfillment_id, refund_id, return_id, return_receipt_id)
    VALUES (_order_id, _kind, _variant, 'auto', _fulfillment_id, _refund_id, v_return, v_receipt)
    ON CONFLICT (order_id, kind)
      WHERE origin = 'auto' AND kind <> 'shipped' AND refund_id IS NULL
        AND kind NOT IN ('return_accepted', 'return_received', 'return_sent_back', 'return_refund_pending_shop')
      DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$$;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.claim_order_email(integer);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_order_email(_lease_seconds integer)
RETURNS TABLE (
  email_id uuid,
  order_id uuid,
  kind text,
  variant text,
  origin text,
  attempts integer,
  lease_token uuid,
  subject text,
  body_text text,
  payment_expired_sent boolean,
  fulfillment_id uuid,
  refund_id uuid,
  return_id uuid,
  return_receipt_id uuid
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_paused boolean;
  v_next_probe_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  IF _lease_seconds IS NULL OR _lease_seconds < 30 OR _lease_seconds > 900 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_LEASE_SECONDS' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  UPDATE private.order_email_outbox AS e
  SET status = CASE WHEN e.attempts >= private.order_email_max_attempts() THEN 'dead' ELSE 'retry_wait' END,
      finished_at = CASE WHEN e.attempts >= private.order_email_max_attempts() THEN pg_catalog.now() END,
      subject = CASE WHEN e.attempts >= private.order_email_max_attempts() THEN NULL ELSE e.subject END,
      body_text = CASE WHEN e.attempts >= private.order_email_max_attempts() THEN NULL ELSE e.body_text END,
      body_erased_at = CASE
        WHEN e.attempts >= private.order_email_max_attempts() AND e.subject IS NOT NULL THEN pg_catalog.now()
        ELSE e.body_erased_at
      END,
      lease_token = NULL,
      lease_expires_at = NULL,
      last_error_code = 'lease_expired',
      next_attempt_at = pg_catalog.now() + private.order_email_retry_delay(e.attempts)
  WHERE e.status = 'sending'
    AND e.lease_expires_at <= pg_catalog.now();

  -- 止めていない間は一時停止の行をロックしない（同時に動く worker の取り出しを待たせない）
  SELECT p.paused INTO v_paused FROM private.order_email_send_pause AS p WHERE p.id;
  IF v_paused THEN
    SELECT p.paused, p.next_probe_at INTO v_paused, v_next_probe_at
    FROM private.order_email_send_pause AS p
    WHERE p.id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_paused THEN
      IF v_next_probe_at > pg_catalog.now() THEN
        RETURN;
      END IF;
      UPDATE private.order_email_send_pause AS p
      SET next_probe_at = pg_catalog.now() + interval '15 minutes',
          updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
      WHERE p.id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT e.id
    FROM private.order_email_outbox AS e
    WHERE e.status IN ('pending', 'retry_wait')
      AND e.next_attempt_at <= pg_catalog.now()
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM private.order_email_outbox AS earlier
        WHERE earlier.order_id = e.order_id
          AND earlier.seq < e.seq
          AND earlier.status IN ('pending', 'sending', 'retry_wait')
      )
    ORDER BY e.next_attempt_at, e.seq
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  claimed AS (
    UPDATE private.order_email_outbox AS e
    SET status = 'sending',
        attempts = e.attempts + 1,
        lease_token = pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid(),
        lease_expires_at = pg_catalog.now() + pg_catalog.make_interval(secs => _lease_seconds),
        last_error_code = NULL
    FROM candidate AS c
    WHERE e.id = c.id
    RETURNING e.id, e.order_id, e.kind, e.variant, e.origin, e.attempts, e.lease_token, e.subject, e.body_text,
              e.fulfillment_id, e.refund_id, e.return_id, e.return_receipt_id
  )
  SELECT c.id, c.order_id, c.kind, c.variant, c.origin, c.attempts, c.lease_token, c.subject, c.body_text,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM private.order_email_outbox AS x
           WHERE x.order_id = c.order_id
             AND x.kind = 'payment_expired'
             AND x.status = 'sent'
         ),
         c.fulfillment_id,
         c.refund_id, c.return_id, c.return_receipt_id
  FROM claimed AS c;
END;
$$;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.list_order_email_history(uuid);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_order_email_history(_order_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (
  email_id uuid,
  kind text,
  variant text,
  origin text,
  requested_by_email text,
  status text,
  attempts integer,
  last_error_code text,
  delivery_status text,
  delivery_event_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz,
  sent_at timestamptz,
  finished_at timestamptz,
  has_body boolean,
  body_erased boolean,
  fulfillment_id uuid,
  fulfillment_number integer,
  refund_id uuid,
  return_id uuid,
  return_receipt_id uuid
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  SELECT e.id, e.kind, e.variant, e.origin, u.email::text, e.status, e.attempts, e.last_error_code,
         e.delivery_status, e.delivery_event_at, e.created_at, e.sent_at, e.finished_at,
         e.body_text IS NOT NULL, e.body_erased_at IS NOT NULL,
         e.fulfillment_id, f.number, e.refund_id, e.return_id, e.return_receipt_id
  FROM private.order_email_outbox AS e
  LEFT JOIN auth.users AS u ON u.id = e.requested_by
  LEFT JOIN public.order_fulfillments AS f ON f.id = e.fulfillment_id
  WHERE e.order_id = _order_id
  ORDER BY e.seq DESC
$$;

-- 新しい種類は入力として受けるが、既存の許可状態の表には入れず RESEND_NOT_ALLOWED で断る。
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_order_email_resend(
  _order_id uuid,
  _kind text,
  _actor_id uuid,
  _fulfillment_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_status public.order_status;
  v_variant text;
  v_refund_id uuid;
  v_found boolean;
  v_email_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF _order_id IS NULL OR _kind IS NULL OR _actor_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESEND_ARGUMENT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF _kind NOT IN ('paid', 'awaiting_payment', 'payment_expired', 'canceled', 'shipped', 'refund','return_accepted','return_received','return_sent_back','return_refund_pending_shop') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_EMAIL_KIND' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  -- 発送のメールは発送ごとに送るので、どの発送かが要る
  IF _kind = 'shipped' AND _fulfillment_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESEND_FULFILLMENT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT o.status INTO v_status FROM public.orders AS o WHERE o.id = _order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- 発送のメールは、一部だけ送った決済完了の注文でも再送できる。返金のお知らせはどの状態でも再送できない
  IF NOT (
    (_kind = 'paid' AND v_status IN ('paid', 'shipped'))
    OR (_kind = 'awaiting_payment' AND v_status = 'pending')
    OR (_kind = 'payment_expired' AND v_status = 'failed')
    OR (_kind = 'canceled' AND v_status = 'cancelled')
    OR (_kind = 'shipped' AND v_status IN ('paid', 'shipped'))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESEND_NOT_ALLOWED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 発送の番号は発送のメールだけに付く。その注文の、取り消していない発送だけ
  IF (_kind <> 'shipped' AND _fulfillment_id IS NOT NULL)
     OR (_kind = 'shipped' AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM public.order_fulfillments AS f
       WHERE f.id = _fulfillment_id
         AND f.order_id = _order_id
         AND f.cancelled_at IS NULL
     )) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESEND_NOT_ALLOWED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 失敗・エラーになった返金の行から写すと、お金が戻らない文のメールが届く。そういう行は写す元にしない（設計書 8-2）
  SELECT e.variant, e.refund_id, true INTO v_variant, v_refund_id, v_found
  FROM private.order_email_outbox AS e
  WHERE e.order_id = _order_id
    AND e.kind = _kind
    AND e.fulfillment_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _fulfillment_id
    AND e.status IN ('sent', 'dead')
    AND (e.refund_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.order_refunds AS r
      WHERE r.id = e.refund_id
        AND r.status IN ('failed', 'error')
    ))
  ORDER BY e.seq DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT COALESCE(v_found, false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESEND_NOT_ALLOWED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO private.order_email_outbox (order_id, kind, variant, origin, requested_by, fulfillment_id, refund_id)
    VALUES (_order_id, _kind, v_variant, 'manual', _actor_id, _fulfillment_id, v_refund_id)
    RETURNING id INTO v_email_id;
  EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'RESEND_ALREADY_QUEUED' USING ERRCODE = '23505';
  END;

  RETURN v_email_id;
END;
$$;

-- 返品の種類は取りやめない。ただし店への返金待ちの知らせは、その返品の返金待ちが0なら superseded にできる。
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.skip_order_email(_email_id uuid, _lease_token uuid, _reason text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF _reason IS NULL OR _reason NOT IN ('superseded', 'no_recipient', 'fulfillment_cancelled') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_SKIP_REASON' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 取りやめ（superseded）は入金待ちと支払い期限切れ、返金が失敗・エラーになった返金の行、または返金待ちが0の店への知らせだけ。
  -- 入金済み・取消・発送、返金が失敗・エラーでない返金の行は、その時の事実を伝えるので取りやめない
  IF _reason = 'superseded' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM private.order_email_outbox AS e
    WHERE e.id = _email_id
      AND e.kind NOT IN ('awaiting_payment', 'payment_expired')
      AND NOT (
        e.kind = 'return_refund_pending_shop'
        AND e.return_id IS NOT NULL
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM private.order_return_line_progress(e.return_id) AS g WHERE g.refund_waiting > 0
        )
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.order_refunds AS r
        WHERE r.id = e.refund_id
          AND r.status IN ('failed', 'error')
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPERSEDE_NOT_ALLOWED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 発送の取消による取りやめは、取り消した発送の発送のメールだけ（worker の思い違いで、送るべきメールを落とさない）
  IF _reason = 'fulfillment_cancelled' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM private.order_email_outbox AS e
    LEFT JOIN public.order_fulfillments AS f ON f.id = e.fulfillment_id
    WHERE e.id = _email_id
      AND (e.kind <> 'shipped' OR f.cancelled_at IS NULL)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SKIP_REASON_NOT_ALLOWED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  UPDATE private.order_email_outbox AS e
  SET status = 'skipped',
      finished_at = pg_catalog.now(),
      subject = NULL,
      body_text = NULL,
      body_erased_at = CASE WHEN e.subject IS NOT NULL THEN pg_catalog.now() ELSE e.body_erased_at END,
      lease_token = NULL,
      lease_expires_at = NULL,
      last_error_code = _reason
  WHERE e.id = _email_id
    AND e.status = 'sending'
    AND e.lease_token = _lease_token;
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$$;

-- 返品の在庫は受け取りで動かす。既存の before_shipment の条件を保ち、返金結果では二度動かさない。
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.apply_order_refund_state(_refund_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (
  newly_accepted boolean,
  newly_failed boolean,
  order_status public.order_status,
  refunded_amount integer,
  rereserve_shortage integer,
  email_enqueued boolean,
  exception_id uuid
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
  v_refund public.order_refunds%ROWTYPE;
  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_line record;
  v_accepted boolean := false;
  v_failed boolean := false;
  v_email boolean := false;
  v_exception uuid;
  v_available integer;
  v_take integer;
  v_shortage integer := 0;
  v_kind text;
  v_variant text;
  v_succeeded integer;
  v_succeeded_at timestamptz;
  v_full integer;
  v_refunded integer;
  v_unshipped integer;
  v_shipped integer;
  v_target public.order_status;
  v_reason text := 'refund_projection';
  v_mark_review boolean := false;
  v_cancel_reason text;
  v_cancel_note text;
  v_cancel_notify boolean;
  v_shipped_at timestamptz;
  v_carrier text;
  v_tracking text;
  v_last_shipped_at timestamptz;
  v_last_carrier text;
  v_last_tracking text;
BEGIN
  SELECT r.* INTO v_refund FROM public.order_refunds AS r WHERE r.id = _refund_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  -- 呼ぶ側が取った鍵と同じ行（自分の鍵は取り直しても待たない）
  SELECT o.* INTO v_order FROM public.orders AS o WHERE o.id = v_refund.order_id FOR UPDATE;
  v_target := v_order.status;
  v_refunded := v_order.refunded_amount;

  -- 2. Stripe が受け付けた時（保留か成功に初めてなった時）の1回だけ、在庫を動かす（設計書 7-1）。写しは動かさない
  IF v_refund.source <> 'legacy'
     AND v_refund.stock_applied_at IS NULL
     AND v_refund.status IN ('pending', 'succeeded') THEN
    PERFORM 1
    FROM public.item_variants AS v
    WHERE v.id IN (
      SELECT oi.variant_id
      FROM public.order_refund_lines AS rl
      JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.id = rl.order_item_id
      WHERE rl.refund_id = v_refund.id
        AND rl.before_shipment
        AND oi.fulfillment_type = 'stock'
        AND oi.variant_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    ORDER BY v.id
    FOR UPDATE;

    -- 外せる数 = min(返金する数, max(確保中の数 − 発送した数, 0))。確保の記録が無い古い商品（R-41）は 0 になり、在庫が湧かない
    FOR v_line IN
      SELECT rl.id AS line_id,
             rl.order_item_id,
             rl.restock_type,
             oi.variant_id,
             LEAST(rl.quantity, GREATEST(res.reserved - f.shipped, 0)) AS release_quantity
      FROM public.order_refund_lines AS rl
      JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.id = rl.order_item_id
      JOIN private.order_line_reservations(v_order.id) AS res ON res.order_item_id = rl.order_item_id
      JOIN private.order_line_fulfillment(v_order.id) AS f ON f.order_item_id = rl.order_item_id
      WHERE rl.refund_id = v_refund.id
        AND rl.before_shipment
        AND oi.fulfillment_type = 'stock'
        AND oi.variant_id IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY oi.variant_id, rl.order_item_id
    LOOP
      IF v_line.release_quantity > 0 THEN
        -- 先に +n を書く（戻さない時の −n で、すぐ出せる数が負にならないように）
        INSERT INTO public.stock_movements
          (variant_id, delta, reason, order_id, order_item_id, note, created_by, refund_id)
        VALUES
          (v_line.variant_id, v_line.release_quantity, 'refund', v_order.id, v_line.order_item_id,
           CASE WHEN v_line.restock_type = 'cancel' THEN 'refund_restock' ELSE 'refund_release' END,
           v_refund.actor_id, v_refund.id);
        IF v_line.restock_type = 'no_restock' THEN
          INSERT INTO public.stock_movements
            (variant_id, delta, reason, order_id, order_item_id, note, created_by, refund_id)
          VALUES
            (v_line.variant_id, -v_line.release_quantity, 'adjustment', v_order.id, v_line.order_item_id,
             'refund_no_restock', v_refund.actor_id, v_refund.id);
        END IF;
        UPDATE public.order_refund_lines AS l
        SET released_quantity = v_line.release_quantity,
            restocked_quantity = CASE WHEN v_line.restock_type = 'cancel' THEN v_line.release_quantity ELSE 0 END
        WHERE l.id = v_line.line_id;
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    UPDATE public.order_refunds AS r SET stock_applied_at = pg_catalog.now() WHERE r.id = v_refund.id;
    v_accepted := true;
  END IF;

  -- 3. お客様へのメールの予定（1回だけ。設計書 8-1・8-2）。残高不足の保留は、お金が動く成功まで待つ。写しは書かない
  IF v_refund.source <> 'legacy'
     AND v_refund.notify_customer
     AND v_refund.email_enqueued_at IS NULL
     AND (v_refund.status = 'succeeded'
```
