- [ ] **Step 3: 返品の型と言葉を書く**

2つのファイルを作る。型のファイルは、この Step では専用の試験を持たない。記号の表と、画面からも読めること（型だけの import）は Step 2 の試験が確かめる。`return-types.ts` の C-2 の枠（`export const RETURN_STATUSES` から `OrderReturnSummary` まで）は、共通の約束 C-2 の写しなので1字も変えない。`ShopReturnSettingsUpdate` はその外に足した物。

`src/lib/orders/returns/return-types.ts`:

```ts
import type { OrderStatus } from '@/lib/orders/order-payment-types';
import type { OrderRefundStatus } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';

/**
 * 返品の窓口の形と記号（グループ E-3 設計書 3〜8 章）。窓口・DB の呼び出し・画面が同じ型を使うので、画面からも読む。
 * サーバーだけの物を import しない（型だけの import に限る）。
 * DB の関数が返す jsonb は、ここの型のキーを snake_case にした形（fulfillment_id・deadline_date・refund_amounts_by_count など）。
 * camelCase への直しは return-store.ts だけが行う。
 */
export const RETURN_STATUSES = ['requested', 'open', 'closed', 'cancelled', 'declined'] as const;
export type ReturnStatus = (typeof RETURN_STATUSES)[number];
export const RETURN_DISPLAY_STATUSES = ['requested', 'in_progress', 'refund_waiting', 'returned'] as const;
export type ReturnDisplayStatus = (typeof RETURN_DISPLAY_STATUSES)[number];
export const RETURN_MARKS = ['awaiting_items', 'partially_received', 'pending_inspection', 'awaiting_fee'] as const;
export type ReturnMark = (typeof RETURN_MARKS)[number];
export const RETURN_NEXT_ACTIONS = ['review_request', 'refund', 'receive', 'none'] as const;
export type ReturnNextAction = (typeof RETURN_NEXT_ACTIONS)[number];
export const RETURN_REASONS = ['defective', 'wrong_item', 'size_too_small', 'size_too_large', 'color', 'style', 'not_as_described', 'unwanted', 'other', 'unknown'] as const;
export type ReturnReason = (typeof RETURN_REASONS)[number];
export type ReturnResolution = 'refund' | 'exchange';
export type ExchangeMethod = 'stock' | 'make';
export type ReturnMethod = 'customer_ships' | 'shop_label' | 'not_required';
export type ShippingPayer = 'shop' | 'customer';
export const RETURN_CARRIERS = ['yamato', 'sagawa', 'japanpost', 'other'] as const;
export type ReturnCarrier = (typeof RETURN_CARRIERS)[number];
export type ReceiptDisposition = 'restocked' | 'not_restocked' | 'pending_inspection' | 'sent_back';
export type RefundChoice = 'now' | 'consult' | 'none';
export type OutOfStockExchange = 'make' | 'decline';
export const RETURN_ERROR_CODES = [
  'RETURN_NOT_FOUND', 'RETURN_ARGUMENT_INVALID', 'RETURN_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS', 'RETURN_EXCHANGE_VARIANT_INVALID',
  'RETURN_ADDRESS_REQUIRED', 'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT', 'RETURN_RECEIPT_EXCEEDS', 'RETURN_EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK',
  'RETURN_FORBIDDEN', 'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH', 'RETURN_REASON_NOTE_REQUIRED', 'RETURN_SENT_BACK_MESSAGE_REQUIRED',
  'RETURN_FEE_INVALID', 'RETURN_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID', 'RETURN_NOTHING_TO_REFUND', 'FULFILLMENT_HAS_RETURN',
  'FULFILLMENT_EXCHANGE_ON_HOLD', 'ORDER_NOT_RETURNABLE',
] as const;
export type ReturnErrorCode = (typeof RETURN_ERROR_CODES)[number];

export type ShopReturnSettings = {
  requestsEnabled: boolean; requestTypes: 'returns_and_cancellations' | 'returns_only' | 'cancellations_only';
  noticeText: string; windowDays: number | null; windowStart: 'each_item' | 'last_item'; deliveryBufferDays: number;
  returnAddress: { name: string; postalCode: string; address: string; phone: string } | null;
  customerPaidMethod: 'customer_ships' | 'shop_label'; shopLabelFee: number; noReturnNeededEnabled: boolean;
  restockingFeeEnabled: boolean; restockingFeePercent: number;
  exchangeFeesEnabled: boolean; exchangeFee: number; exchangeShippingFee: number;
  inspectionEnabled: boolean;
  reasons: Array<{ reason: ReturnReason; shown: boolean; resolutions: 'refund_and_exchange' | 'exchange_only' | 'refund_only';
                   outOfStockExchange: OutOfStockExchange; photo: 'none' | 'optional' | 'required'; photoInstructions: string;
                   shippingPayer: ShippingPayer }>;
  updated: Record<'requests' | 'window' | 'shipping' | 'reasons' | 'fees' | 'receiving', { at: string | null; byEmail: string | null }>;
};
export type ReturnCreateMaterials = {
  order: { id: string; status: OrderStatus; hasAwaitingRefund: boolean };
  shipments: Array<{
    fulfillmentId: string; number: number; shippedAt: string; deadlineDate: string | null; pastDeadline: boolean;
    lines: Array<{ orderItemId: string; itemId: number; variantId: number | null; itemName: string; color: string | null; size: string | null;
                   lineKind: 'order' | 'exchange'; quantity: number; returnable: number }>;
  }>;
  exchangeOptions: Array<{ itemId: number; variants: Array<{ variantId: number; color: string | null; size: string | null;
                                                             isActive: boolean; stockQuantity: number; madeToOrderLeadDays: number | null }> }>;
  settings: { returnAddressSet: boolean; noReturnNeededEnabled: boolean; customerPaidMethod: 'customer_ships' | 'shop_label'; shopLabelFee: number;
              restockingFeeEnabled: boolean; restockingFeePercent: number; exchangeFeesEnabled: boolean; exchangeFee: number; exchangeShippingFee: number;
              reasonShippingPayers: Record<ReturnReason, ShippingPayer>; reasonOutOfStockExchange: Record<ReturnReason, OutOfStockExchange> };
};
export type OrderReturnLineDetail = {
  id: string; fulfillmentId: string; fulfillmentNumber: number; orderItemId: string; itemName: string; color: string | null; size: string | null;
  quantity: number; reason: ReturnReason; reasonNote: string | null; resolution: ReturnResolution;
  exchange: { variantId: number; color: string | null; size: string | null; method: ExchangeMethod; stockQuantity: number;
              madeToOrderLeadDays: number | null; outOfStockExchange: OutOfStockExchange } | null;
  progress: { restocked: number; notRestocked: number; pendingInspection: number; sentBack: number; missing: number;
              processed: number; unprocessed: number; exchanged: number; refundCovered: number; refundWaived: number; refundWaiting: number };
  refundAmountsByCount: number[];   // 今から k 点を返金した時の、その注文の商品の額（添字 k−1、長さはこの返品でその注文の商品を指す行の未処理の数の合計。同じ注文の商品の行は同じ列。DB の受け取りが注文の商品ごとに数を足して1回で額を出すのに合わせる）。交換の予定の行も入れる（受け取りで「返金に変える」時の見込みに使う）。受付中でない返品は []
  refundWaitingAmount: number;      // rw の品の商品の額（額を決めて返金の見込み）
};
export type OrderReturnDetail = {
  id: string; number: number; label: string; status: ReturnStatus; source: 'customer_request' | 'shop';
  displayStatus: ReturnDisplayStatus | null; marks: ReturnMark[];
  returnMethod: ReturnMethod; returnShippingPayer: ShippingPayer; returnCarrier: ReturnCarrier | null; returnTrackingNumber: string | null;
  fees: { returnShippingFee: number; restockingFeePercent: number; exchangeFee: number; exchangeShippingFee: number;
          feeDueAmount: number; feePendingDeduction: number; feeReceivedAt: string | null; exchangeReleasedAt: string | null };
  firstReceiptDone: boolean; firstExchangeReceiptDone: boolean;
  shopNote: string | null; notifyCustomer: boolean; createdAt: string; createdByEmail: string | null;
  closedAt: string | null; cancelledAt: string | null;
  lines: OrderReturnLineDetail[];
  refunds: Array<{ id: string; amount: number; status: OrderRefundStatus; createdAt: string }>;
  receipts: Array<{ id: string; kind: 'receive' | 'inspect' | 'close_missing' | 'reopen' | 'waive_refund'; refundChoice: RefundChoice | null;
                    createdAt: string; actorEmail: string | null }>;
  exchangeItems: Array<{ orderItemId: string; itemName: string; color: string | null; size: string | null; quantity: number;
                         fulfillmentType: 'stock' | 'backorder'; shipped: number }>;
};
export type OrderReturnSummary = {
  orderId: string; displayStatus: ReturnDisplayStatus | null; marks: ReturnMark[]; nextAction: ReturnNextAction;
  hasReturnable: boolean; refundWaitingReturns: number; requestedReturns: number;
};

/**
 * 設定の窓口（PUT /api/admin/settings/shop の returns）へ送る返品の設定。段1の画面（ショップの設定の「返品」の欄。P14）が出す欄だけで、
 * キーは ShopReturnSettings と同じ。段2の欄（申し込み・種類・注意書き・理由ごとの出す／ご希望／写真と案内の文）は含めない。
 * windowDays の null は無制限、returnAddress の null は4つとも空に戻す。reasons は理由ごとの行（返送料の負担と在庫の無い交換）
 */
export type ShopReturnSettingsUpdate = {
  returnAddress: ShopReturnSettings['returnAddress'];
  customerPaidMethod: ShopReturnSettings['customerPaidMethod'];
  shopLabelFee: number;
  noReturnNeededEnabled: boolean;
  windowDays: number | null;
  windowStart: ShopReturnSettings['windowStart'];
  deliveryBufferDays: number;
  reasons: Array<{ reason: ReturnReason; shippingPayer: ShippingPayer; outOfStockExchange: OutOfStockExchange }>;
  restockingFeeEnabled: boolean;
  restockingFeePercent: number;
  exchangeFeesEnabled: boolean;
  exchangeFee: number;
  exchangeShippingFee: number;
  inspectionEnabled: boolean;
};
```

```ts
import { toOrderNumber } from '@/lib/orders/order-number';
import type {
  ReceiptDisposition,
  ReturnCarrier,
  ReturnDisplayStatus,
  ReturnErrorCode,
  ReturnMark,
  ReturnReason,
} from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

/**
 * 返品の窓口の誤りの言葉と HTTP、一覧や画面に出す言葉（グループ E-3 設計書 4-10・8 章。共通の約束 C-4・C-5）。
 * 窓口と画面の両方が使うので、サーバーだけの物を import しない。画面に出す言葉は、ここの1か所だけで持つ。
 * E-2 の返金の誤り（AWAITING_REFUND_EXISTS など）の言葉と HTTP は、E-2 の REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES をそのまま使う（共通の約束 C-4 の末尾）。
 */
export const RETURN_ERROR_MESSAGES = {
  RETURN_NOT_FOUND: { status: 404, message: '返品が見つかりません。' },

  RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT: { status: 409, message: '返品の状態が変わりました。画面を開き直してください。' },
  RETURN_RECEIPT_EXCEEDS: { status: 409, message: '受け取る数が、残りの数を超えています。画面を開き直してください。' },
  RETURN_EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK: { status: 409, message: '交換の品の在庫が足りません。「作って送る」か「返金に変える」を選んでください。' },
  RETURN_FORBIDDEN: { status: 403, message: 'この操作は店長だけができます。' },
  RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH: { status: 409, message: '同じ操作の番号で、違う内容が送られました。画面を開き直してください。' },
  RETURN_REASON_NOTE_REQUIRED: { status: 400, message: '理由が「その他」の時は、理由のメモを入れてください。' },
  RETURN_SENT_BACK_MESSAGE_REQUIRED: { status: 400, message: 'お返しする時は、お客様へのメッセージを入れてください。' },
  RETURN_FEE_INVALID: { status: 400, message: '手数料の額を確かめてください。' },
  RETURN_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID: { status: 400, message: '返金額は、返せる額までにしてください。' },
  RETURN_NOTHING_TO_REFUND: { status: 409, message: '返金する品がありません。画面を開き直してください。' },
  FULFILLMENT_HAS_RETURN: { status: 409, message: '返品のある発送は取り消せません。' },
  FULFILLMENT_EXCHANGE_ON_HOLD: { status: 409, message: '手数料のお支払いを待っている交換の品は送れません。' },
  ORDER_NOT_RETURNABLE: { status: 409, message: 'この注文は返品を作れません。' },
} as const satisfies Record<ReturnErrorCode, { status: 400 | 403 | 404 | 409; message: string }>;

export const RETURN_DISPLAY_STATUS_LABELS: Record<ReturnDisplayStatus, string> = {

};

export const RETURN_CARRIER_LABELS: Record<ReturnCarrier, string> = {
  yamato: 'ヤマト運輸',

  japanpost: '日本郵便',

};

/** 受け取りの画面の、品ごとの状態の選び方 */
export const DISPOSITION_LABELS: Record<ReceiptDisposition, string> = {
  restocked: '在庫に戻す',
  not_restocked: '戻さない',
  pending_inspection: '検品待ち',

};

/** 返品の番号（画面・メール・履歴で同じ書き方）。例: ORD-A1B2C3D4-R1。DB は番号の文字を作らない */
export function formatReturnNumber(orderId: string, number: number): string {
  return `${toOrderNumber(orderId)}-R${number}`;
}
```

`tests/unit/lib/orders/returns/return-calc.test.ts`:

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { refundLineAmount } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-allocation';
import { buildReceiveButtonLabel, computeReturnRefundPreview, formatDeadline } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-calc';

type PreviewInput = Parameters<typeof computeReturnRefundPreview>[0];

// 返品の返金の額の試験の値。E-2 の割り振りの値 A（tests/integration/db/order_refund_records.integration.test.ts の「値 A」と同じ）に合わせる:
// 商品 X は 3000 円 × 2（割引 667）、商品 Y は 1000 円 × 3（割引 333）。DB は返品の行ごとに、その行が指す注文の商品の
// 「今から k 点を返金した時の商品の額」の列を返す（同じ注文の商品を指す行は同じ列）。orderItemId の X・Y はその商品、Z は額の列が空の行
// （受付中でない返品など）が指す商品
const X_AMOUNTS = [2666, 5333];
const Y_AMOUNTS = [889, 1778, 2667];

function previewInput(overrides: Partial<PreviewInput> = {}): PreviewInput {
  return {
    lines: [{ orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 1 }],
    firstReceipt: true,
    hasExchangeInThisReceipt: false,
    firstExchangeReceipt: true,
    returnMethod: 'customer_ships',
    returnShippingFee: 0,
    restockingFeePercent: 0,
    exchangeFee: 0,
    exchangeShippingFee: 0,
    shippingRefund: 0,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const NO_FEES = { returnShipping: 0, restocking: 0, exchange: 0, exchangeShipping: 0 };

describe('computeReturnRefundPreview（商品の額）', () => {
  it('商品の額の列は E-2 の割り振り（refundLineAmount）の値と同じ。1点ずつ返しても合計が合う', () => {
    const amounts = (line: { itemPrice: number; quantity: number; lineDiscount: number }) =>
      Array.from({ length: line.quantity }, (_, index) => refundLineAmount({ ...line, refundedUnits: 0 }, index + 1));

    expect(amounts({ itemPrice: 3000, quantity: 2, lineDiscount: 667 })).toEqual(X_AMOUNTS);
    expect(amounts({ itemPrice: 1000, quantity: 3, lineDiscount: 333 })).toEqual(Y_AMOUNTS);
    // X を 1 点返した後に、残りの 1 点を返す額は 2667。2666 + 2667 は 2 点まとめて返す額 5333 と同じ
    expect(refundLineAmount({ itemPrice: 3000, quantity: 2, lineDiscount: 667, refundedUnits: 1 }, 1)).toBe(2667);
    expect(2666 + 2667).toBe(X_AMOUNTS[1]);
  });

  it('手数料も送料も無い時は、選んだ数の商品の額がそのまま返金額になる', () => {
    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput())).toEqual({ itemsAmount: 2666, fees: NO_FEES, refundAmount: 2666, feeDue: 0 });
    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ lines: [{ orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 2 }] }))).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 5333, fees: NO_FEES, refundAmount: 5333, feeDue: 0,
    });
  });

  it('返品の行が複数ある時は、注文の商品ごとの額を足す。数が0の行は数えない', () => {
    const lines = [
      { orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 2 },
      { orderItemId: 'Y', refundAmountsByCount: Y_AMOUNTS, count: 1 },
      { orderItemId: 'Y', refundAmountsByCount: Y_AMOUNTS, count: 0 },
    ];

    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ lines })).itemsAmount).toBe(5333 + 889);
  });

  it('同じ注文の商品の行が2つある（2回に分けて送った品など）時は、数を足してから列を引く。行ごとに足すと割引の端数で 5332 になる', () => {
    const lines = [
      { orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 1 },
      { orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 1 },
    ];

    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ lines })).itemsAmount).toBe(5333);
  });

  it('選んだ数が無ければ、商品の額も返金額も0。送料の返金だけが返金額に入る', () => {
    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ lines: [], shippingRefund: 500 }))).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 0, fees: NO_FEES, refundAmount: 500, feeDue: 0,
    });
  });

  it('送料の返金は、商品の額から手数料を引いた後に足す（手数料では減らない）', () => {
    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ shippingRefund: 500 }))).toMatchObject({ itemsAmount: 2666, refundAmount: 3166 });
    expect(
      computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ restockingFeePercent: 10, shippingRefund: 500 })),
    ).toMatchObject({ itemsAmount: 2666, refundAmount: 2400 + 500 });
  });

  it('数が1に満たない・整数でない行は数えない。列より多く指した数は、列の最後（返せる最大）で数える。列が空の行（受付中でない返品など）は額に入らない', () => {
    const preview = (count: number, amounts = X_AMOUNTS) =>
      computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ lines: [{ orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: amounts, count }] })).itemsAmount;

    expect(preview(0)).toBe(0);
    expect(preview(-1)).toBe(0);
    expect(preview(1.5)).toBe(0);
    expect(preview(Number.NaN)).toBe(0);
    expect(preview(5)).toBe(5333);
    expect(preview(2, [])).toBe(0);
  });

  it('受け取りで「返金に変える」にした交換の行は、DB が交換の予定の行にも返す額の列と数を渡せば、返金の行と同じに額へ入る', () => {
    const refundLine = { orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 1 };
    const changedToRefund = { orderItemId: 'Y', refundAmountsByCount: Y_AMOUNTS, count: 2 };

    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ lines: [refundLine, changedToRefund] })).itemsAmount).toBe(2666 + 1778);
  });
});

describe('computeReturnRefundPreview（返品の手数料）', () => {
  it.each([
    // [割合, 商品の額 2666 に対する手数料 floor(2666 × 割合 / 100), 返金額]
    [10, 266, 2400],
    [33, 879, 1787],
    [1, 26, 2640],
    [100, 2666, 0],
  ])('返品の手数料 %i%% → 手数料 %i 円（端数は切り捨て）、返金額 %i 円', (percent, fee, refund) => {
    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ restockingFeePercent: percent }))).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 2666, fees: { ...NO_FEES, restocking: fee }, refundAmount: refund, feeDue: 0,
    });
  });

  it('割合は、この受け取りで返金する品の商品の額に対して付く（2点なら 5333 の 10% = 533）', () => {
    const preview = computeReturnRefundPreview(
      previewInput({ lines: [{ orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 2 }], restockingFeePercent: 10 }),
    );

    expect(preview).toMatchObject({ itemsAmount: 5333, fees: { restocking: 533 }, refundAmount: 4800, feeDue: 0 });
  });

  it('割合が0なら手数料は付かない', () => {
    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput({ restockingFeePercent: 0 })).fees.restocking).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('computeReturnRefundPreview（返送料）', () => {

    });

  it.each([

    ['返送不要の返品', { returnMethod: 'not_required', returnShippingFee: 800 }],
  ] as const)('%s には返送料を付けない', (_name, overrides) => {

      previewInput({ ...SHOP_LABEL, lines: [{ orderItemId: 'Z', refundAmountsByCount: [], count: 1 }], hasExchangeInThisReceipt: true }),
    );

describe('computeReturnRefundPreview（手数料の組み合わせ）', () => {
  it('4つの手数料が全部付く: X を2点（5333）、返送料 800・返品の手数料 10%（533）・交換の手数料 500・交換の送料 300 → 返金額 3200', () => {
    const preview = computeReturnRefundPreview(
      previewInput({
        lines: [{ orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 2 }],
        hasExchangeInThisReceipt: true,
        returnMethod: 'shop_label',
        returnShippingFee: 800,
        restockingFeePercent: 10,
        exchangeFee: 500,
        exchangeShippingFee: 300,
      }),
    );

    expect(preview).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 5333,
      fees: { returnShipping: 800, restocking: 533, exchange: 500, exchangeShipping: 300 },
      refundAmount: 3200,
      feeDue: 0,
    });
  });

  it('手数料が商品の額を超える: Y を1点（889）、返送料 800・返品の手数料 20%（177）→ 返金額は0、引けない 88 円は feeDue', () => {
    const preview = computeReturnRefundPreview(
      previewInput({
        lines: [{ orderItemId: 'Y', refundAmountsByCount: Y_AMOUNTS, count: 1 }],
        returnMethod: 'shop_label',
        returnShippingFee: 800,
        restockingFeePercent: 20,
      }),
    );

    expect(preview).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 889, fees: { ...NO_FEES, returnShipping: 800, restocking: 177 }, refundAmount: 0, feeDue: 88,
    });
  });

  it('手数料が商品の額を超えても、送料の返金は返金額に残る（返金額 = 0 + 500）', () => {
    const preview = computeReturnRefundPreview(
      previewInput({
        lines: [{ orderItemId: 'Y', refundAmountsByCount: Y_AMOUNTS, count: 1 }],
        returnMethod: 'shop_label',
        returnShippingFee: 800,
        restockingFeePercent: 20,
        shippingRefund: 500,
      }),
    );

    expect(preview).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 500, feeDue: 88 });
  });

  it('SQL と同じ値の例（Task 3 の DB 結合テストが、同じ入力で同じ額を確かめる）', () => {
    // R1 手数料なし: X を1点 → 2666
    expect(computeReturnRefundPreview(previewInput())).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 2666, feeDue: 0 });
    // R2 返送料 800（最初の受け取り）と返品の手数料 10%: X を2点 → 5333 − (800 + 533) = 4000
    expect(
      computeReturnRefundPreview(
        previewInput({
          lines: [{ orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count: 2 }],
          returnMethod: 'shop_label',
          returnShippingFee: 800,
          restockingFeePercent: 10,
        }),
      ),
    ).toMatchObject({ itemsAmount: 5333, refundAmount: 4000, feeDue: 0 });
    // R3 交換だけ（返送料 800・交換の手数料 500・交換の送料 300）→ 返金なし、お支払い待ち 1600
    expect(
      computeReturnRefundPreview(
        previewInput({
          lines: [],
          hasExchangeInThisReceipt: true,
          returnMethod: 'shop_label',
          returnShippingFee: 800,
          exchangeFee: 500,
          exchangeShippingFee: 300,
        }),
      ),
    ).toMatchObject({ itemsAmount: 0, refundAmount: 0, feeDue: 1600 });
    // R4 手数料が商品の額を超える: Y を1点（889）、返送料 800 と 20%（177）→ 返金なし、お支払い待ち 88
    expect(
      computeReturnRefundPreview(
        previewInput({
          lines: [{ orderItemId: 'Y', refundAmountsByCount: Y_AMOUNTS, count: 1 }],
          returnMethod: 'shop_label',
          returnShippingFee: 800,
          restockingFeePercent: 20,
        }),
      ),
    ).toMatchObject({ itemsAmount: 889, refundAmount: 0, feeDue: 88 });
  });

  it('どの組み合わせでも: 返金額（送料を除く）− feeDue = 商品の額 − 手数料の合計。返金額と feeDue は同時に正にならない', () => {
    for (const count of [0, 1, 2]) {
      for (const percent of [0, 10, 100]) {
        for (const returnShippingFee of [0, 800, 5000]) {
          for (const hasExchangeInThisReceipt of [false, true]) {
            const input = previewInput({
              lines: [{ orderItemId: 'X', refundAmountsByCount: X_AMOUNTS, count }],
              hasExchangeInThisReceipt,
              returnMethod: 'shop_label',
              returnShippingFee,
              restockingFeePercent: percent,
              exchangeFee: 500,
              exchangeShippingFee: 300,
              shippingRefund: 200,
            });

            const { itemsAmount, fees, refundAmount, feeDue } = computeReturnRefundPreview(input);
            const feesTotal = fees.returnShipping + fees.restocking + fees.exchange + fees.exchangeShipping;

            expect(refundAmount - input.shippingRefund - feeDue).toBe(itemsAmount - feesTotal);
            expect(refundAmount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(input.shippingRefund);
            expect(feeDue).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
            expect((refundAmount - input.shippingRefund) * feeDue).toBe(0);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });
});

describe('buildReceiveButtonLabel（受け取りの確定のボタンの言葉）', () => {
  function label(overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof buildReceiveButtonLabel>[0]> = {}): string {
    return buildReceiveButtonLabel({
      checked: 1,
      remaining: 1,
      refundUnits: 1,
      exchangeUnits: 0,
      sentBackUnits: 0,
      refundChoice: 'now',
      refundAmount: 2666,
      actorCanRefund: true,
      ...overrides,
    });
  }

  it('返金の品があり今返金（額が0より大きい）: 残りを全部受け取るなら「すべて受け取って ￥{額} を返金する」', () => {
    expect(label()).toBe('すべて受け取って ￥2,666 を返金する');
  });

  it('返金の品があり今返金: 一部だけなら「{n}点を受け取って ￥{額} を返金する」', () => {
    expect(label({ checked: 1, remaining: 2 })).toBe('1点を受け取って ￥2,666 を返金する');
    expect(label({ checked: 2, remaining: 3, refundUnits: 2, refundAmount: 5333 })).toBe('2点を受け取って ￥5,333 を返金する');
  });

  it('返金の品があり今返金: 交換の品があれば、尾に「、交換の品を発送待ちにする」を足す', () => {
    expect(label({ exchangeUnits: 1, checked: 2, remaining: 2 })).toBe(
      'すべて受け取って ￥2,666 を返金する、交換の品を発送待ちにする',
    );
    expect(label({ exchangeUnits: 1, checked: 2, remaining: 3, refundAmount: 5333 })).toBe(
      '2点を受け取って ￥5,333 を返金する、交換の品を発送待ちにする',
    );
  });

  it('返金の品があり相談: 店長は「受け取りだけ記録する（返金は額を決めてから）」、サポートは「（額は店長が決める）」。点数や交換の有無で変わらない', () => {
    const admin = '受け取りだけ記録する（返金は額を決めてから）';
    const supporter = '受け取りだけ記録する（額は店長が決める）';

    expect(label({ refundChoice: 'consult' })).toBe(admin);
    expect(label({ refundChoice: 'consult', checked: 1, remaining: 3, exchangeUnits: 1 })).toBe(admin);
    expect(label({ refundChoice: 'consult', actorCanRefund: false })).toBe(supporter);
    expect(label({ refundChoice: 'consult', actorCanRefund: false, checked: 1, remaining: 3, sentBackUnits: 1 })).toBe(supporter);
  });

  it('返金の品が無く交換の品がある: 「すべて受け取り、交換の品を発送待ちにする」「{n}点を受け取り、交換の品を発送待ちにする」', () => {
    const exchangeOnly = { refundUnits: 0, exchangeUnits: 1, refundChoice: 'none', refundAmount: 0 } as const;

    expect(label({ ...exchangeOnly, checked: 1, remaining: 1 })).toBe('すべて受け取り、交換の品を発送待ちにする');
    expect(label({ ...exchangeOnly, checked: 2, remaining: 3, exchangeUnits: 2 })).toBe('2点を受け取り、交換の品を発送待ちにする');
  });

  it('お返しだけ: 「すべて受け取り、品物をお返しする」「{n}点を受け取り、品物をお返しする」', () => {
    const sentBackOnly = { refundUnits: 0, sentBackUnits: 1, refundChoice: 'none', refundAmount: 0 } as const;

    expect(label({ ...sentBackOnly, checked: 1, remaining: 1 })).toBe('すべて受け取り、品物をお返しする');
    expect(label({ ...sentBackOnly, checked: 1, remaining: 2 })).toBe('1点を受け取り、品物をお返しする');
  });

  it('交換の品とお返しが両方ある（返金の品は無い）時は、交換の言葉を使う', () => {
    expect(label({ refundUnits: 0, exchangeUnits: 1, sentBackUnits: 1, refundChoice: 'none', refundAmount: 0, checked: 2, remaining: 2 })).toBe(
      'すべて受け取り、交換の品を発送待ちにする',
    );
  });

  it('返金の品があり今返金でも、返金額が0円（手数料が商品の額以上、または額を0に直した）なら「返金なしで記録する」。返金の記録は作らない（P20）', () => {
    expect(label({ refundAmount: 0 })).toBe('すべて受け取り、返金なしで記録する');
    expect(label({ refundAmount: 0, checked: 1, remaining: 2 })).toBe('1点を受け取り、返金なしで記録する');
    expect(label({ refundAmount: 0, checked: 2, remaining: 3, refundUnits: 2 })).toBe('2点を受け取り、返金なしで記録する');
  });

  it('返金なしで記録する時も、交換の品があれば、尾に「、交換の品を発送待ちにする」を足す。お返しは言葉に出さない', () => {
    expect(label({ refundAmount: 0, exchangeUnits: 1, checked: 2, remaining: 2 })).toBe(
      'すべて受け取り、返金なしで記録する、交換の品を発送待ちにする',
    );
    expect(label({ refundAmount: 0, exchangeUnits: 1, checked: 2, remaining: 3 })).toBe(
      '2点を受け取り、返金なしで記録する、交換の品を発送待ちにする',
    );
    expect(label({ refundAmount: 0, sentBackUnits: 1, checked: 2, remaining: 3 })).toBe('2点を受け取り、返金なしで記録する');
  });

  it('返金額が0円でも、相談（consult）の言葉は変わらない。返金の記録を作るのは今返金だけ', () => {
    expect(label({ refundChoice: 'consult', refundAmount: 0 })).toBe('受け取りだけ記録する（返金は額を決めてから）');
  });

  it('それ以外（返金の品が無く、交換もお返しも無い）は「{n}点を受け取る」', () => {
    expect(label({ refundUnits: 0, refundChoice: 'none', refundAmount: 0, checked: 3, remaining: 3 })).toBe('3点を受け取る');
    // 返金の品が無いのに今返金が渡された（画面ではあり得ない）時は、返金の言葉を出さない
    expect(label({ refundUnits: 0, refundChoice: 'now', refundAmount: 2666, checked: 1, remaining: 2 })).toBe('1点を受け取る');
  });

  it('チェックした点数が残りの数以上なら「すべて」（残りより多く渡されても「すべて」）', () => {
    expect(label({ checked: 3, remaining: 2 })).toBe('すべて受け取って ￥2,666 を返金する');
  });
});
```

Expected: FAIL（`Cannot find module '@/lib/orders/returns/return-calc'`）

- [ ] **Step 5: 返金の見込み・ボタンの言葉・期限の書き方を書く**

`src/lib/orders/returns/return-calc.ts`:

```ts
import { formatYen } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-messages';
import type { RefundChoice, ReturnMethod } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

/**
 * 受け取りの画面の返金の見込みとボタンの言葉、受付の期限の日付の書き方（グループ E-3 設計書 4-9・6-1・6-3・6-4。共通の約束 C-5）。
 * 画面からも読むので、サーバーだけの物を import しない。
 * 記録する額は DB の関数 admin_receive_return が同じ式で出す（SQL が正。TS は見込みだけ）。商品の額は E-2 の割り振りで
 * DB が出し、返品の行が指す注文の商品ごとの「今から k 点を返金した時の額」（refundAmountsByCount。同じ注文の商品の行は同じ列）として
 * 画面に渡る。ここでは割り振らず、同じ注文の商品の行の数を足して列を引くだけ。
 */

/**
 * 注文の商品ごとの、今回返金する品の商品の額（商品ごとに1要素の配列。返金の品が無ければ空）。DB の admin_receive_return は注文の商品ごとに
 * 今回の数を足してから private.return_units_amount で1回で額を出すので、同じ注文の商品の行は数を足してから列を引く
 * （行ごとに引いて足すと、割引の端数で1円ずれうる。E-2 の estimateRefund と同じ考え）。列は DB が同じ注文の商品の行に同じ物を返す。
 * count が 1 に満たない・整数でない行と、列が空の行（受付中でない返品など）は数えない。列より多く指しても、列の最後（返せる最大）で数える
 */
function itemsAmountsOf(
  lines: ReadonlyArray<{ orderItemId: string; refundAmountsByCount: number[]; count: number }>,
): number[] {
  const byItem = new Map<string, { amounts: number[]; count: number }>();
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(line.count) || line.count < 1 || line.refundAmountsByCount.length === 0) {
      continue;
    }
    const entry = byItem.get(line.orderItemId) ?? { amounts: line.refundAmountsByCount, count: 0 };
    entry.count += line.count;
    byItem.set(line.orderItemId, entry);
  }
  return [...byItem.values()].map((entry) => entry.amounts[Math.min(entry.count, entry.amounts.length) - 1]);
}

/**
 * 受け取りで返金する額の見込み。式は共通の約束 Global Constraints「返品の返金の額」のとおり:
 * 返品の手数料 = floor(商品の額 × % / 100)、返送料（お店の送り状）は返金の品か交換の品がある最初の受け取りだけ、
 * 交換の手数料と送料は交換の品のある最初の受け取りだけ。返金額 = max(商品の額 − 手数料の合計, 0) + 送料の返金、
 * 引けなかった手数料 = max(手数料の合計 − 商品の額, 0)（お支払い待ちの額 fee_due_amount に足される）。
 * lines は今回返金する返品の行ごとの orderItemId（行が指す注文の商品）・数 count・その行の refundAmountsByCount。
 * 同じ orderItemId の行は count を足してから列を引く（itemsAmountsOf）。返金の品の行と、受け取りで「返金に変える」にした交換の行
 * （DB は交換の予定の行にも額の列を返す）だけを呼ぶ側が入れる。count が 0 の行と、額の列が [] の行（受付中でない返品）は額にも返金の品にも入らない。
 * firstReceipt は、返金か交換の品を受け取った受け取り（receive）がまだ無いか（OrderReturnDetail.firstReceiptDone の反対。
 * お返しだけの受け取りは数えない）、hasExchangeInThisReceipt はこの受け取りに交換の品があるか、
 * firstExchangeReceipt は交換の品のある最初の受け取りか、shippingRefund は店長が入れる送料の返金。
 */
export function computeReturnRefundPreview(input: {
  lines: Array<{ orderItemId: string; refundAmountsByCount: number[]; count: number }>;
  firstReceipt: boolean;
  hasExchangeInThisReceipt: boolean;
  firstExchangeReceipt: boolean;
  returnMethod: ReturnMethod;
  returnShippingFee: number;
  restockingFeePercent: number;
  exchangeFee: number;
  exchangeShippingFee: number;
  shippingRefund: number;
}): {
  itemsAmount: number;
  fees: { returnShipping: number; restocking: number; exchange: number; exchangeShipping: number };
  refundAmount: number;
  feeDue: number;
} {
  const amounts = itemsAmountsOf(input.lines);
  const itemsAmount = amounts.reduce((total, amount) => total + amount, 0);
  const hasRefundItems = amounts.length > 0;

  const hasExchangeFees = input.hasExchangeInThisReceipt && input.firstExchangeReceipt;
  const fees = {
    returnShipping:
      input.returnMethod === 'shop_label' && input.firstReceipt && (hasRefundItems || input.hasExchangeInThisReceipt)
        ? input.returnShippingFee
        : 0,
    restocking: Math.floor((itemsAmount * input.restockingFeePercent) / 100),
    exchange: hasExchangeFees ? input.exchangeFee : 0,
    exchangeShipping: hasExchangeFees ? input.exchangeShippingFee : 0,
  };
  const feesTotal = fees.returnShipping + fees.restocking + fees.exchange + fees.exchangeShipping;

  return {
    itemsAmount,
    fees,
    refundAmount: Math.max(itemsAmount - feesTotal, 0) + input.shippingRefund,
    feeDue: Math.max(feesTotal - itemsAmount, 0),
  };
}

/**
 * 受け取りの画面の確定のボタンの言葉（共通の約束 C-5「受け取りのボタンの言葉」）。
 * checked は今回チェックした点数、remaining は返品の未処理の残りの点数（checked が残り全部ならすべて受け取る）、
 * refundUnits・exchangeUnits・sentBackUnits は今回の点のうち、返金の品・交換の品・お返しの数。
 * 返金の品があり今返金を選んだ時に、返金額 refundAmount が 0 円なら（手数料が商品の額以上、または額を0に直した。P20）、
 * 返金の記録を作らないので「返金なしで記録する」と書く。
 */
export function buildReceiveButtonLabel(input: {
  checked: number;
  remaining: number;
  refundUnits: number;
  exchangeUnits: number;
  sentBackUnits: number;
  refundChoice: RefundChoice;
  refundAmount: number;
  actorCanRefund: boolean;
}): string {
  const receivesAll = input.checked >= input.remaining;
  const received = receivesAll ? 'すべて受け取り' : `${input.checked}点を受け取り`;
  const exchangeTail = input.exchangeUnits > 0 ? '、交換の品を発送待ちにする' : '';

  if (input.refundUnits > 0 && input.refundChoice === 'consult') {
    return input.actorCanRefund ? '受け取りだけ記録する（返金は額を決めてから）' : '受け取りだけ記録する（額は店長が決める）';
  }
  if (input.refundUnits > 0 && input.refundChoice === 'now') {
    if (input.refundAmount > 0) {
      const head = receivesAll ? 'すべて受け取って ' : `${input.checked}点を受け取って `;
      return `${head}${formatYen(input.refundAmount)} を返金する${exchangeTail}`;
    }
    return `${received}、返金なしで記録する${exchangeTail}`;
  }
  if (input.exchangeUnits > 0) {
    return `${received}、交換の品を発送待ちにする`;
  }
  if (input.sentBackUnits > 0) {
    return `${received}、品物をお返しする`;
  }
  return `${input.checked}点を受け取る`;
}

/**
 * 受付の期限の日付の書き方（M月D日。0詰めなし）。DB が日本時間の日付 YYYY-MM-DD で返す物を読む。
 * 期限の文（`受付の期限: M月D日まで`・`期限を過ぎています（M月D日まで）`・`受付の期限: なし`）は、呼ぶ側（作る画面）が組む。
 * 期限が無い（無制限）時は「なし」を返す。YYYY-MM-DD に読めない文字は、そのまま返す。
 */
export function formatDeadline(date: string | null): string {
  if (date === null) {
    return 'なし';
  }
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(date);
  return match ? `${Number(match[2])}月${Number(match[3])}日` : date;
}
```

```ts
type RpcAnswer = { data?: unknown; error?: { message?: string; code?: string } | null };

/** rpc だけを持つ入れ物。関数の名前ごとに答えを決める。決めていない関数は空の行を返す（null を決めた時は null のまま返す） */
function storeWith(answers: Record<string, RpcAnswer>) {
  const rpc = jest.fn(async (...call: [name: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>]) => {
    const answer = answers[call[0]];
    return { data: answer && 'data' in answer ? answer.data : [], error: answer?.error ?? null };
  });
  return { store: { rpc } as unknown as ReturnStore, rpc };
}

/** 版の頭の数字は本番に当てる時に付け替わるので、移行のファイルは名前の後ろで探す */
function migrationText(suffix: string): string {
  const directory = path.join(process.cwd(), 'supabase/migrations');
  const files = fs.readdirSync(directory).filter((name) => name.endsWith(suffix));
  expect(files).toHaveLength(1);
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(directory, files[0]), 'utf8');
}

const MIGRATION_SUFFIXES = ['_order_return_records.sql', '_order_return_actions.sql', '_order_return_receipts.sql'];

/** 移行 A・B・C の本文をつないだ物 */
function returnMigrationsText(): string {
  return MIGRATION_SUFFIXES.map(migrationText).join('\n');
}

/** CREATE FUNCTION public.{name}( … ) の引数の名前。DEFAULT のある引数は省略できる物として返す */
function declaredParams(sql: string, name: string): Array<{ name: string; optional: boolean }> {
  // SQL のコメント（-- から行末まで）は、括弧や引用符を含みうるので、先に捨てる
  const text = sql.replace(/--.*$/gm, '');
  const head = new RegExp(`CREATE\\s+(?:OR\\s+REPLACE\\s+)?FUNCTION\\s+public\\.${name}\\s*\\(`).exec(text);
  expect(head).not.toBeNull();

  // 対応する ) までを、括弧・角括弧・引用符の外のカンマで引数に分ける
  const pieces: string[] = [];
  let current = '';
  let depth = 1;
  let quoted = false;
  for (let index = (head?.index ?? 0) + (head?.[0].length ?? 0); index < text.length; index += 1) {
    const char = text[index];
    if (char === "'") quoted = !quoted;
    if (!quoted && (char === '(' || char === '[')) depth += 1;
    if (!quoted && (char === ')' || char === ']')) depth -= 1;
    if (depth === 0) break;
    if (!quoted && depth === 1 && char === ',') {
      pieces.push(current);
      current = '';
    } else {
      current += char;
    }
  }
  pieces.push(current);

  return pieces
    .map((piece) => piece.trim())
    .filter((piece) => piece !== '')
    .map((piece) => ({ name: piece.split(/\s+/)[0], optional: /\bDEFAULT\b/i.test(piece) }));
}

/** DB が word で断った時に、run が ReturnStoreError（記号 code）で止まること */
async function expectRefusal(
  rpcName: string,
  word: string,
  code: string,
  run: (store: ReturnStore) => Promise<unknown>,
): Promise<void> {
  const { store } = storeWith({ [rpcName]: { error: { message: word, code: 'P0001' } } });

  const error = await run(store).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);

  expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ReturnStoreError);
  expect(error).not.toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);
  expect(error).toMatchObject({ code });
}

describe('toReturnErrorCode', () => {
  it.each(RETURN_ERROR_CODES)('返品の言葉 %s は、同じ綴りの記号', (code) => {
    expect(toReturnErrorCode(code)).toBe(code);
    // PostgREST は言葉の前後に別の文を足すことがある
    expect(toReturnErrorCode(`error: ${code} (detail)`)).toBe(code);
  });

  it.each(REFUND_DB_WORDS)('E-2 の言葉 %s は、E-2 の記号 %s のまま渡す', (word, code) => {
    expect(toReturnErrorCode(word)).toBe(code);
    expect(toReturnErrorCode(`error: ${word} (detail)`)).toBe(code);
  });

  it('注文の番号を200件より多く渡した断り（TOO_MANY_ORDERS）は、C-4 にも E-2 にも記号が無いので RETURN_ARGUMENT_INVALID', () => {
    expect(toReturnErrorCode('TOO_MANY_ORDERS')).toBe('RETURN_ARGUMENT_INVALID');
    expect(toReturnErrorCode('error: TOO_MANY_ORDERS (detail)')).toBe('RETURN_ARGUMENT_INVALID');
  });

  it('どの言葉も、別の言葉の一部になっていない（部分一致で記号を決めるため。綴りが足されて重なると、記号を取り違える）', () => {
    const words: string[] = [...RETURN_ERROR_CODES, 'TOO_MANY_ORDERS', ...REFUND_DB_WORDS.map(([word]) => word)];
    const overlaps = words.flatMap((word) =>
      words.filter((other) => other !== word && other.includes(word)).map((other) => `${word} は ${other} の一部`),
    );

    expect(overlaps).toEqual([]);

  it('返品の言葉と E-2 の言葉が両方入った文は、返品の言葉の記号になる', () => {
    expect(toReturnErrorCode('RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT / ORDER_NOT_FOUND')).toBe('RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT');
    expect(toReturnErrorCode('ORDER_NOT_FOUND / RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT')).toBe('RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT');

    expect(toReturnErrorCode('RETURN_UNKNOWN_WORD')).toBeNull();
    expect(toReturnErrorCode('connection refused')).toBeNull();
    expect(toReturnErrorCode('')).toBeNull();
    expect(toReturnErrorCode(undefined)).toBeNull();

    const sql = returnMigrationsText();

    for (const code of RETURN_ERROR_CODES) {
      expect(sql).toContain(code);
    }
  });

  it('返品の言葉のほかに store が記号に直す DB の言葉（TOO_MANY_ORDERS・ORDER_NOT_FOUND・SETTINGS_ARGUMENT_INVALID）も、移行の本文にある', () => {
    const sql = returnMigrationsText();

    for (const word of ['TOO_MANY_ORDERS', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 'SETTINGS_ARGUMENT_INVALID']) {
      expect(sql).toContain(word);
    }
  });

  it('TS が呼ぶ DB の関数は、移行の本文にある（名前が食い違うと、呼んだ時に初めて分かる）', () => {
    const sql = returnMigrationsText();

    for (const [rpcName] of CALLS) {
      expect(sql).toMatch(new RegExp(`CREATE\\s+(?:OR\\s+REPLACE\\s+)?FUNCTION\\s+public\\.${rpcName}\\s*\\(`));
    }
  });

  it.each(CALLS)('%s に渡す引数の名前は、移行の関数の引数と一字も違わない（食い違うと PostgREST が関数を見つけられない）', async (rpcName, run) => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({});

    await run(store).catch(() => undefined);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const [calledName, args] = rpc.mock.calls[0];
    expect(calledName).toBe(rpcName);
    const declared = declaredParams(returnMigrationsText(), rpcName);
    const passed = Object.keys(args ?? {});
    // 渡した引数が関数に無い、または、省略できない引数を渡していない
    expect(passed.filter((name) => !declared.some((param) => param.name === name))).toEqual([]);
    expect(declared.filter((param) => !param.optional && !passed.includes(param.name)).map((param) => param.name)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('手数料の受け取りの記録の関数は、C-1 のとおり引数に _waive（いただかないで終える）を持つ。P27', () => {
    const declared = declaredParams(returnMigrationsText(), 'admin_record_return_fee_payment');

    expect(declared.map((param) => param.name).sort()).toEqual(['_actor_id', '_note', '_return_id', '_waive']);
  });
});

describe.each(CALLS)('%s の失敗', (rpcName, run) => {
  const dbError = { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' };

  it('記号の無い DB の失敗は RefundStoreError（DB の文はメッセージに入れず、cause にだけ残す）', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ [rpcName]: { error: dbError } });

    const error = (await run(store).catch((caught: unknown) => caught)) as RefundStoreError;

    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);
    expect(error).not.toBeInstanceOf(ReturnStoreError);
    expect(error.message).toBe(`refund store failed: ${rpcName}`);
    expect(error.operation).toBe(rpcName);
    expect(error.code).toBe('08006');
    expect(error.cause).toEqual(dbError);
  });

  it('DB が返品の言葉で断れば、同じ綴りの記号を持つ ReturnStoreError', async () => {
    await expectRefusal(rpcName, 'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT', 'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT', run);
  });

  it('DB が E-2 の言葉で断れば、E-2 の記号のまま ReturnStoreError に載せる（RefundOperationError にしない）', async () => {
    await expectRefusal(rpcName, 'AWAITING_REFUND_EXISTS', 'awaiting_refund_exists', run);
  });
});

describe('行が返らない時', () => {
  it.each(CALLS.filter(([rpcName]) => ROW_REQUIRED_RPCS.includes(rpcName)))('%s は RefundStoreError', async (rpcName, run) => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ [rpcName]: { data: [] } });

    const error = await run(store).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);

    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ operation: rpcName });
  });
});

describe('receiveReturn', () => {
  const RECEIVED_ROW = {
    receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID, return_status: 'open', refund_id: REFUND_ID, refund_amount: 2400, refund_status: 'awaiting_response',
    exchange_order_item_ids: [EXCHANGE_ITEM_ID], fee_due_amount: 0, shop_notice_enqueued: false, replayed: false,
  };

  it('DB の関数の引数名のとおりに渡し、1行の答えを窓口の形に直す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ admin_receive_return: { data: [RECEIVED_ROW] } });

    await expect(receiveReturn(store, RECEIVE_INPUT)).resolves.toEqual({
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      returnStatus: 'open',
      refundId: REFUND_ID,
      refundAmount: 2400,
      refundStatus: 'awaiting_response',
      exchangeOrderItemIds: [EXCHANGE_ITEM_ID],
      feeDueAmount: 0,
      shopNoticeEnqueued: false,
      replayed: false,
    });

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_receive_return', {
      _return_id: RETURN_ID,
      _actor_id: ACTOR_ID,
      _actor_can_refund: true,
      _request_key: REQUEST_KEY,
      _units: [
        { return_line_id: LINE_1, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 },
        { return_line_id: LINE_2, disposition: 'sent_back', quantity: 1 },
      ],
      _exchange_overrides: [{ return_line_id: LINE_2, action: 'make' }],
      _refund_choice: 'now',
      _refund_amount: 2400,
      _refund_shipping_amount: 0,
      _note: '箱が潰れていた',
      _notify_customer: true,
      _sent_back_message: '着用の跡があるためお返しします',
      _sent_back_carrier: 'yamato',
      _sent_back_tracking_number: 'AB-9999',
    });
  });

  it('返金の無い受け取りは、返金の番号・額・状態が null、交換の品の行が無ければ空の配列。お支払い待ちの額と店への知らせを写す', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({
      admin_receive_return: {
        data: [{
          receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID, return_status: 'open', refund_id: null, refund_amount: null, refund_status: null,
          exchange_order_item_ids: null, fee_due_amount: 1600, shop_notice_enqueued: true, replayed: false,
        }],
      },
    });

    await expect(
      receiveReturn(store, { ...RECEIVE_INPUT, actorCanRefund: false, refundChoice: 'consult', refundAmount: null }),
    ).resolves.toEqual({
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      returnStatus: 'open',
      refundId: null,
      refundAmount: null,
      refundStatus: null,
      exchangeOrderItemIds: [],
      feeDueAmount: 1600,
      shopNoticeEnqueued: true,
      replayed: false,
    });
  });

  it('返金額が0円になる受け取り（手数料が商品の額以上など。P20）は、返金の番号が null・状態が waived。返金の記録は作られず、お支払い待ちの額が残る', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      admin_receive_return: {
        data: [{
          receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID, return_status: 'open', refund_id: null, refund_amount: 0, refund_status: 'waived',
          exchange_order_item_ids: [], fee_due_amount: 88, shop_notice_enqueued: false, replayed: false,
        }],
      },
    });

    await expect(receiveReturn(store, { ...RECEIVE_INPUT, refundAmount: 0 })).resolves.toEqual({
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      returnStatus: 'open',
      refundId: null,
      refundAmount: 0,
      refundStatus: 'waived',
      exchangeOrderItemIds: [],
      feeDueAmount: 88,
      shopNoticeEnqueued: false,
      replayed: false,
    });
    // 店長が額を0に直した時は、計算どおり（null）ではなく 0 を渡す
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_receive_return', expect.objectContaining({ _refund_amount: 0 }));
  });

  it('同じ二重防止の番号の送り直しは、前の受け取りと返金の記録をそのまま返す（replayed が true。Review Focus 1）', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ admin_receive_return: { data: [{ ...RECEIVED_ROW, replayed: true, refund_status: 'pending' }] } });

    await expect(receiveReturn(store, RECEIVE_INPUT)).resolves.toMatchObject({
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, refundId: REFUND_ID, refundStatus: 'pending', replayed: true,
    });
  });

  it('サポートの受け取り（actorCanRefund が false）は、そのまま DB に渡す。権限そのものは窓口が確かめる', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ admin_receive_return: { data: [RECEIVED_ROW] } });

    await receiveReturn(store, { ...RECEIVE_INPUT, actorCanRefund: false, refundChoice: 'consult' });

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'admin_receive_return',
      expect.objectContaining({ _actor_can_refund: false, _refund_choice: 'consult' }),
    );
  });

  it.each([
    'RETURN_NOT_FOUND',
    'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT',
    'RETURN_RECEIPT_EXCEEDS',
    'RETURN_EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK',
    'RETURN_FORBIDDEN',
    'RETURN_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID',
    'RETURN_SENT_BACK_MESSAGE_REQUIRED',
    'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH',
  ] as const)('DB が %s で断れば、同じ綴りの記号', async (word) => {
    await expectRefusal('admin_receive_return', word, word, (store) => receiveReturn(store, RECEIVE_INPUT));
  });

  it.each(REFUND_DB_WORDS)('受け取りの中で E-2 の返金が %s で断れば、E-2 の記号 %s のまま渡す（確かめ中の返金がある時など）', async (word, code) => {
    await expectRefusal('admin_receive_return', word, code, (store) => receiveReturn(store, RECEIVE_INPUT));
  });
});

describe('refundReturn', () => {
  it('DB の関数の引数名のとおりに渡し、1行の答えを窓口の形に直す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      admin_refund_return: { data: [{ refund_id: REFUND_ID, amount: 2900, status: 'awaiting_response', replayed: false }] },
    });

    await expect(refundReturn(store, REFUND_INPUT)).resolves.toEqual({
      refundId: REFUND_ID, amount: 2900, status: 'awaiting_response', replayed: false,
    });

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_refund_return', {
      _return_id: RETURN_ID,
      _actor_id: ACTOR_ID,
      _request_key: REQUEST_KEY,
      _amount: 2400,
      _shipping_amount: 500,
      _note: '額を相談して決めた',
      _notify_customer: true,
    });
  });

  it('額を0にして渡すと、返金しないで終える。返金の記録は無いので、返金の番号が null・状態が waived（P20）。送り直しも同じ答え', async () => {
    const first = storeWith({ admin_refund_return: { data: [{ refund_id: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived', replayed: false }] } });

    await expect(refundReturn(first.store, { ...REFUND_INPUT, amount: 0, shippingAmount: 0 })).resolves.toEqual({
      refundId: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived', replayed: false,
    });
    expect(first.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_refund_return', expect.objectContaining({ _amount: 0, _shipping_amount: 0 }));

    const again = storeWith({ admin_refund_return: { data: [{ refund_id: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived', replayed: true }] } });
    await expect(refundReturn(again.store, { ...REFUND_INPUT, amount: 0, shippingAmount: 0 })).resolves.toEqual({
      refundId: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived', replayed: true,
    });
  });

  it('額を決めない（計算どおり）時は null を渡す。同じ番号の送り直しは前の返金の記録をそのまま返す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      admin_refund_return: { data: [{ refund_id: REFUND_ID, amount: 2666, status: 'pending', replayed: true }] },
    });

    await expect(refundReturn(store, { ...REFUND_INPUT, amount: null, shippingAmount: 0 })).resolves.toEqual({
      refundId: REFUND_ID, amount: 2666, status: 'pending', replayed: true,
    });
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_refund_return', expect.objectContaining({ _amount: null, _shipping_amount: 0 }));
  });

  it.each([
    'RETURN_NOT_FOUND',
    'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT',
    'RETURN_FORBIDDEN',
    'RETURN_NOTHING_TO_REFUND',
    'RETURN_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID',
    'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH',
  ] as const)('DB が %s で断れば、同じ綴りの記号', async (word) => {
    await expectRefusal('admin_refund_return', word, word, (store) => refundReturn(store, REFUND_INPUT));
  });

  it.each(REFUND_DB_WORDS)('E-2 の返金が %s で断れば、E-2 の記号 %s のまま渡す', async (word, code) => {
    await expectRefusal('admin_refund_return', word, code, (store) => refundReturn(store, REFUND_INPUT));
  });
});

describe('取消・開き直し・届かないで終える・検品・手数料の記録・支払いを待たずに送る', () => {
  it('cancelReturn: 返品と実行した人を渡し、返品の番号と状態を返す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ admin_cancel_return: { data: [{ return_id: RETURN_ID, status: 'cancelled' }] } });

    await expect(cancelReturn(store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID })).resolves.toEqual({
      returnId: RETURN_ID, status: 'cancelled',
    });
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_cancel_return', { _return_id: RETURN_ID, _actor_id: ACTOR_ID });
  });

  it('closeReturnMissing・reopenReturn: 二重防止の番号を渡し、受け取りの記録の番号と返品の状態と replayed を返す', async () => {
    const closed = storeWith({
      admin_close_return_missing: { data: [{ receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID, return_status: 'closed', replayed: false }] },
    });
    await expect(closeReturnMissing(closed.store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID, requestKey: REQUEST_KEY })).resolves.toEqual({
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'closed', replayed: false,
    });
    expect(closed.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_close_return_missing', {
      _return_id: RETURN_ID, _actor_id: ACTOR_ID, _request_key: REQUEST_KEY,
    });

    const reopened = storeWith({
      admin_reopen_return: { data: [{ receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID, return_status: 'open', replayed: true }] },
    });
    await expect(reopenReturn(reopened.store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID, requestKey: REQUEST_KEY })).resolves.toEqual({
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'open', replayed: true,
    });
    expect(reopened.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_reopen_return', {
      _return_id: RETURN_ID, _actor_id: ACTOR_ID, _request_key: REQUEST_KEY,
    });
  });

  it('inspectReturn: 品ごとの在庫に戻す数・戻さない数を渡す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      admin_inspect_return: { data: [{ receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID, return_status: 'closed', replayed: false }] },
    });

    await expect(
      inspectReturn(store, {
        returnId: RETURN_ID,
        actorId: ACTOR_ID,
        requestKey: REQUEST_KEY,
        lines: [{ returnLineId: LINE_1, restocked: 1, notRestocked: 1 }, { returnLineId: LINE_2, restocked: 0, notRestocked: 2 }],
      }),
    ).resolves.toEqual({ receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'closed', replayed: false });

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_inspect_return', {
      _return_id: RETURN_ID,
      _actor_id: ACTOR_ID,
      _request_key: REQUEST_KEY,
      _lines: [
        { return_line_id: LINE_1, restocked: 1, not_restocked: 1 },
        { return_line_id: LINE_2, restocked: 0, not_restocked: 2 },
      ],
    });
  });

  it('recordReturnFeePayment・releaseReturnExchange: 返品の番号と状態を返す。メモは無くてもよい（null）。受け取りの記録（waive が偽）は _waive を偽で渡す', async () => {
    const paid = storeWith({
      admin_record_return_fee_payment: { data: [{ return_id: RETURN_ID, return_status: 'closed' }] },
    });
    await expect(
      recordReturnFeePayment(paid.store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID, note: null, waive: false }),
    ).resolves.toEqual({ returnId: RETURN_ID, returnStatus: 'closed' });
    expect(paid.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_record_return_fee_payment', {
      _return_id: RETURN_ID, _actor_id: ACTOR_ID, _note: null, _waive: false,
    });

    const released = storeWith({
      admin_release_return_exchange: { data: [{ return_id: RETURN_ID, return_status: 'open' }] },
    });
    await expect(releaseReturnExchange(released.store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID })).resolves.toEqual({
      returnId: RETURN_ID, returnStatus: 'open',
    });
    expect(released.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_release_return_exchange', { _return_id: RETURN_ID, _actor_id: ACTOR_ID });
  });

  it('recordReturnFeePayment: waive が真なら「いただかないで終える」。_waive を真のまま渡し、答えの形は受け取りの記録と同じ（P27）', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      admin_record_return_fee_payment: { data: [{ return_id: RETURN_ID, return_status: 'closed' }] },
    });

    await expect(
      recordReturnFeePayment(store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID, note: '常連のお客様のため', waive: true }),
    ).resolves.toEqual({ returnId: RETURN_ID, returnStatus: 'closed' });

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin_record_return_fee_payment', {
      _return_id: RETURN_ID, _actor_id: ACTOR_ID, _note: '常連のお客様のため', _waive: true,
    });
  });

  it.each([
    ['admin_cancel_return', 'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT', (store: ReturnStore) => cancelReturn(store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID })],
    ['admin_reopen_return', 'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT', (store: ReturnStore) => reopenReturn(store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID, requestKey: REQUEST_KEY })],
    ['admin_close_return_missing', 'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH', (store: ReturnStore) => closeReturnMissing(store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID, requestKey: REQUEST_KEY })],
    ['admin_record_return_fee_payment', 'RETURN_FORBIDDEN', (store: ReturnStore) => recordReturnFeePayment(store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID, note: null, waive: false })],
    ['admin_release_return_exchange', 'RETURN_NOT_FOUND', (store: ReturnStore) => releaseReturnExchange(store, { returnId: RETURN_ID, actorId: ACTOR_ID })],
  ])('%s は DB が %s で断れば、同じ綴りの記号', async (rpcName, word, run) => {
    await expectRefusal(rpcName, word, word, run);
  });
});

    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ get_order_return_materials: { data: MATERIALS_JSON } });

    await expect(loadReturnCreateMaterials(store, ORDER_ID)).resolves.toEqual(MATERIALS);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('get_order_return_materials', { _order_id: ORDER_ID });
  });

  it('jsonb が配列に包まれて来ても読める', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ get_order_return_materials: { data: [MATERIALS_JSON] } });

    await expect(loadReturnCreateMaterials(store, ORDER_ID)).resolves.toEqual(MATERIALS);
  });

  it('注文が無い時（答えが null か空）は、E-2 の記号 order_not_found の ReturnStoreError', async () => {
    for (const data of [null, []]) {
      const { store } = storeWith({ get_order_return_materials: { data } });

      const error = await loadReturnCreateMaterials(store, ORDER_ID).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);

      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ReturnStoreError);
      expect(error).toMatchObject({ code: 'order_not_found' });
    }
  });
});

describe('listOrderReturns', () => {
  it('返品の一覧を窓口の形に直す。キーは camelCase、番号の文字（label）は注文の番号と返品の番号から付ける', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ list_order_returns: { data: [RETURN_JSON] } });

    await expect(listOrderReturns(store, ORDER_ID)).resolves.toEqual([RETURN]);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('list_order_returns', { _order_id: ORDER_ID });
  });

  it('交換の予定の行にも、返金の行と同じ形の額の列（refund_amounts_by_count）が入る。受け取りで「返金に変える」時の見込みに使う', async () => {
    const [refundLine, exchangeLine] = RETURN_JSON.lines;
    const pendingExchange = {
      ...exchangeLine,
      quantity: 2,
      progress: { ...exchangeLine.progress, restocked: 0, processed: 0, unprocessed: 2, exchanged: 0 },
      refund_amounts_by_count: [4000, 8000],
    };
    const { store } = storeWith({ list_order_returns: { data: [{ ...RETURN_JSON, lines: [refundLine, pendingExchange] }] } });

    const [detail] = await listOrderReturns(store, ORDER_ID);

    expect(detail.lines[0]).toMatchObject({ resolution: 'refund', refundAmountsByCount: [2666] });
    expect(detail.lines[1]).toMatchObject({ resolution: 'exchange', refundAmountsByCount: [4000, 8000] });
  });

  it('取消・お断りの返品も読める。行・返金・受け取り・交換の品が null でも空の配列にし、状態の印は null・[]', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ list_order_returns: { data: [CANCELLED_JSON] } });

    const [cancelled] = await listOrderReturns(store, ORDER_ID);

    expect(cancelled).toMatchObject({
      number: 1, label: 'ORD-A1B2C3D4-R1', status: 'cancelled', source: 'customer_request', displayStatus: null, marks: [],
      returnMethod: 'not_required', returnCarrier: null, returnTrackingNumber: null, shopNote: null, createdByEmail: null,
      cancelledAt: '2026-10-11T02:00:00+00:00', lines: [], refunds: [], receipts: [], exchangeItems: [],
    });
  });

  it('返品が無ければ空の配列。表に無い状態の記号・小さな印は捨てる（画面が言葉の表を引いて undefined にならない）', async () => {
    const empty = storeWith({ list_order_returns: { data: null } });
    await expect(listOrderReturns(empty.store, ORDER_ID)).resolves.toEqual([]);

    const weird = storeWith({ list_order_returns: { data: [{ ...RETURN_JSON, display_status: 'weird', marks: ['awaiting_items', 'weird'] }] } });
    const [detail] = await listOrderReturns(weird.store, ORDER_ID);

    expect(detail).toMatchObject({ displayStatus: null, marks: ['awaiting_items'] });
  });
});

describe('listOrderReturnSummaries', () => {
  const summaryRow = (orderId: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
    order_id: orderId, display_status: 'refund_waiting', marks: [], next_action: 'refund', has_returnable: false,
    refund_waiting_returns: 1, requested_returns: 0, ...overrides,
  });
  const summary = (orderId: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
    orderId, displayStatus: 'refund_waiting', marks: [], nextAction: 'refund', hasReturnable: false,
    refundWaitingReturns: 1, requestedReturns: 0, ...overrides,
  });

  it('空の入力は DB を呼ばず、空の Map を返す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({});

    await expect(listOrderReturnSummaries(store, [])).resolves.toEqual(new Map());

    expect(rpc).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('要約を注文ごとに集める。DB が行を返さなかった注文も、返品なし・次にすることなしの要約でキーに入る', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      list_order_return_summaries: {
        data: [
          summaryRow(ORDER_ID),
          summaryRow(OTHER_ORDER_ID, {
            display_status: 'in_progress', marks: ['awaiting_items', 'awaiting_fee'], next_action: 'receive', has_returnable: true,
            refund_waiting_returns: 0, requested_returns: 2,
          }),
        ],
      },
    });

    const result = await listOrderReturnSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID, OTHER_ORDER_ID, EMPTY_ORDER_ID]);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('list_order_return_summaries', { _order_ids: [ORDER_ID, OTHER_ORDER_ID, EMPTY_ORDER_ID] });
    expect([...result.keys()]).toEqual([ORDER_ID, OTHER_ORDER_ID, EMPTY_ORDER_ID]);
    expect(result.get(ORDER_ID)).toEqual(summary(ORDER_ID));
    expect(result.get(OTHER_ORDER_ID)).toEqual(
      summary(OTHER_ORDER_ID, {
        displayStatus: 'in_progress', marks: ['awaiting_items', 'awaiting_fee'], nextAction: 'receive', hasReturnable: true,
        refundWaitingReturns: 0, requestedReturns: 2,
      }),
    );
    expect(result.get(EMPTY_ORDER_ID)).toEqual({
      orderId: EMPTY_ORDER_ID, displayStatus: null, marks: [], nextAction: 'none', hasReturnable: false,
      refundWaitingReturns: 0, requestedReturns: 0,
    });
  });

  it('返品の無い注文（状態が null）と、表に無い記号（状態・印・次にすること）の扱い', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({
      list_order_return_summaries: {
        data: [
          summaryRow(ORDER_ID, { display_status: null, next_action: 'none', has_returnable: true, refund_waiting_returns: 0 }),
          summaryRow(OTHER_ORDER_ID, { display_status: 'weird', marks: ['weird', 'pending_inspection'], next_action: 'weird' }),
        ],
      },
    });

    const result = await listOrderReturnSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID, OTHER_ORDER_ID]);

    expect(result.get(ORDER_ID)).toEqual(
      summary(ORDER_ID, { displayStatus: null, nextAction: 'none', hasReturnable: true, refundWaitingReturns: 0 }),
    );
    expect(result.get(OTHER_ORDER_ID)).toEqual(
      summary(OTHER_ORDER_ID, { displayStatus: null, marks: ['pending_inspection'], nextAction: 'none' }),
    );
  });

  it('同じ番号は1回として数える。大文字の番号は RPC へ小文字で渡り、DB が小文字で返した行は渡した文字のキーに入る', async () => {
    const upper = ORDER_ID.toUpperCase();
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ list_order_return_summaries: { data: [summaryRow(ORDER_ID)] } });

    const result = await listOrderReturnSummaries(store, [upper, upper]);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('list_order_return_summaries', { _order_ids: [ORDER_ID] });
    expect([...result.keys()]).toEqual([upper]);
    expect(result.get(upper)).toEqual(summary(ORDER_ID));
  });

  it('200件ずつに分けて呼ぶ（DB の関数は201件以上を断るため）。渡した番号は全部キーに入る', async () => {
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 450 }, (_, index) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(index).padStart(12, '0')}`);
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ list_order_return_summaries: { data: [] } });

    const result = await listOrderReturnSummaries(store, ids);

    expect(rpc.mock.calls.map(([, args]) => (args?._order_ids as string[]).length)).toEqual([200, 200, 50]);
    expect(rpc.mock.calls[0][1]?._order_ids).toEqual(ids.slice(0, 200));
    expect(rpc.mock.calls[2][1]?._order_ids).toEqual(ids.slice(400));
    expect(result.size).toBe(450);
  });

  it('DB が TOO_MANY_ORDERS で断れば RETURN_ARGUMENT_INVALID（200件ずつに分けるので、ふつうは来ない）', async () => {
    await expectRefusal('list_order_return_summaries', 'TOO_MANY_ORDERS', 'RETURN_ARGUMENT_INVALID', (store) =>
      listOrderReturnSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID]),
    );
  });

  describe('PostgREST の max_rows（1000）で答えが切れうる時', () => {
    const rows = (count: number) => Array.from({ length: count }, () => summaryRow(ORDER_ID));

    it('1回の答えが 1000 行に届いたら、切れている恐れがあるので RefundStoreError で止める', async () => {
      const { store } = storeWith({ list_order_return_summaries: { data: rows(1000) } });

      const error = await listOrderReturnSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID]).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);

      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);
      expect(error).toMatchObject({ operation: 'list_order_return_summaries' });
    });

    it('999 行なら通る', async () => {
      const { store } = storeWith({ list_order_return_summaries: { data: rows(999) } });

      await expect(listOrderReturnSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID])).resolves.toBeInstanceOf(Map);
    });
  });
});
```
