```ts
describe('本文の zod の部品（画面が使わない欄を null で送る本文と、額の 0 を受ける。Task 9）', () => {
  describe('optionalText（店だけのメモ・お返しのメッセージなどの文）', () => {
    const text = optionalText(500);

    it.each<[string, unknown]>([
      ['省く', undefined],
      ['null', null],
      ['空の文', ''],
      ['空白と改行だけ', '  \n '],
    ])('%s は null にする（空は持たない）', (_name, value) => {
      expect(text.parse(value)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('前後の空白を除いた文を返す。上限は空白を除いた後の文字数で数える', () => {
      expect(text.parse('  袖の汚れなし ')).toBe('袖の汚れなし');
      expect(text.parse(`  ${'あ'.repeat(500)}  `)).toBe('あ'.repeat(500));
    });

    it.each<[string, unknown]>([
      ['上限を超える文字数', 'あ'.repeat(501)],
      ['数', 5],
      ['真偽', true],
      ['配列', ['メモ']],
    ])('%s は誤り', (_name, value) => {
      expect(text.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('optionalAmount（金額。省く／null は計算どおり、0 は返金しないで終える）', () => {
    it.each<[string, unknown, number | null]>([
      ['省く', undefined, null],
      ['null', null, null],
      ['0', 0, 0],
      ['8000', 8000, 8000],
      ['integer の上限', MAX_AMOUNT, MAX_AMOUNT],
    ])('%s は受ける。0 は 0 のまま、省く／null は null のまま渡す', (_name, value, expected) => {
      expect(optionalAmount.parse(value)).toBe(expected);
    });

    it.each<[string, unknown]>([
      ['負', -1],
      ['小数', 100.5],
      ['integer の上限を超える', MAX_AMOUNT + 1],
      ['文字', '100'],
      ['数でない値', Number.NaN],
    ])('%s は誤り', (_name, value) => {
      expect(optionalAmount.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('optionalCarrier・optionalTrackingNumber（送り返し・返送の配送業者と伝票番号）', () => {
    it.each<[string, unknown]>([
      ['省く', undefined],
      ['null', null],
    ])('配送業者が %s なら null', (_name, value) => {
      expect(optionalCarrier.parse(value)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('知っている配送業者はそのまま通し、知らない値と空の文は誤りにする', () => {
      expect(optionalCarrier.parse('yamato')).toBe('yamato');
      expect(optionalCarrier.safeParse('fedex').success).toBe(false);
      expect(optionalCarrier.safeParse('').success).toBe(false);
    });

    it.each<[string, unknown]>([
      ['省く', undefined],
      ['null', null],
      ['空の文', ''],
      ['空白だけ', '   '],
    ])('伝票番号が %s なら null', (_name, value) => {
      expect(optionalTrackingNumber.parse(value)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('伝票番号は前後の空白を除き、英数字とハイフンの1〜64文字だけ受ける', () => {
      expect(optionalTrackingNumber.parse(' AB-123 ')).toBe('AB-123');
      expect(optionalTrackingNumber.parse('a'.repeat(64))).toBe('a'.repeat(64));
      for (const value of ['AB 123', 'a'.repeat(65), '日本', 123]) {
        expect(optionalTrackingNumber.safeParse(value).success).toBe(false);
      }
    });
  });
});

describe('refusalCodeOf（DB が決まった言葉で断った誤りだけを見分ける）', () => {
  it.each(C4_CASES)('返品の store が %s で断った誤りは、その記号を返す', (code) => {
    expect(refusalCodeOf(new ReturnStoreError(code))).toBe(code);
  });

  it('store が E-2 の言葉をそのまま渡した誤り（記号は E-2 の物）も、断りとして返す', () => {
    expect(refusalCodeOf(new ReturnStoreError('awaiting_refund_exists'))).toBe('awaiting_refund_exists');
  });

  it('E-2 の RefundOperationError も断りとして返す', () => {
    expect(refusalCodeOf(new RefundOperationError('exceeds_refundable'))).toBe('exceeds_refundable');
  });

  it('知らない記号（DB の SQLSTATE など）を持つ ReturnStoreError や、ほかの誤りは断りではない（500 にする）', () => {
    expect(refusalCodeOf(new ReturnStoreError('08006' as never))).toBeNull();
    expect(refusalCodeOf(new RefundStoreError('create_return', { message: 'DB の文', code: '08006' }))).toBeNull();
    expect(refusalCodeOf(new TypeError('Stripe のキーが無い'))).toBeNull();
    expect(refusalCodeOf('文字')).toBeNull();
    expect(refusalCodeOf(null)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('toRefusalReply（断りを HTTP・言葉・監査に直す）', () => {
  it('計画の冒頭 C-4 の表と E-2 の表の書き写しは、全部の記号を覆っている', () => {
    expect(C4_CASES.map(([code]) => code).sort()).toEqual([...RETURN_ERROR_CODES].sort());
    expect(E2_CASES.map(([code]) => code).sort()).toEqual([...REFUND_ERROR_CODES].sort());
  });

  it.each(C4_CASES)('%s は HTTP %i と C-4 の言葉。409 は衝突、ほかは失敗として監査に残す', (code, status, message) => {
    expect(toRefusalReply(code, 'Return refused')).toEqual({
      status,
      body: { error: message, code },
      audit: { outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure', detail: 'Return refused', metadata: { code } },
    });
  });

  it.each(E2_CASES)('E-2 の記号 %s は E-2 の HTTP %i と言葉のまま', (code, status, message) => {
    expect(toRefusalReply(code, 'Return refused')).toEqual({
      status,
      body: { error: message, code },
      audit: { outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure', detail: 'Return refused', metadata: { code } },
    });
  });
});

describe('toReceiveReply（受け取りの流れの答えを HTTP と監査に直す）', () => {
  // satisfies にして、kind: 'received' の型のまま下で上書き（{ ...RECEIVED, refund: null } など）できるようにする
  const RECEIVED = {
    kind: 'received',
    receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
    returnStatus: 'closed',
    refund: { refundId: REFUND_ID, amount: 8000, status: 'pending' },
    feeDueAmount: 0,
    exchangeOrderItemIds: [],
    replayed: false,
  } satisfies ReceiveReturnResult;

  it('今返金して Stripe が受け付けた答えは 200。受け取りと返金の番号・状態・額を data に入れ、監査は成功', () => {
    expect(toReceiveReply(RECEIVED)).toEqual({
      status: 200,
      body: {
        data: {
          receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'closed', refundId: REFUND_ID, refundAmount: 8000,
          refundStatus: 'pending', feeDueAmount: 0, replayed: false,
        },
      },
      audit: {
        outcome: 'success',
        detail: 'Return received',
        metadata: {
          receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID, return_status: 'closed', refund_id: REFUND_ID, refund_amount: 8000,
          refund_status: 'pending', fee_due_amount: 0, replayed: false,
        },
      },
    });
  });

  it('返金の無い受け取り（相談・なし）は、返金の3つの欄が null。お支払い待ちの額はそのまま返す', () => {
    const reply = toReceiveReply({ ...RECEIVED, returnStatus: 'open', refund: null, feeDueAmount: 300 });

    expect(reply.status).toBe(200);
    expect(reply.body).toEqual({
      data: {
        receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'open', refundId: null, refundAmount: null,
        refundStatus: null, feeDueAmount: 300, replayed: false,
      },
    });
    expect(reply.audit.metadata).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ refund_id: null, refund_amount: null, refund_status: null }));
  });

  // 計画の冒頭 P20: 手数料が商品の額以上で返金が0円になった。返金の記録も Stripe への頼みも無い
  it('返金が0円で省かれた受け取りは、返金の番号が null・額が 0・状態が waived', () => {
    const reply = toReceiveReply({ ...RECEIVED, refund: { refundId: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived' }, feeDueAmount: 200 });

    expect(reply.status).toBe(200);
    expect(reply.body).toEqual({
      data: {
        receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'closed', refundId: null, refundAmount: 0,
        refundStatus: 'waived', feeDueAmount: 200, replayed: false,
      },
    });
    expect(reply.audit.metadata).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ refund_id: null, refund_amount: 0, refund_status: 'waived' }));
  });

  // Review Focus 1: 同じ二重防止の番号の送り直しは、前の受け取りと返金の記録を返す（replayed）。200 のまま写す
  it('同じ番号の送り直し（replayed）は、そのまま写す', () => {
    const reply = toReceiveReply({ ...RECEIVED, replayed: true });

    expect(reply.status).toBe(200);
    expect(reply.body).toEqual({ data: expect.objectContaining({ replayed: true }) });
    expect(reply.audit.metadata).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ replayed: true }));
  });

  it.each(C4_CASES)('断り %s は C-4 の言葉。受け取りの断りとして監査に残す', (code, status, message) => {
    expect(toReceiveReply({ kind: 'refused', code })).toEqual({
      status,
      body: { error: message, code },
      audit: { outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure', detail: 'Return receive refused', metadata: { code } },
    });
  });

  it('E-2 の断り（確かめ中の返金がある）は E-2 の言葉のまま', () => {
    expect(toReceiveReply({ kind: 'refused', code: 'awaiting_refund_exists' })).toEqual({
      status: 409,
      body: { error: '確かめ中の返金があります。先に確かめてください。', code: 'awaiting_refund_exists' },
      audit: { outcome: 'conflict', detail: 'Return receive refused', metadata: { code: 'awaiting_refund_exists' } },
    });
  });

  it('受け取りは記録できたが Stripe が断った時は 422。E-2 の言葉に返金の番号を付け、記録済みの受け取りの番号も付ける', () => {
    expect(toReceiveReply({
      kind: 'refund_not_accepted',
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      returnStatus: 'closed',
      refund: { kind: 'stripe_rejected', refundId: REFUND_ID, reasonLabel: 'カード会社に断られました' },
    })).toEqual({
      status: 422,
      body: {
        error: 'Stripe が返金を受け付けませんでした（カード会社に断られました）。',
        code: 'stripe_rejected',
        refundId: REFUND_ID,
        receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      },
      audit: {
        outcome: 'failure',
        detail: 'Stripe rejected the refund',
        metadata: { refund_id: REFUND_ID, receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID },
      },
    });
  });

  it('Stripe の断りに理由の言葉が無ければ、括弧を付けない', () => {
    const reply = toReceiveReply({
      kind: 'refund_not_accepted',
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      returnStatus: 'closed',
      refund: { kind: 'stripe_rejected', refundId: REFUND_ID, reasonLabel: null },
    });

    expect(reply.body).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ error: 'Stripe が返金を受け付けませんでした。' }));
  });

  // Review Focus 1: 通信が切れて Stripe が返金を作ったか分からない。画面が開き直した後も確かめ直せるよう、番号を返す
  it('答えが分からない時は 502 で、決まった文と返金の番号・受け取りの番号を返す。監査は error', () => {
    expect(toReceiveReply({
      kind: 'refund_not_accepted',
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      returnStatus: 'closed',
      refund: { kind: 'unknown', refundId: REFUND_ID },
    })).toEqual({
      status: 502,
      body: { error: UNKNOWN_MESSAGE, code: 'unknown_outcome', refundId: REFUND_ID, receiptId: RECEIPT_ID },
      audit: {
        outcome: 'error',
        detail: 'Refund outcome is unknown',
        metadata: { refund_id: REFUND_ID, receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID },
      },
    });
  });

  it('受け取りは記録できたが E-2 が返金を断った時（支払いの番号が Stripe の物でない注文など）は、E-2 の言葉と HTTP に受け取りの番号を付ける', () => {
    expect(toReceiveReply({
      kind: 'refund_not_accepted',
      receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
      returnStatus: 'open',
      refund: { kind: 'refused', code: 'order_not_refundable' },
    })).toEqual({
      status: 409,
      body: { error: 'この注文は返金できません。', code: 'order_not_refundable', receiptId: RECEIPT_ID },
      audit: { outcome: 'conflict', detail: 'Refund refused', metadata: { code: 'order_not_refundable', receipt_id: RECEIPT_ID } },
    });
  });

  it.each<ReceiveReturnResult>([
    RECEIVED,
    { ...RECEIVED, refund: { refundId: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived' } },
    { kind: 'refused', code: 'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT' },
    { kind: 'refund_not_accepted', receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'closed', refund: { kind: 'stripe_rejected', refundId: REFUND_ID, reasonLabel: null } },
    { kind: 'refund_not_accepted', receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'closed', refund: { kind: 'unknown', refundId: REFUND_ID } },
  ])('監査の鍵は、実物の maskAuditEvent を通しても伏せられない（$kind）', (result) => {
    expectNoKeyIsRedacted(toReceiveReply(result).audit.metadata);
  });
});

describe('toRefundReturnReply（額を決めて返金の流れの答えを HTTP と監査に直す）', () => {
  it('受け付けた答えは 200。E-2 の返金の答えを data に入れ、監査は E-2 と同じ', () => {
    expect(toRefundReturnReply({ kind: 'accepted', refundId: REFUND_ID, status: 'pending', amount: 12000, replayed: false })).toEqual({
      status: 200,
      body: { data: { refundId: REFUND_ID, status: 'pending', amount: 12000, replayed: false } },
      audit: {
        outcome: 'success',
        detail: 'Refund accepted',
        metadata: { refund_id: REFUND_ID, status: 'pending', amount: 12000, replayed: false },
      },
    });
  });

  it('同じ番号の送り直し（replayed）の成功も、そのまま写す', () => {
    const reply = toRefundReturnReply({ kind: 'accepted', refundId: REFUND_ID, status: 'succeeded', amount: 500, replayed: true });

    expect(reply.body).toEqual({ data: { refundId: REFUND_ID, status: 'succeeded', amount: 500, replayed: true } });
  });

  // 計画の冒頭 P20: 額を決めて返金で0円にした。返金の記録も Stripe への頼みも無く、お客様への返金のお知らせも無い
  it('0円で返金しないで終えた答え（waived）は 200。返金の番号が null・額が 0・状態が waived', () => {
    expect(toRefundReturnReply({ kind: 'waived', replayed: false })).toEqual({
      status: 200,
      body: { data: { refundId: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived', replayed: false } },
      audit: {
        outcome: 'success',
        detail: 'Refund waived',
        metadata: { refund_id: null, status: 'waived', amount: 0, replayed: false },
      },
    });
    expect(toRefundReturnReply({ kind: 'waived', replayed: true }).body).toEqual({
      data: { refundId: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived', replayed: true },
    });
  });

  it.each(C4_CASES)('断り %s は C-4 の言葉。額を決めて返金の断りとして監査に残す', (code, status, message) => {
    expect(toRefundReturnReply({ kind: 'refused', code })).toEqual({
      status,
      body: { error: message, code },
      audit: { outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure', detail: 'Return refund refused', metadata: { code } },
    });
  });

  it('Stripe の断りは 422、答えが分からない時は 502。どちらも E-2 の言葉に返金の番号を付ける', () => {
    expect(toRefundReturnReply({ kind: 'stripe_rejected', refundId: REFUND_ID, reasonLabel: null })).toEqual({
      status: 422,
      body: { error: 'Stripe が返金を受け付けませんでした。', code: 'stripe_rejected', refundId: REFUND_ID },
      audit: { outcome: 'failure', detail: 'Stripe rejected the refund', metadata: { refund_id: REFUND_ID } },
    });
    expect(toRefundReturnReply({ kind: 'unknown', refundId: REFUND_ID })).toEqual({
      status: 502,
      body: { error: UNKNOWN_MESSAGE, code: 'unknown_outcome', refundId: REFUND_ID },
      audit: { outcome: 'error', detail: 'Refund outcome is unknown', metadata: { refund_id: REFUND_ID } },
    });
  });

  it.each<RefundReturnResult>([
    { kind: 'accepted', refundId: REFUND_ID, status: 'pending', amount: 1, replayed: false },
    { kind: 'waived', replayed: false },
    { kind: 'refused', code: 'RETURN_NOTHING_TO_REFUND' },
    { kind: 'stripe_rejected', refundId: REFUND_ID, reasonLabel: null },
    { kind: 'unknown', refundId: REFUND_ID },
  ])('監査の鍵は、実物の maskAuditEvent を通しても伏せられない（$kind）', (result) => {
    expectNoKeyIsRedacted(toRefundReturnReply(result).audit.metadata);
  });
});

describe('returnErrorLogFields（窓口の失敗のログに出す物）', () => {
  it('DB の記号を持つ誤りは、名前と記号だけ。DB の文は出さない', () => {
    const error = new RefundStoreError('create_return', { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' });

    expect(returnErrorLogFields(error)).toEqual(['RefundStoreError', '08006']);

    expect(returnErrorLogFields(returnError)).toEqual([returnError.name, 'RETURN_NOT_FOUND']);
    expect(returnErrorLogFields(new RefundOperationError('exceeds_refundable'))).toEqual(['RefundOperationError', 'exceeds_refundable']);
  });

  it('DB の記号が無ければ名前だけ。誤りでない物を投げられても UnknownError と出す', () => {

});

describe('guardReturnWrite（書く窓口の守り）', () => {
  const OPTIONS = { rateLimit: RETURN_RATE_LIMITS.update, requireRefundPermission: false };

  it('権限・CSRF・回数の制限が通れば、実行する人の番号を返す。回数は送信元ごと→管理者ごとに、渡した窓口名と回数で数える', async () => {
    const guard = await guardReturnWrite(postRequest(), OPTIONS);

    expect(guard).toEqual({ ok: true, userId: 'admin-1' });
    expect(mockAuthorize.mock.calls).toEqual([['admin.orders.return', expect.any(Request)]]);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, {
      request: expect.any(Request), endpoint: 'admin:returns:update', limit: 60, windowSeconds: 600,
    });
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, {
      request: expect.any(Request), endpoint: 'admin:returns:update', limit: 60, windowSeconds: 600, subject: 'admin-1',
    });
  });

  it('権限 admin.orders.return が無ければ、認可の応答を返し、CSRF も回数の制限も確かめない（権限の確認が先）', async () => {
    grant();

    const guard = await guardReturnWrite(postRequest(), OPTIONS);

    expect(guard.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!guard.ok) expect(guard.response).toBe(DENIED);
    expect(mockRequireCsrf).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('requireRefundPermission が真なら、admin.orders.return の次に admin.orders.refund も確かめる', async () => {
    const guard = await guardReturnWrite(postRequest(), { ...OPTIONS, requireRefundPermission: true });

    expect(guard).toEqual({ ok: true, userId: 'admin-1' });
    expect(mockAuthorize.mock.calls).toEqual([
      ['admin.orders.return', expect.any(Request)],
      ['admin.orders.refund', expect.any(Request)],
    ]);
  });

  it('requireRefundPermission が真で admin.orders.refund が無ければ、認可の応答を返し、CSRF も回数の制限も確かめない', async () => {
    grant('admin.orders.return');

    const guard = await guardReturnWrite(postRequest(), { ...OPTIONS, requireRefundPermission: true });

    expect(guard.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!guard.ok) expect(guard.response).toBe(DENIED);
    expect(mockRequireCsrf).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('CSRF の合言葉が合わなければ、その応答を返し、回数も数えない', async () => {
    const csrfDenied = new Response(null, { status: 403 });
    mockRequireCsrf.mockResolvedValueOnce(csrfDenied);

    const guard = await guardReturnWrite(postRequest(), OPTIONS);

    expect(guard.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!guard.ok) expect(guard.response).toBe(csrfDenied);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('送信元ごとの回数の制限を超えたら、その応答を返し、管理者ごとの回数は数えない', async () => {
    const limited = new Response(null, { status: 429 });
    mockEnforceRateLimit.mockResolvedValueOnce(limited);

    const guard = await guardReturnWrite(postRequest(), OPTIONS);

    expect(guard.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!guard.ok) expect(guard.response).toBe(limited);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('管理者ごとの回数の制限を超えたら、その応答を返す', async () => {
    const limited = new Response(null, { status: 429 });
    mockEnforceRateLimit.mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined).mockResolvedValueOnce(limited);

    const guard = await guardReturnWrite(postRequest(), OPTIONS);

    expect(guard.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!guard.ok) expect(guard.response).toBe(limited);
  });
});

describe('resolveCanRefund（返金の権限を持つか）', () => {
  it('admin.orders.refund を持てば真', async () => {
    await expect(resolveCanRefund(postRequest())).resolves.toEqual({ ok: true, canRefund: true });
    expect(mockAuthorize).toHaveBeenCalledWith('admin.orders.refund', expect.any(Request));
  });

  it('持たない（403）なら偽。サポートの人は返品の窓口を使えるまま', async () => {
    grant('admin.orders.return');

    await expect(resolveCanRefund(postRequest())).resolves.toEqual({ ok: true, canRefund: false });
  });

  // 確かめられなかっただけの人を、黙ってサポートの扱いにしない（今返金を選んだ店長が「店長だけ」と言われないように）
  it.each([401, 503, 500])('確かめられなかった（%i）時は、偽にせず、その応答をそのまま返す', async (status) => {
    const failed = new Response(null, { status });
    mockAuthorize.mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: false, response: failed });

    const result = await resolveCanRefund(postRequest());

    expect(result.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!result.ok) expect(result.response).toBe(failed);
  });
});

    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
```

```ts
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { RefundStoreError } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';

/**
 * 注文の「返品できる数」の合計（グループ E-3 設計書 4-8）。返品の画面の下の「返品できる品: あと{n}点」に使う。
 * 数え方は DB の関数 list_order_line_return_counts の1か所（注文の商品ごとの returnable）で、ここでは足すだけ。
 * 呼ぶのは返品の一覧の窓口だけ（ほかの窓口は返品できる数を持たない）。
 * サーバーだけで使う（画面から読まない）。単体テストが直接読むので、サーバー専用の印（server-only）は付けない。
 */
export async function loadReturnableUnits(client: Pick<SupabaseClient, 'rpc'>, orderId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { data, error } = await client.rpc('list_order_line_return_counts', { _order_ids: [orderId] });
  if (error) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('list_order_line_return_counts', error);
  }
  // 表を返す関数の答えは配列。数えられない行（null）は 0 として足す
  const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? (data as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) : [];
  return rows.reduce((total, row) => total + Number(row.returnable ?? 0), 0);
}
```

`src/lib/orders/returns/return-route-support.ts`:

```ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { enforceRateLimit } from '@/features/auth/middleware/rateLimit';
import { authorizeAdminPermission } from '@/lib/auth/admin-rbac';
import { logAudit } from '@/lib/audit';
import { REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES, refundErrorBody } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-messages';
import { toRefundReply, type RefundReply } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-route-support';
import { RefundOperationError, RefundStoreError } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import { REFUND_ERROR_CODES, type RefundErrorCode } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';
import { RETURN_ERROR_MESSAGES } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-messages';
import type { ReceiveReturnResult, RefundReturnResult } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-service';
import { ReturnStoreError } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-store';
import { RETURN_CARRIERS, RETURN_ERROR_CODES, type ReturnErrorCode } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

/**
 * 返品の窓口が共有する部品（グループ E-3 Task 7、決め事 T7-1）。E-2 の refund-route-support.ts と同じ考えで、
 * 守りの順・断りの言葉・監査・ログを1か所に持ち、10本の窓口がずれないようにする。サーバーだけで使う。
 * 監査の鍵は maskAuditEvent に伏せられない名前にし（number・card・pan・token などを含めない）、
 * メモ・お返しのメッセージ・伝票番号・住所・メールは入れない。
 */

// ---- 回数の制限と 500 の言葉（計画の冒頭 Global Constraints） ----

export type RateLimitRule = { readonly endpoint: string; readonly limit: number; readonly windowSeconds: number };

export const RETURN_RATE_LIMITS = {
  create: { endpoint: 'admin:returns:create', limit: 30, windowSeconds: 600 },
  receive: { endpoint: 'admin:returns:receive', limit: 30, windowSeconds: 600 },
  refund: { endpoint: 'admin:returns:refund', limit: 30, windowSeconds: 600 },
  // 取消・開き直し・届かないで終える・検品・手数料の記録・支払いを待たずに送る
  update: { endpoint: 'admin:returns:update', limit: 60, windowSeconds: 600 },
} as const satisfies Record<string, RateLimitRule>;

/** 思いがけない失敗（500）の言葉。C-4・C-5 に無いので本タスクで決めた。何をしようとして失敗したかで分ける */
export const RETURN_FAILURE_MESSAGES = {
  list: '返品の一覧を読み込めませんでした。',
  materials: '返品の材料を読み込めませんでした。',
  create: '返品の記録に失敗しました。',
  receive: '受け取りの記録に失敗しました。',
  refund: '返金の記録に失敗しました。',
  update: '返品の更新に失敗しました。',
} as const;
export type ReturnFailureKind = keyof typeof RETURN_FAILURE_MESSAGES;

export function returnFailureBody(kind: ReturnFailureKind) {
  return { error: RETURN_FAILURE_MESSAGES[kind], code: 'failed' };
}

// ---- 本文の zod の部品 ----

// Postgres の integer の上限。これを超える額は DB が型の誤りで断って 500 になり、画面が同じ番号で送り直しを繰り返してしまうので、窓口で 400 にする
export const MAX_AMOUNT = 2147483647;

// 手数料の円の欄（返品を作る時の返送料・交換の手数料・交換の送料、設定の返送料の定額・交換の手数料・交換の送料）の上限。
// 計画の冒頭の Global Constraints の「金額の入力の上限は 1,000,000 円」。DB の関数（Task 2 の admin_create_return の RETURN_FEE_INVALID・
// admin_update_shop_return_settings の settings_int）と画面（Task 10・Task 12）と同じ値。返金の額は手数料ではない（DB が返せる額で確かめる）ので MAX_AMOUNT のまま
export const MAX_FEE_YEN = 1000000;

/** 店だけのメモ・お返しのメッセージなどの文。前後の空白を除き、空は持たない（null） */
export const optionalText = (maxLength: number) =>
  z.string().trim().max(maxLength).nullish().transform((value) => value || null);

/** 金額（円）。省いた時と null は、DB が設定の値・計算どおりで決める印。0 は 0 のまま渡す（返金しないで終える意味。P20） */
export const optionalAmount = z.number().int().min(0).max(MAX_AMOUNT).nullish().transform((value) => value ?? null);

export const optionalCarrier = z.enum(RETURN_CARRIERS).nullish().transform((value) => value ?? null);

/** 伝票番号（P16。E-1 と同じ ^[0-9A-Za-z-]{1,64}$）。空は持たない（null） */
export const optionalTrackingNumber = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .nullish()
  .transform((value) => value || null)
  .refine((value) => value === null || /^[0-9A-Za-z-]{1,64}$/.test(value));

// ---- 答えの対応 ----

export type AuditOutcome = 'success' | 'failure' | 'conflict' | 'error';

/** 窓口の HTTP の答えと、監査に残す結果・文・鍵 */
export type ReturnReply = {
  status: number;
  body: Record<string, unknown>;
  audit: { outcome: AuditOutcome; detail: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> };
};

function isReturnErrorCode(code: string): code is ReturnErrorCode {
  return (RETURN_ERROR_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(code);
}

function isRefundErrorCode(code: string): code is RefundErrorCode {
  return (REFUND_ERROR_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(code);
}

/**
 * DB が決まった言葉で断った誤りだけを見分ける（T7-6）。ReturnStoreError か RefundOperationError で、
 * 記号が C-4 か E-2 の表に入る物。表に無い記号（DB の SQLSTATE など）は断りではなく、思いがけない失敗として 500 にする
 */
export function refusalCodeOf(error: unknown): ReturnErrorCode | RefundErrorCode | null {
  if (!(error instanceof ReturnStoreError) && !(error instanceof RefundOperationError)) {
    return null;
  }
  const code: unknown = error.code;
  return typeof code === 'string' && (isReturnErrorCode(code) || isRefundErrorCode(code)) ? code : null;
}

/** 断りの記号を、HTTP・画面の言葉・監査に直す。409 は衝突、ほかは失敗（E-2 の toRefundReply と同じ） */
export function toRefusalReply(code: ReturnErrorCode | RefundErrorCode, detail: string): ReturnReply {
  const { status, body } = isReturnErrorCode(code)
    ? { status: RETURN_ERROR_MESSAGES[code].status, body: { error: RETURN_ERROR_MESSAGES[code].message, code } }
    : { status: REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES[code].status, body: refundErrorBody(code) };
  return { status, body, audit: { outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure', detail, metadata: { code } } };
}

/** 受け取りは記録済み（Stripe に頼む前に DB が書いた）なので、E-2 の答えに受け取りの番号を足す */
function withReceipt(reply: RefundReply, receiptId: string): ReturnReply {
  return {
    status: reply.status,
    body: { ...reply.body, receiptId },
    audit: { ...reply.audit, metadata: { ...reply.audit.metadata, receipt_id: receiptId } },
  };
}

export function toReceiveReply(result: ReceiveReturnResult): ReturnReply {
  switch (result.kind) {
    case 'received': {
      // 返金が無い受け取り（相談・なし）は3つとも null。0円で省いた時は返金の番号が null・額が 0・状態が waived（P20）
      const refundId = result.refund?.refundId ?? null;
      const refundAmount = result.refund?.amount ?? null;
      const refundStatus = result.refund?.status ?? null;
      return {
        status: 200,
        body: {
          data: {
            receiptId: result.receiptId,
            returnStatus: result.returnStatus,
            refundId,
            refundAmount,
            refundStatus,
            feeDueAmount: result.feeDueAmount,
            replayed: result.replayed,
          },
        },
        audit: {
          outcome: 'success',
          detail: 'Return received',
          metadata: {
            receipt_id: result.receiptId,
            return_status: result.returnStatus,
            refund_id: refundId,
            refund_amount: refundAmount,
            refund_status: refundStatus,
            fee_due_amount: result.feeDueAmount,
            replayed: result.replayed,
          },
        },
      };
    }
    case 'refused':
      return toRefusalReply(result.code, 'Return receive refused');
    case 'refund_not_accepted':
      // Stripe が断った（422）・答えが分からない（502。Stripe は返金を作ったかもしれない）・E-2 が断った。
      // 言葉と返金の番号は E-2 のまま、画面が開き直した後も同じ二重防止の番号で確かめ直せるよう、受け取りの番号を足す
      return withReceipt(toRefundReply(result.refund), result.receiptId);
  }
}

export function toRefundReturnReply(result: RefundReturnResult): ReturnReply {
  switch (result.kind) {
    case 'refused':
      return toRefusalReply(result.code, 'Return refund refused');
    case 'waived':
      // 0円は返金の記録を作らず Stripe にも頼まない（P20）。お客様への返金のお知らせも無い
      return {
        status: 200,
        body: { data: { refundId: null, amount: 0, status: 'waived', replayed: result.replayed } },
        audit: {
          outcome: 'success',
          detail: 'Refund waived',
          metadata: { refund_id: null, status: 'waived', amount: 0, replayed: result.replayed },
        },
      };
    case 'accepted': {
      // E-2 の返金の窓口と同じ言葉・同じ監査。成功だけ data に入れる（C-3）
      const reply = toRefundReply(result);
      return { ...reply, body: { data: reply.body } };
    }
    case 'stripe_rejected':
    case 'unknown':
      return toRefundReply(result);
  }
}

/**
 * 窓口の失敗のログに出す物。誤りの名前と DB の記号だけにする
 * （DB の文には宛先・氏名・メールが混ざりうるので、出さない）。
 */
export function returnErrorLogFields(error: unknown): string[] {
  const name = error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'UnknownError';
  const code =
    error instanceof ReturnStoreError || error instanceof RefundStoreError || error instanceof RefundOperationError
      ? error.code
      : null;
  return code ? [name, code] : [name];
}

// ---- 守りと監査 ----

export type ReturnAudit = (outcome: AuditOutcome, detail: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null) => Promise<void>;

/** 監査の書き込み。実行した人・対象・送信元を付ける。メモ・連絡先を含みうる入力は metadata に入れない */
export function createReturnAudit(
  request: Request,
  actorId: string,
  target: { action: string; resource: 'orders' | 'order_returns'; resourceId: string },
): ReturnAudit {
  return (outcome, detail, metadata = null) =>
    logAudit({
      action: target.action,
      actor_id: actorId,
      resource: target.resource,
      resource_id: target.resourceId,
      outcome,
      detail,
      ip: request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ?? null,
      user_agent: request.headers.get('user-agent') ?? null,
      metadata,
    });
}

export type ReturnWriteGuard = { ok: true; userId: string } | { ok: false; response: Response };

/**
 * 書く窓口の守り（T7-2）: 権限 admin.orders.return（お金の窓口は続けて admin.orders.refund）→ CSRF → 回数の制限
 * （送信元ごと→管理者ごと）。どこかで断られたら、その応答を返し、後の確かめも記録もしない。
 */
export async function guardReturnWrite(
  request: Request,
  options: { rateLimit: RateLimitRule; requireRefundPermission: boolean },
): Promise<ReturnWriteGuard> {
  const authz = await authorizeAdminPermission('admin.orders.return', request);
  if (!authz.ok) {
    return { ok: false, response: authz.response };
  }
  if (options.requireRefundPermission) {
    const refundAuthz = await authorizeAdminPermission('admin.orders.refund', request);
    if (!refundAuthz.ok) {
      return { ok: false, response: refundAuthz.response };
    }
  }

  const { requireCsrfOrDeny } = await import('@/lib/csrfMiddleware');
  const csrfResult = await requireCsrfOrDeny();
  if (csrfResult instanceof Response) {
    return { ok: false, response: csrfResult };
  }

  const ipLimited = await enforceRateLimit({ request, ...options.rateLimit });
  if (ipLimited) {
    return { ok: false, response: ipLimited };
  }
  const actorLimited = await enforceRateLimit({ request, ...options.rateLimit, subject: authz.userId });
  if (actorLimited) {
    return { ok: false, response: actorLimited };
  }
  return { ok: true, userId: authz.userId };
}

/**
 * 実行する人が返金の権限（admin.orders.refund）を持つか（T7-3）。403 だけを「持たない」とする。
 * 401・503・500 は確かめられなかっただけなので、「持たない」と見なさず、その応答をそのまま返す
 */
export async function resolveCanRefund(
  request: Request,
): Promise<{ ok: true; canRefund: boolean } | { ok: false; response: Response }> {
  const authz = await authorizeAdminPermission('admin.orders.refund', request);
  if (authz.ok) {
    return { ok: true, canRefund: true };
  }
  if (authz.response.status === 403) {
    return { ok: true, canRefund: false };
  }
  return { ok: false, response: authz.response };
}

// ---- 失敗の答え ----

/** 入口が答えで返した断り（refused）を、その HTTP と言葉で返し、断りとして監査に残す */
export async function respondToRefusal(
  code: ReturnErrorCode | RefundErrorCode,
  options: { audit: ReturnAudit; refusedDetail: string },
): Promise<Response> {
  const reply = toRefusalReply(code, options.refusedDetail);
  await options.audit(reply.audit.outcome, reply.audit.detail, reply.audit.metadata);
  return NextResponse.json(reply.body, { status: reply.status });
}

/**
 * 書く窓口の catch の中身。決まった言葉で断られた誤りが投げられた時は、答えで返された断りと同じにする。
 * それ以外は 500 で、ログには窓口名つきの文と誤りの名前・DB の記号だけを出し、監査は error にする
 */
export async function respondToReturnError(
  error: unknown,
  options: { audit: ReturnAudit; action: string; refusedDetail: string; failureDetail: string; failureKind: ReturnFailureKind },
): Promise<Response> {
  const code = refusalCodeOf(error);
  if (code) {
    return respondToRefusal(code, { audit: options.audit, refusedDetail: options.refusedDetail });
  }
  console.error(`[${options.action}] ${options.failureDetail}`, ...returnErrorLogFields(error));
  await options.audit('error', options.failureDetail);
  return NextResponse.json(returnFailureBody(options.failureKind), { status: 500 });
}

/** 読む窓口の catch の中身。監査は書かない（読むだけ） */
export async function respondToReturnReadError(
  error: unknown,
  options: { tag: string; failureKind: ReturnFailureKind },
): Promise<Response> {
  const code = refusalCodeOf(error);
  if (code) {
    const reply = toRefusalReply(code, 'Return read refused');
    return NextResponse.json(reply.body, { status: reply.status });
  }
  console.error(options.tag, ...returnErrorLogFields(error));
  return NextResponse.json(returnFailureBody(options.failureKind), { status: 500 });
}
```

```ts
  });

  // 返金の権限を確かめられなかった（セッションの確認が一時的に使えない）だけの人を、黙ってサポートの扱いにしない
  it.each([401, 503])('返金の権限を確かめられなかった（%i）時は、その応答をそのまま返し、DB を読まない', async (status) => {
    mockAuthorize
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(ADMIN)
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: false, response: new Response(null, { status }) });

    expect((await getReturns(listRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(status);
    expect(mockListOrderReturns).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockGetShopReturnSettings).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('注文番号の形が違えば 400。DB を読まない', async () => {
    const response = await getReturns(listRequest(), BAD_ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '入力を確かめてください。', code: 'invalid_request' });
    expect(mockListOrderReturns).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockGetShopReturnSettings).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('注文が無ければ（返金の材料が null）404。E-2 の言葉', async () => {
    mockLoadRefundMaterials.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const response = await getReturns(listRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(404);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '注文が見つかりません。', code: 'order_not_found' });
  });

  it('DB が決まった言葉で断ったら、その HTTP と C-4 の言葉', async () => {
    mockListOrderReturns.mockRejectedValue(new ReturnStoreError('RETURN_NOT_FOUND'));

    const response = await getReturns(listRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(404);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '返品が見つかりません。', code: 'RETURN_NOT_FOUND' });
  });

  it('読み込みの失敗は 500。ログは例外名と DB の記号だけ（DB の文は出さない）', async () => {
    mockListOrderReturns.mockRejectedValue(new RefundStoreError('list_order_returns', { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' }));
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    try {
      const response = await getReturns(listRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);
      expect(response.status).toBe(500);
      await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '返品の一覧を読み込めませんでした。', code: 'failed' });
      expect(consoleError.mock.calls).toEqual([['[admin.orders.return.list] Failed to load returns', 'RefundStoreError', '08006']]);
    } finally {
      consoleError.mockRestore();
    }
  });

  // 設定だけ読めなかった時に inspectionEnabled を偽にして返すと、要検品がオンの店でサポートが検品待ちを選べなくなり、気づけない（T7-15）
  it('設定だけ読めなかった時も、inspectionEnabled を偽にして返さず、一覧全体を 500 にする', async () => {
    mockGetShopReturnSettings.mockRejectedValue(
      new RefundStoreError('get_shop_return_settings', { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' }),
    );
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    try {
      const response = await getReturns(listRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);
      expect(response.status).toBe(500);
      await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '返品の一覧を読み込めませんでした。', code: 'failed' });
      expect(consoleError.mock.calls).toEqual([['[admin.orders.return.list] Failed to load returns', 'RefundStoreError', '08006']]);
    } finally {
      consoleError.mockRestore();
    }
  });
});

describe('GET /api/admin/orders/[id]/returns/materials（返品を作る画面の材料）', () => {
  it('返品の権限で材料を返す。読むだけなので CSRF と回数の制限は通さない。返金の権限は確かめない', async () => {
    mockLoadReturnCreateMaterials.mockResolvedValue(MATERIALS);

    const response = await getMaterials(materialsRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ data: MATERIALS });
    expect(mockLoadReturnCreateMaterials).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockServiceClient, ORDER_ID);
    expect(mockAuthorize.mock.calls).toEqual([['admin.orders.return', expect.any(Request)]]);
    expect(mockRequireCsrf).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('権限が無ければ認可の応答を返し、DB を読まない', async () => {
    grant();

    expect((await getMaterials(materialsRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockLoadReturnCreateMaterials).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('注文番号の形が違えば 400', async () => {
    const response = await getMaterials(materialsRequest(), BAD_ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '入力を確かめてください。', code: 'invalid_request' });
    expect(mockLoadReturnCreateMaterials).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('返品を作れない注文は 409 ORDER_NOT_RETURNABLE（C-4 の言葉）、注文が無ければ E-2 の 404', async () => {
    mockLoadReturnCreateMaterials.mockRejectedValueOnce(new ReturnStoreError('ORDER_NOT_RETURNABLE'));
    const notReturnable = await getMaterials(materialsRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);
    expect(notReturnable.status).toBe(409);
    await expect(notReturnable.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: 'この注文は返品を作れません。', code: 'ORDER_NOT_RETURNABLE' });

    mockLoadReturnCreateMaterials.mockRejectedValueOnce(new ReturnStoreError('order_not_found'));
    const missing = await getMaterials(materialsRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);
    expect(missing.status).toBe(404);
    await expect(missing.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '注文が見つかりません。', code: 'order_not_found' });
  });

  it('読み込みの失敗は 500。ログは例外名と DB の記号だけ', async () => {
    mockLoadReturnCreateMaterials.mockRejectedValue(
      new RefundStoreError('get_order_return_materials', { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' }),
    );
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    try {
      const response = await getMaterials(materialsRequest(), ORDER_CONTEXT);
      expect(response.status).toBe(500);
      await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '返品の材料を読み込めませんでした。', code: 'failed' });
      expect(consoleError.mock.calls).toEqual([
        ['[admin.orders.return.materials] Failed to load materials', 'RefundStoreError', '08006'],
      ]);
    } finally {
      consoleError.mockRestore();
    }
  });
});

// 書く窓口は、権限 → CSRF → 回数の制限（送信元ごと・管理者ごと）の順に確かめる
describe('POST /api/admin/orders/[id]/returns の守り', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockSubmitCreate.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'done', ...CREATED });
  });

  it('権限 admin.orders.return が無ければ CSRF も回数の制限も確かめず、認可の応答を返す（権限の確認が先）', async () => {
    grant();

    expect((await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockAuthorize.mock.calls).toEqual([['admin.orders.return', expect.any(Request)]]);
    expect(mockRequireCsrf).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('サポート（返金の権限が無い人）も返品を作れる。返金の権限は確かめない', async () => {
    grant('admin.orders.return');

    expect((await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(mockAuthorize).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('CSRF の合言葉が合わなければ、回数も数えず、何も記録しない', async () => {
    mockRequireCsrf.mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(null, { status: 403 }));

    expect((await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('送信元ごと・管理者ごとの回数の制限を、返品を作る窓口の名前と回数（10分に30回）で数える', async () => {
    expect((await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(200);

    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, {
      request: expect.any(Request), endpoint: 'admin:returns:create', limit: 30, windowSeconds: 600,
    });
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, {
      request: expect.any(Request), endpoint: 'admin:returns:create', limit: 30, windowSeconds: 600, subject: 'admin-1',
    });
  });

  it('送信元ごとの回数の制限を超えたら 429。管理者ごとの回数も数えず、何も記録しない', async () => {
    mockEnforceRateLimit.mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(null, { status: 429 }));

    expect((await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(429);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('管理者ごとの回数の制限を超えたら 429。何も記録しない', async () => {
    mockEnforceRateLimit.mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined).mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(null, { status: 429 }));

    expect((await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT)).status).toBe(429);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

    ['交換の色・サイズの番号が小数', { ...CREATE_BODY, lines: [{ ...EXCHANGE_LINE, exchangeVariantId: 1.5 }] }],
    ['交換の送り方が知らない値', { ...CREATE_BODY, lines: [{ ...EXCHANGE_LINE, exchangeMethod: 'ship' }] }],
    ['返送の方法が知らない値', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnMethod: 'pickup' }],
    ['返送の方法が無い', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnMethod: undefined }],
    ['返送料の負担が知らない値', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingPayer: 'both' }],
    ['返送料の負担が無い', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingPayer: undefined }],
    ['返送の配送業者が知らない値', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnCarrier: 'fedex' }],
    ['返送の伝票番号に空白', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnTrackingNumber: 'AB 123' }],
    ['返送の伝票番号が65文字', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnTrackingNumber: 'a'.repeat(65) }],
    // 手数料の4つは必須（画面は使わない手数料を 0 にして送る。Task 10）
    ['返送料が無い', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingFee: undefined }],
    ['返送料が null', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingFee: null }],
    ['返送料が負', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingFee: -1 }],
    ['返送料が小数', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingFee: 1.5 }],
    ['返送料が1000000を超える', { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingFee: 1000001 }],
    ['交換の手数料が1000000を超える', { ...CREATE_BODY, exchangeFee: 1000001 }],
    ['交換の送料が1000000を超える', { ...CREATE_BODY, exchangeShippingFee: 1000001 }],
    ['返品の手数料が無い', { ...CREATE_BODY, restockingFeePercent: undefined }],
    ['返品の手数料が101%', { ...CREATE_BODY, restockingFeePercent: 101 }],
    ['返品の手数料が負', { ...CREATE_BODY, restockingFeePercent: -1 }],
    ['返品の手数料が小数', { ...CREATE_BODY, restockingFeePercent: 10.5 }],
    ['交換の手数料が無い', { ...CREATE_BODY, exchangeFee: undefined }],
    ['交換の手数料が負', { ...CREATE_BODY, exchangeFee: -1 }],
    ['交換の送料が無い', { ...CREATE_BODY, exchangeShippingFee: undefined }],
    ['交換の送料が負', { ...CREATE_BODY, exchangeShippingFee: -1 }],
    ['店のメモが501文字', { ...CREATE_BODY, shopNote: 'あ'.repeat(501) }],
    ['店のメモが文字でない', { ...CREATE_BODY, shopNote: 5 }],
    ['お客様に知らせるが無い', { ...CREATE_BODY, notifyCustomer: undefined }],
    ['お客様に知らせるが真偽でない', { ...CREATE_BODY, notifyCustomer: 'yes' }],
  ];

  beforeEach(() => {
    mockSubmitCreate.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'done', ...CREATED });
  });

  it('実行した人と中身を入口に渡し、番号・状態を data で返す。監査にメモ・伝票番号を入れず、鍵も伏せられない', async () => {
    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ data: CREATED });
    expect(mockCreateDeps).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockDeps, { orderId: ORDER_ID, actorId: 'admin-1', ...CREATE_BODY });
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      action: 'admin.orders.return.create',
      actor_id: 'admin-1',
      resource: 'orders',
      resource_id: ORDER_ID,
      outcome: 'success',
      detail: 'Return created',
      ip: '203.0.113.5',
      user_agent: 'jest',
      // 返品の番号の鍵は number でなく sequence（maskAuditEvent が number を含む鍵を伏せるため）
      metadata: { return_id: RETURN_ID, sequence: 1, status: 'open', replayed: false, line_count: 2, notify_customer: true },
    });
    const audited = JSON.stringify(mockLogAudit.mock.calls);
    expect(audited).not.toContain('電話で依頼');
    expect(audited).not.toContain('袖に穴');
    expect(audited).not.toContain('AB-123');
    expect(audited).not.toContain('@example.com');
    expectNoKeyIsRedacted(mockLogAudit.mock.calls[0][0]);
  });

  it('省ける欄は null にして渡す。空・空白だけの文と伝票番号は null、メモの前後の空白は除く', async () => {
    const body = {
      ...CREATE_BODY,
      lines: [{ ...REFUND_LINE, reasonNote: '  ' }],
      returnCarrier: undefined,
      returnTrackingNumber: '',
      shopNote: '  電話で依頼  ',
    };

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(body), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockDeps, {
      orderId: ORDER_ID,
      actorId: 'admin-1',
      ...CREATE_BODY,
      lines: [{ ...REFUND_LINE, reasonNote: null }],
      returnCarrier: null,
      returnTrackingNumber: null,
      shopNote: '電話で依頼',
    });
  });

  it('画面が使わない手数料を 0 にして送る本文（Task 10）を受け、0 のまま入口に渡す。交換でない行の交換の欄は null', async () => {
    const body = {
      ...CREATE_BODY,
      lines: [{ ...REFUND_LINE, reasonNote: null }],
      returnCarrier: null,
      returnTrackingNumber: null,
      returnShippingFee: 0,
      restockingFeePercent: 0,
      exchangeFee: 0,
      exchangeShippingFee: 0,
      shopNote: null,
    };

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(body), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockDeps, { orderId: ORDER_ID, actorId: 'admin-1', ...body });
  });

  // Global Constraints の金額の上限（1,000,000 円）。DB の RETURN_FEE_INVALID・画面（Task 10）と同じ値で、上限ちょうどは通す
  it('円の手数料（返送料・交換の手数料・交換の送料）は 1000000 まで受け、そのまま入口に渡す', async () => {
    const body = { ...CREATE_BODY, returnShippingFee: 1000000, exchangeFee: 1000000, exchangeShippingFee: 1000000 };

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(body), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockDeps, { orderId: ORDER_ID, actorId: 'admin-1', ...body });
  });

  it('同じ発送の同じ品を、理由を変えて2行にできる（2点は不良、1点は不要）', async () => {
    const lines = [
      { ...REFUND_LINE, quantity: 2 },
      { ...REFUND_LINE, quantity: 1, reason: 'unwanted', reasonNote: null },
    ];

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest({ ...CREATE_BODY, lines }), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockDeps, expect.objectContaining({ lines }));
  });

  it('同じ番号の送り直しの答え（replayed）は、200 のまま写す。メールの送る処理は入口が決める（窓口は動かさない）', async () => {
    mockSubmitCreate.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'done', ...CREATED, replayed: true });

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ data: { ...CREATED, replayed: true } });
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      metadata: expect.objectContaining({ replayed: true }),
    }));
  });

  it.each(INVALID_BODIES)('中身の誤り（%s）は 400。入口を呼ばず、固定の文だけを監査に残す', async (_name, body) => {
    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(body), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '入力を確かめてください。', code: 'invalid_request' });
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit.mock.calls).toEqual([[{
      action: 'admin.orders.return.create', actor_id: 'admin-1', resource: 'orders', resource_id: ORDER_ID,
      outcome: 'failure', detail: 'Invalid request body', ip: '203.0.113.5', user_agent: 'jest', metadata: null,
    }]]);
  });

  it.each(['null', '{'])('本文が JSON として読めない（%s）なら 400', async (rawBody) => {
    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(null, rawBody), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('注文番号の形が違えば 400。入口を呼ばず、固定の文だけを監査に残す', async () => {
    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), BAD_ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '入力を確かめてください。', code: 'invalid_request' });
    expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      resource_id: 'x', outcome: 'failure', detail: 'Invalid order id', metadata: null,
    }));
  });

  it.each(C4_CASES)('入口が %s で断った（答えで返した）ら HTTP %i と C-4 の言葉。409 は衝突、ほかは失敗として監査に残す', async (code, status, message) => {
    mockSubmitCreate.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'refused', code });

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(status);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: message, code });
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      action: 'admin.orders.return.create',
      outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure',
      detail: 'Return create refused',
      metadata: { code },
    }));
  });

  it('断りが投げられても（入口は答えで返すので本来は来ない）、答えで返された時と同じ HTTP と言葉', async () => {
    mockSubmitCreate.mockRejectedValue(new ReturnStoreError('RETURN_ADDRESS_REQUIRED'));

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({
      error: '返送先が設定されていません。ショップの設定で返送先を入れてから作ってください。',
      code: 'RETURN_ADDRESS_REQUIRED',
    });
  });

  it('E-2 の記号で断られたら（入口が E-2 の言葉をそのまま渡した時）、E-2 の言葉と HTTP', async () => {
    mockSubmitCreate.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'refused', code: 'order_not_found' });

    const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT);

    expect(response.status).toBe(404);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '注文が見つかりません。', code: 'order_not_found' });
  });

  it('思いがけない失敗は 500。ログは例外名と DB の記号だけ（DB の文は出さない）', async () => {
    mockSubmitCreate.mockRejectedValue(new RefundStoreError('admin_create_return', { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' }));
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    try {
      const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT);
      expect(response.status).toBe(500);
      await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '返品の記録に失敗しました。', code: 'failed' });
      expect(consoleError.mock.calls).toEqual([['[admin.orders.return.create] Failed to create return', 'RefundStoreError', '08006']]);
      expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        action: 'admin.orders.return.create', outcome: 'error', detail: 'Failed to create return', metadata: null,
      }));
    } finally {
      consoleError.mockRestore();
    }
  });

  it('入口に渡す道具を作れなかった（環境の値が無い）時も、決まった 500。ログは例外名だけ', async () => {
    mockCreateDeps.mockRejectedValue(new TypeError('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not set'));
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    try {
      const response = await postReturn(createRequest(CREATE_BODY), ORDER_CONTEXT);
      expect(response.status).toBe(500);
      expect(consoleError.mock.calls).toEqual([['[admin.orders.return.create] Failed to create return', 'TypeError']]);
      expect(mockSubmitCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      consoleError.mockRestore();
    }
  });
});
```

`src/app/api/admin/orders/[id]/returns/route.ts`:

```ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { authorizeAdminPermission } from '@/lib/auth/admin-rbac';
import { createServiceRoleClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { ADMIN_NOTE_MAX_LENGTH } from '@/lib/orders/order-payment-types';
import { loadRefundMaterials } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-materials';
import { INVALID_REQUEST_BODY, REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES, refundErrorBody } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-messages';
import { createDefaultRefundServiceDeps } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-service';
import { loadReturnableUnits } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-counts';
import {
  MAX_FEE_YEN,
  RETURN_RATE_LIMITS,
  createReturnAudit,
  guardReturnWrite,
  optionalCarrier,
  optionalText,
  optionalTrackingNumber,
  resolveCanRefund,
  respondToRefusal,
  respondToReturnError,
  respondToReturnReadError,
} from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-route-support';
import { submitCreateReturn } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-service';
import { getShopReturnSettings, listOrderReturns } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-store';
import { RETURN_REASONS } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

const ACTION = 'admin.orders.return.create';

const lineSchema = z
  .object({
    fulfillmentId: z.string().uuid(),
    orderItemId: z.string().uuid(),
    quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(999),
    reason: z.enum(RETURN_REASONS),
    reasonNote: optionalText(255),
    resolution: z.enum(['refund', 'exchange']),
    exchangeVariantId: z.number().int().positive().nullish().transform((value) => value ?? null),
    exchangeMethod: z.enum(['stock', 'make']).nullish().transform((value) => value ?? null),
  })
  // DB の CHECK と同じ。交換なら色・サイズと送り方が両方要り、返金なら両方とも無い
  .refine((line) =>
    line.resolution === 'exchange'
      ? line.exchangeVariantId !== null && line.exchangeMethod !== null
      : line.exchangeVariantId === null && line.exchangeMethod === null,
  );

const bodySchema = z.object({
  requestKey: z.string().uuid(),
  // 同じ発送の同じ品でも、理由が違えば別の行にできる（2点は不良、1点は不要）ので、重なりは禁じない。数の上限は DB が確かめる
  lines: z.array(lineSchema).min(1).max(100),
  returnMethod: z.enum(['customer_ships', 'shop_label', 'not_required']),
  returnShippingPayer: z.enum(['shop', 'customer']),
  returnCarrier: optionalCarrier,
  returnTrackingNumber: optionalTrackingNumber,
  // 手数料の4つは必須の0以上の整数。画面は設定から入れた値（使わない手数料は 0）を送る（Task 10）。
  // 円の3つは Global Constraints の金額の上限（1,000,000 円。DB の RETURN_FEE_INVALID と同じ範囲）まで
  returnShippingFee: z.number().int().min(0).max(MAX_FEE_YEN),
  restockingFeePercent: z.number().int().min(0).max(100),
  exchangeFee: z.number().int().min(0).max(MAX_FEE_YEN),
  exchangeShippingFee: z.number().int().min(0).max(MAX_FEE_YEN),
  shopNote: optionalText(ADMIN_NOTE_MAX_LENGTH),
  notifyCustomer: z.boolean(),
});

/**
 * 注文の返品の一覧（グループ E-3 設計書 8-1）。返品ごとの中身・返金できるか・返品できる数・返せる額と送料・要検品の設定。
 * 返品の画面（注文ごと）を開いた時に読む。返品の権限の人だけが読める。読むだけなので CSRF と回数の制限は通さない。
 * 返金の権限（canRefund）は答えに入れるだけで、持たなくても読める（サポートの人は、額を決めて返金のボタンが出ない）。
 * 要検品（inspectionEnabled）は、受け取りの画面が「検品待ち」を選ばせるかに使う。設定の窓口は店長だけが読めるので、
 * サポートも読めるこの窓口に入れる（T7-15）。設定が読めなかった時は偽にせず、一覧全体を失敗にする。
 */
export async function GET(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const authz = await authorizeAdminPermission('admin.orders.return', request);
  if (!authz.ok) {
    return authz.response;
  }
  const refundSide = await resolveCanRefund(request);
  if (!refundSide.ok) {
    return refundSide.response;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const parsedId = z.string().uuid().safeParse(id);
  if (!parsedId.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(INVALID_REQUEST_BODY, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const client = await createServiceRoleClient();
    const [returns, returnableUnits, materials, settings] = await Promise.all([
      listOrderReturns(client, parsedId.data),
      loadReturnableUnits(client, parsedId.data),
      loadRefundMaterials(client, parsedId.data),
      getShopReturnSettings(client),
    ]);
    if (!materials) {
      return NextResponse.json(refundErrorBody('order_not_found'), { status: REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES.order_not_found.status });
    }
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        data: {
          returns,
          canRefund: refundSide.canRefund,
          returnableUnits,
          refundableAmount: materials.order.refundableAmount,
          refundableShipping: materials.order.refundableShipping,
          inspectionEnabled: settings.inspectionEnabled,
        },
      },
      { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } },
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return respondToReturnReadError(error, { tag: '[admin.orders.return.list] Failed to load returns', failureKind: 'list' });
  }
}

/**
 * 返品を作る（グループ E-3 設計書 5-3）。お店が発送の行・数・理由・解決の方法（返金／交換）・返送・手数料を決めて、すぐ受付中の返品にする。
 * 権限 → CSRF → 回数の制限（送信元ごとと管理者ごと）→ 注文の番号 → 中身 → 返品を作る入口の順に確かめる。
 * 受付のお知らせの送る処理は入口が動かす（新しく作って知らせる時だけ）。監査にメモ・伝票番号・連絡先は入れない。
 * 同じ requestKey の送り直しは前の結果を返す（replayed）。
 */
export async function POST(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const guard = await guardReturnWrite(request, { rateLimit: RETURN_RATE_LIMITS.create, requireRefundPermission: false });
  if (!guard.ok) {
    return guard.response;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const audit = createReturnAudit(request, guard.userId, { action: ACTION, resource: 'orders', resourceId: id });

  const parsedId = z.string().uuid().safeParse(id);
  if (!parsedId.success) {
    await audit('failure', 'Invalid order id');
    return NextResponse.json(INVALID_REQUEST_BODY, { status: 400 });
  }
  const parsedBody = bodySchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsedBody.success) {
    // 入力値や検証の詳細はメモなどを含みうるので、固定の文だけを監査に残す
    await audit('failure', 'Invalid request body');
    return NextResponse.json(INVALID_REQUEST_BODY, { status: 400 });
  }
  const returnRequest = parsedBody.data;

  try {
    const deps = await createDefaultRefundServiceDeps();
    const result = await submitCreateReturn(deps, { orderId: parsedId.data, actorId: guard.userId, ...returnRequest });
    if (result.kind === 'refused') {
      return respondToRefusal(result.code, { audit, refusedDetail: 'Return create refused' });
    }
    // 返品の番号の鍵に number を含めない（maskAuditEvent が number を含む鍵を伏せるため）。メモ・伝票番号は入れない
    await audit('success', 'Return created', {
      return_id: result.returnId,
      sequence: result.number,
      status: result.status,
      replayed: result.replayed,
      line_count: returnRequest.lines.length,
      notify_customer: returnRequest.notifyCustomer,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({
      data: { returnId: result.returnId, number: result.number, status: result.status, replayed: result.replayed },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return respondToReturnError(error, {
      audit,
      action: ACTION,
      refusedDetail: 'Return create refused',
      failureDetail: 'Failed to create return',
      failureKind: 'create',
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { authorizeAdminPermission } from '@/lib/auth/admin-rbac';
import { createServiceRoleClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { INVALID_REQUEST_BODY } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-messages';
import { respondToReturnReadError } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-route-support';
import { loadReturnCreateMaterials } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-store';

/**
 * 返品を作る画面を開いた時に読む材料（グループ E-3 設計書 5-3）。発送ごとの品と返品できる数・期限・
 * 交換で選べる色・サイズと在庫・設定（返送先の有無・手数料・理由ごとの返送料の負担）。
 * 返品を作る操作と同じ権限の人だけが読める。読むだけなので CSRF と回数の制限は通さない。
 */
export async function GET(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const authz = await authorizeAdminPermission('admin.orders.return', request);
  if (!authz.ok) {
    return authz.response;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const parsedId = z.string().uuid().safeParse(id);
  if (!parsedId.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(INVALID_REQUEST_BODY, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const store = await createServiceRoleClient();
    const materials = await loadReturnCreateMaterials(store, parsedId.data);
    return NextResponse.json({ data: materials }, { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
  } catch (error) {
    return respondToReturnReadError(error, {
      tag: '[admin.orders.return.materials] Failed to load materials',
      failureKind: 'materials',
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { POST as postReceive } from '@/app/api/admin/returns/[returnId]/receive/route';
import { POST as postRefund } from '@/app/api/admin/returns/[returnId]/refund/route';
import { RefundStoreError } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import { ReturnStoreError } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-store';
import {
  C4_CASES,
  HEADERS,
  LINE_ID,
  RECEIPT_ID,
  REFUND_ID,
  REQUEST_KEY,
  RETURN_ID,
  UNKNOWN_MESSAGE,
} from '../../lib/orders/returns/return-route-fixtures';

const DENIED = new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Forbidden' }), { status: 403 });
const ADMIN = { ok: true, userId: 'admin-1', role: 'admin', actorEmail: 'admin@example.com' };
const RETURN_CONTEXT = { params: Promise.resolve({ returnId: RETURN_ID }) };
const BAD_RETURN_CONTEXT = { params: Promise.resolve({ returnId: 'x' }) };

/** 持っている権限だけを通す認可の差し替え。それ以外は 403 */
function grant(...permissions: string[]) {
  mockAuthorize.mockImplementation(async (permission: string) =>
    permissions.includes(permission) ? ADMIN : { ok: false, response: DENIED },
  );
}

/** 実物の maskAuditEvent を通しても、監査の鍵が [REDACTED] にならないこと（number・card などを含む鍵は伏せられてしまう） */
function expectNoKeyIsRedacted(event: { metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null }) {
  const { maskAuditEvent } = jest.requireActual('@/lib/audit');
  expect(maskAuditEvent(event).metadata).toEqual(event.metadata);
}

function jsonRequest(path: string, body: unknown, rawBody?: string) {
  return new Request(`http://localhost/api/admin/returns/${RETURN_ID}/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: HEADERS,
    body: rawBody ?? JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

const UNIT = { returnLineId: LINE_ID, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 2 };
const RECEIVE_BODY = {
  requestKey: REQUEST_KEY,
  units: [UNIT],
  exchangeOverrides: [],
  refundChoice: 'now',
  refundAmount: null,
  refundShippingAmount: 0,
  note: '袖の汚れなし',
  notifyCustomer: true,
  sentBackMessage: null,
  sentBackCarrier: null,
  sentBackTrackingNumber: null,
};
// Task 5 の入口の答え（受け取りを記録し、Stripe が返金を受け付けた）
const RECEIVED = {
  kind: 'received',
  receiptId: RECEIPT_ID,
  returnStatus: 'closed',
  refund: { refundId: REFUND_ID, amount: 8000, status: 'pending' },
  feeDueAmount: 0,
  exchangeOrderItemIds: [],
  replayed: false,
};
const RECEIVED_DATA = {
  receiptId: RECEIPT_ID, returnStatus: 'closed', refundId: REFUND_ID, refundAmount: 8000,
  refundStatus: 'pending', feeDueAmount: 0, replayed: false,
};
const RECEIVE_AUDIT = { refund_choice: 'now', unit_count: 2 };

const REFUND_BODY = { requestKey: REQUEST_KEY, amount: 7500, shippingAmount: 500, note: '電話で相談済み', notifyCustomer: true };
const ACCEPTED = { kind: 'accepted', refundId: REFUND_ID, status: 'pending', amount: 8000, replayed: false };
const ACCEPTED_DATA = { refundId: REFUND_ID, status: 'pending', amount: 8000, replayed: false };

type Endpoint = {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  post: (request: Request, context: { params: Promise<{ returnId: string }> }) => Promise<Response>;
  action: string;
  rateLimit: { endpoint: string; limit: number };
  /** 受け取りの窓口は admin.orders.return だけで通り、返金の権限は本文を読んだ後に確かめる。額を決めて返金は最初から両方を求める */
  requiresRefund: boolean;
  service: jest.Mock;
  validBody: unknown;
  okResult: unknown;
  /** 窓口が監査に足す鍵（どの結果にも付く） */
  auditExtra: Record<string, unknown>;
  refusedDetail: string;
  failureLog: string;
  failureAudit: string;
  failureMessage: string;
};

// 受け取りと額を決めて返金は、同じ守り・同じ断りと失敗の答えを持つ
const ENDPOINTS: Endpoint[] = [
  {
    name: '受け取り',
    path: 'receive',
    post: postReceive,
    action: 'admin.orders.return.receive',
    rateLimit: { endpoint: 'admin:returns:receive', limit: 30 },
    requiresRefund: false,
    service: mockReceive,
    validBody: RECEIVE_BODY,
    okResult: RECEIVED,
    auditExtra: RECEIVE_AUDIT,
    refusedDetail: 'Return receive refused',
    failureLog: '[admin.orders.return.receive] Failed to receive return',
    failureAudit: 'Failed to receive return',
    failureMessage: '受け取りの記録に失敗しました。',
  },
  {
    name: '額を決めて返金',
    path: 'refund',
    post: postRefund,
    action: 'admin.orders.return.refund',
    rateLimit: { endpoint: 'admin:returns:refund', limit: 30 },
    requiresRefund: true,
    service: mockRefund,
    validBody: REFUND_BODY,
    okResult: ACCEPTED,
    auditExtra: { source: 'return' },
    refusedDetail: 'Return refund refused',
    failureLog: '[admin.orders.return.refund] Failed to refund return',
    failureAudit: 'Failed to refund return',
    failureMessage: '返金の記録に失敗しました。',
  },
];

function call(endpoint: Endpoint, options: { body?: unknown; rawBody?: string; context?: typeof RETURN_CONTEXT } = {}) {
  const body = 'body' in options ? options.body : endpoint.validBody;
  return endpoint.post(jsonRequest(endpoint.path, body, options.rawBody), options.context ?? RETURN_CONTEXT);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  jest.clearAllMocks();
  mockAuthorize.mockReset();
  mockRequireCsrf.mockReset();
  mockEnforceRateLimit.mockReset();
  mockCreateDeps.mockReset();
  mockReceive.mockReset();
  mockRefund.mockReset();
  grant('admin.orders.return', 'admin.orders.refund');
  mockRequireCsrf.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  mockEnforceRateLimit.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  mockCreateDeps.mockResolvedValue(mockDeps);
});

// 書く窓口はどれも、権限 → CSRF → 回数の制限（送信元ごと・管理者ごと）の順に確かめる
describe.each(ENDPOINTS)('$name の窓口の守り', (endpoint) => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    endpoint.service.mockResolvedValue(endpoint.okResult);
  });

  it('権限 admin.orders.return が無ければ CSRF も回数の制限も確かめず、認可の応答を返す（権限の確認が先）', async () => {
    grant();

    expect((await call(endpoint)).status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockAuthorize.mock.calls[0]).toEqual(['admin.orders.return', expect.any(Request)]);
    expect(mockRequireCsrf).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('CSRF の合言葉が合わなければ、回数も数えず、何も記録しない', async () => {
    mockRequireCsrf.mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(null, { status: 403 }));

    expect((await call(endpoint)).status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('送信元ごと・管理者ごとの回数の制限を、この窓口の名前と回数（10分に30回）で数える', async () => {
    expect((await call(endpoint)).status).toBe(200);

    const { endpoint: name, limit } = endpoint.rateLimit;
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, { request: expect.any(Request), endpoint: name, limit, windowSeconds: 600 });
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, {
      request: expect.any(Request), endpoint: name, limit, windowSeconds: 600, subject: 'admin-1',
    });
  });

  it('送信元ごとの回数の制限を超えたら 429。管理者ごとの回数も数えず、何も記録しない', async () => {
    mockEnforceRateLimit.mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(null, { status: 429 }));

    expect((await call(endpoint)).status).toBe(429);
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('管理者ごとの回数の制限を超えたら 429。何も記録しない', async () => {
    mockEnforceRateLimit.mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined).mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(null, { status: 429 }));

    expect((await call(endpoint)).status).toBe(429);
    expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe.each(ENDPOINTS.filter((endpoint) => endpoint.requiresRefund))('$name の窓口は返金の権限も求める', (endpoint) => {
  it('権限 admin.orders.refund が無ければ（サポートの人）CSRF も回数の制限も確かめず、認可の応答を返す', async () => {
    grant('admin.orders.return');

    expect((await call(endpoint)).status).toBe(403);
    expect(mockAuthorize.mock.calls).toEqual([
      ['admin.orders.return', expect.any(Request)],
      ['admin.orders.refund', expect.any(Request)],
    ]);
    expect(mockRequireCsrf).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEnforceRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

// 断りと失敗の答え。入口が断りを答えで返す形（Task 5 の本来の形）と、断りが投げられる形のどちらも、同じ HTTP・言葉・監査にする
describe.each(ENDPOINTS)('$name の窓口の断りと失敗', (endpoint) => {
  it.each(C4_CASES)('入口が %s で断った（答えで返した）ら HTTP %i と C-4 の言葉。409 は衝突、ほかは失敗として監査に残す', async (code, status, message) => {
    endpoint.service.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'refused', code });

    const response = await call(endpoint);

    expect(response.status).toBe(status);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: message, code });
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      action: endpoint.action,
      actor_id: 'admin-1',
      resource: 'order_returns',
      resource_id: RETURN_ID,
      outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure',
      detail: endpoint.refusedDetail,
      ip: '203.0.113.5',
      user_agent: 'jest',
      metadata: { ...endpoint.auditExtra, code },
    });
  });

  it.each(C4_CASES)('入口が %s で断った（投げた）ら HTTP %i と C-4 の言葉。監査は断りとして残す', async (code, status, message) => {
    endpoint.service.mockRejectedValue(new ReturnStoreError(code));

    const response = await call(endpoint);

    expect(response.status).toBe(status);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: message, code });
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      action: endpoint.action,
      outcome: status === 409 ? 'conflict' : 'failure',
      detail: endpoint.refusedDetail,
      metadata: { code },
    }));
  });

  it('E-2 の断り（確かめ中の返金がある）は、E-2 の言葉と HTTP のまま', async () => {
    endpoint.service.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'refused', code: 'awaiting_refund_exists' });

    const response = await call(endpoint);

    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({
      error: '確かめ中の返金があります。先に確かめてください。',
      code: 'awaiting_refund_exists',
    });
  });

  it('思いがけない失敗は 500。ログは例外名と DB の記号だけ（DB の文は出さない）', async () => {
    endpoint.service.mockRejectedValue(new RefundStoreError('begin_order_refund', { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' }));
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    try {
      const response = await call(endpoint);
      expect(response.status).toBe(500);
      await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: endpoint.failureMessage, code: 'failed' });
      expect(consoleError.mock.calls).toEqual([[endpoint.failureLog, 'RefundStoreError', '08006']]);
      expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        action: endpoint.action, outcome: 'error', detail: endpoint.failureAudit, metadata: null,
      }));
    } finally {
      consoleError.mockRestore();
    }
  });

  it('入口に渡す道具を作れなかった（環境の値が無い）時も、決まった 500。ログは例外名だけ', async () => {
    mockCreateDeps.mockRejectedValue(new TypeError('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not set'));
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    try {
      const response = await call(endpoint);
      expect(response.status).toBe(500);
      await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: endpoint.failureMessage, code: 'failed' });
      expect(consoleError.mock.calls).toEqual([[endpoint.failureLog, 'TypeError']]);
      expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      consoleError.mockRestore();
    }
  });

  it('返品の番号の形が違えば 400。入口を呼ばず、固定の文だけを監査に残す', async () => {
    const response = await call(endpoint, { context: BAD_RETURN_CONTEXT });

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: '入力を確かめてください。', code: 'invalid_request' });
    expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockLogAudit.mock.calls).toEqual([[{
      action: endpoint.action, actor_id: 'admin-1', resource: 'order_returns', resource_id: 'x',
      outcome: 'failure', detail: 'Invalid return id', ip: '203.0.113.5', user_agent: 'jest', metadata: null,
    }]]);
  });

  it.each(['null', '{'])('本文が JSON として読めない（%s）なら 400', async (rawBody) => {
    const response = await call(endpoint, { body: null, rawBody });

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    expect(endpoint.service).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe('POST /api/admin/returns/[returnId]/receive（受け取る）', () => {
  const SENT_BACK_BODY = {
```
