```ts
export type E2eReturnEmailRow = {
  kind: string;
  variant: string | null;
  status: string;
  return_id: string | null;
  return_receipt_id: string | null;
  refund_id: string | null;
};

/** 返品に結び付くメールの予定（return_ で始まる種類と、返品の返金のお知らせ）を、書いた順に読む */
export async function returnEmailRows(db: PgClient, orderId: string): Promise<E2eReturnEmailRow[]> {
  const res = await db.query(
    `select kind, variant, status, return_id, return_receipt_id, refund_id
     from private.order_email_outbox
     where order_id = $1 and (kind like 'return\\_%' or (kind = 'refund' and variant = 'return')) order by seq`,
    [orderId],
  );
  return res.rows as E2eReturnEmailRow[];
}

/** 送信済みになった、返品に結び付くメールの行の数（種類で絞る）。メールが着いてから行が送信済みになるまでの、わずかな差を待つために使う */
export async function sentReturnMailCount(orderId: string, kind: string): Promise<number> {
  const rows = await withLocalDb((db) => returnEmailRows(db, orderId));
  return rows.filter((row) => row.kind === kind && row.status === 'sent').length;
}

/** 件名に subjectIncludes を含むメールが count 通になるまで、worker を叩き直して待ち、本文つきで返す */
export async function waitForMails(
  request: APIRequestContext,
  email: string,
  subjectIncludes: string,
  count = 1,
): Promise<MailBody[]> {
  await runWorkerUntil(
    request,
    async () => (await mailBodies(request, email, subjectIncludes)).length >= count,
    `${subjectIncludes} のメールが${count}通届くこと`,
  );
  return mailBodies(request, email, subjectIncludes);
}

/** 店への要対応メール（宛先は E2E の固定の値）のうち、その注文の物。同じ宛先を他の試験も使うので、注文番号で絞る */
export async function shopAlertsFor(request: APIRequestContext, orderNumber: string): Promise<MailBody[]> {
  return (await mailBodies(request, SHOP_ALERT_TO, '【要対応】')).filter((mail) => mail.Text.includes(orderNumber));
}

// ---- 窓口の答えの組み立て（画面を窓口の差し替えで確かめる） ----

export const SHIPPED_AT = '2026-10-10T03:00:00.000Z';
export const FULFILLMENT_ID = 'f3b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f1';
export const ITEM_ID = 9001;
export const VARIANT_ID = 9101;

/** 返品の番号の表示（注文番号の末尾に -R と返品の番号を付ける。formatReturnNumber と同じ） */
export function returnLabelOf(orderId: string, number: number): string {
  return `${orderNumberOf(orderId)}-R${number}`;
}

type LineProgress = OrderReturnLineDetail['progress'];

const ZERO_PROGRESS: Omit<LineProgress, 'unprocessed'> = {
  restocked: 0,
  notRestocked: 0,
  pendingInspection: 0,
  sentBack: 0,
  missing: 0,
  processed: 0,
  exchanged: 0,
  refundCovered: 0,
  refundWaived: 0,
  refundWaiting: 0,
};

/** 交換の色・サイズの見本 */
export function exchangeOf(input: Partial<NonNullable<OrderReturnLineDetail['exchange']>> = {}): NonNullable<OrderReturnLineDetail['exchange']> {
  return {
    variantId: VARIANT_ID + 1,
    color: 'ホワイト',
    size: 'L',
    method: 'stock',
    stockQuantity: 3,
    madeToOrderLeadDays: 5,
    outOfStockExchange: 'decline' as OutOfStockExchange,
    ...input,
  };
}

/**
 * 返品の行の見本（既定は、シルクブラウス1点・返金・まだ何も処理していない）。
 * 処理した数（processed）・未処理の数（unprocessed）・返金の見込み（添字 k−1 は k 点分の商品の額）は、渡さなければ他の欄から出す。
 */
export function returnLineOf(input: {
  id: string;
  orderItemId: string;
  quantity?: number;
  itemName?: string;
  color?: string | null;
  size?: string | null;
  fulfillmentId?: string;
  reason?: ReturnReason;
  reasonNote?: string | null;
  exchange?: OrderReturnLineDetail['exchange'];
  progress?: Partial<LineProgress>;
  unitAmount?: number;
}): OrderReturnLineDetail {
  const quantity = input.quantity ?? 1;
  const unitAmount = input.unitAmount ?? PRICE;
  const done = { ...ZERO_PROGRESS, ...input.progress };
  const processed =
    input.progress?.processed ?? done.restocked + done.notRestocked + done.pendingInspection + done.sentBack + done.missing;
  const unprocessed = input.progress?.unprocessed ?? quantity - processed;
  const exchange = input.exchange ?? null;
  return {
    id: input.id,
    fulfillmentId: input.fulfillmentId ?? FULFILLMENT_ID,
    fulfillmentNumber: 1,
    orderItemId: input.orderItemId,
    itemName: input.itemName ?? 'シルクブラウス',
    color: input.color === undefined ? 'ホワイト' : input.color,
    size: input.size === undefined ? 'M' : input.size,
    quantity,
    reason: input.reason ?? 'size_too_small',
    reasonNote: input.reasonNote ?? null,
    resolution: exchange ? 'exchange' : 'refund',
    exchange,
    progress: { ...done, processed, unprocessed },
    // 交換の予定の行にも入れる（受け取りで「返金に変える」を選んだ時の見込みに使う。計画の冒頭 C-2）
    refundAmountsByCount: Array.from({ length: unprocessed }, (_, index) => unitAmount * (index + 1)),
    refundWaitingAmount: exchange ? 0 : unitAmount * done.refundWaiting,
  };
}

/** 返品の見本（既定は、お店が作った・返送はお客様が送る・受け取り待ちの返品中） */
export function returnDetailOf(input: {
  orderId: string;
  lines: OrderReturnLineDetail[];
  id?: string;
  number?: number;
  status?: ReturnStatus;
  displayStatus?: OrderReturnDetail['displayStatus'];
  marks?: OrderReturnDetail['marks'];
  returnMethod?: ReturnMethod;
  returnShippingPayer?: ShippingPayer;
  fees?: Partial<OrderReturnDetail['fees']>;
  firstReceiptDone?: boolean;
  firstExchangeReceiptDone?: boolean;
  refunds?: OrderReturnDetail['refunds'];
  receipts?: OrderReturnDetail['receipts'];
  exchangeItems?: OrderReturnDetail['exchangeItems'];
  shopNote?: string | null;
}): OrderReturnDetail {
  const number = input.number ?? 1;
  const status = input.status ?? 'open';
  return {
    id: input.id ?? `b3b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-00000000000${number}`,
    number,
    label: returnLabelOf(input.orderId, number),
    status,
    source: 'shop',
    displayStatus: input.displayStatus === undefined ? 'in_progress' : input.displayStatus,
    marks: input.marks ?? ['awaiting_items'],
    returnMethod: input.returnMethod ?? 'customer_ships',
    returnShippingPayer: input.returnShippingPayer ?? 'customer',
    returnCarrier: null,
    returnTrackingNumber: null,
    fees: {
      returnShippingFee: 0,
      restockingFeePercent: 0,
      exchangeFee: 0,
      exchangeShippingFee: 0,
      feeDueAmount: 0,
      // 相談の受け取りで付き、額を決めて返金する時に引く手数料（C-2 の必須の欄。額を決めて返金の画面が読む）
      feePendingDeduction: 0,
      feeReceivedAt: null,
      exchangeReleasedAt: null,
      ...input.fees,
    },
    firstReceiptDone: input.firstReceiptDone ?? false,
    firstExchangeReceiptDone: input.firstExchangeReceiptDone ?? false,
    shopNote: input.shopNote ?? null,
    notifyCustomer: true,
    createdAt: '2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z',
    createdByEmail: 'admin@example.com',
    closedAt: status === 'closed' ? '2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z' : null,
    cancelledAt: status === 'cancelled' ? '2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z' : null,
    lines: input.lines,
    refunds: input.refunds ?? [],
    receipts: input.receipts ?? [],
    exchangeItems: input.exchangeItems ?? [],
  };
}

/**
 * 注文の一覧の窓口（答えに returnAttention＝一覧の上の一行の数 つき）。読まれた URL を記録する。数は試験が呼び出しごとに替えられる。
 * 注文の番号つきの窓口（…/orders/{id}/…）と取り違えないよう、パスが一覧だけの時に当てる。
 */
export async function mockOrderListWithAttention(
  page: Page,
  current: () => OrderItem[],
  attention: () => { requested: number; refundWaiting: number },
): Promise<{ urls: string[] }> {
  const urls: string[] = [];
  await page.route(
    (url) => url.pathname === '/api/admin/orders',
    (route) => {
      urls.push(route.request().url());
      const orders = current();
      return fulfillJson(route, {
        data: orders,
        pagination: { page: 1, pageSize: 20, total: orders.length, totalPages: 1 },
        returnAttention: attention(),
      });
    },
  );
  return { urls };
}

export type ReturnAction =
  | 'receive'
  | 'refund'
  | 'cancel'
  | 'reopen'
  | 'close-missing'
  | 'inspect'
  | 'fee-payment'
  | 'release-exchange';

const RETURN_ACTIONS: readonly ReturnAction[] = [
  'receive',
  'refund',
  'cancel',
  'reopen',
  'close-missing',
  'inspect',
  'fee-payment',
  'release-exchange',
];

export type ReturnPost = { returnId: string; body: Record<string, unknown> };

export type ReturnRouteState = {
  /** GET …/returns の答え。試験が差し替えられる */
  returns: OrderReturnDetail[];
  canRefund: boolean;
  returnableUnits: number;
  refundableAmount: number;
  refundableShipping: number;
  /** 要検品を使うか（ショップの設定。GET …/returns の答えに入る欄で、受け取りの画面が「検品待ち」を選ばせるかを決める） */
  inspectionEnabled: boolean;
  /** GET …/returns/materials の答え */
  materials: ReturnCreateMaterials;
  listReads: number;
  materialsReads: number;
  createPosts: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  posts: Record<ReturnAction, ReturnPost[]>;
  /** POST …/returns（返品を作る）の答え。既定は「作れた」 */
  answerCreate: (route: Route, body: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>;
  /** POST …/returns/{returnId}/{action} の答え。既定は、操作ごとの「受け付けた」の答え */
  answerAction: (route: Route, action: ReturnAction, post: ReturnPost) => Promise<void>;
};

/** 受け取りの窓口の「受け付けた」答えの data（C-3）。既定は、返金の無い受け取り（返金の欄はどれも null。0円で終えた受け取りだけ refundAmount 0・refundStatus waived）で、返品は受付中のまま */
export function receiveData(input: Partial<Record<'receiptId' | 'returnStatus' | 'refundId' | 'refundAmount' | 'refundStatus' | 'feeDueAmount' | 'replayed', unknown>> = {}) {
  return {
    receiptId: randomUUID(),
    returnStatus: 'open',
    refundId: null,
    refundAmount: null,
    refundStatus: null,
    feeDueAmount: 0,
    replayed: false,
    ...input,
  };
}

/** 額を決めて返金の窓口の「受け付けた」答えの data（C-3）。0円なら refundId は null・status は waived */
export function refundData(input: { amount: number; status?: string; refundId?: string | null; replayed?: boolean }) {
  return {
    refundId: input.refundId === undefined ? randomUUID() : input.refundId,
    amount: input.amount,
    status: input.status ?? 'pending',
    replayed: input.replayed ?? false,
  };
}

function defaultActionData(action: ReturnAction): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (action === 'receive') return receiveData();
  if (action === 'refund') return refundData({ amount: 0 });
  return { returnStatus: 'open' };
}

export function newReturnRouteState(input: {
  orderId: string;
  returns?: OrderReturnDetail[];
  materials?: ReturnCreateMaterials;
  canRefund?: boolean;
  returnableUnits?: number;
  refundableAmount?: number;
  refundableShipping?: number;
}): ReturnRouteState {
  const state: ReturnRouteState = {
    returns: input.returns ?? [],
    canRefund: input.canRefund ?? true,
    returnableUnits: input.returnableUnits ?? 1,
    refundableAmount: input.refundableAmount ?? PRICE * 4,
    refundableShipping: input.refundableShipping ?? 0,
    inspectionEnabled: true,
    materials: input.materials ?? returnMaterialsOf({ orderId: input.orderId, shipments: [] }),
    listReads: 0,
    materialsReads: 0,
    createPosts: [],
    posts: {
      receive: [],
      refund: [],
      cancel: [],
      reopen: [],
      'close-missing': [],
      inspect: [],
      'fee-payment': [],
      'release-exchange': [],
    },
    answerCreate: (route) =>
      fulfillJson(route, { data: { returnId: randomUUID(), number: state.returns.length + 1, status: 'open', replayed: false } }),
    answerAction: (route, action) => fulfillJson(route, { data: defaultActionData(action) }),
  };
  return state;
}

/**
 * その注文の返品の窓口（一覧と中身・材料・作る）と、返品ごとの操作の窓口を差し替える。
 * 後から登録した窓口が先に効くので、管理画面の窓口（mockAdminSession・mockOrderList）を先に呼んでから、これを呼ぶ。
 */
export async function mockReturnRoutes(page: Page, orderId: string, state: ReturnRouteState): Promise<void> {
  await page.route(`**/api/admin/orders/${orderId}/returns/materials`, async (route) => {
    state.materialsReads += 1;
    await fulfillJson(route, { data: state.materials });
  });
  await page.route(`**/api/admin/orders/${orderId}/returns`, async (route) => {
    if (route.request().method() === 'GET') {
      state.listReads += 1;
      await fulfillJson(route, {
        data: {
          returns: state.returns,
          canRefund: state.canRefund,
          returnableUnits: state.returnableUnits,
          refundableAmount: state.refundableAmount,
          refundableShipping: state.refundableShipping,
          inspectionEnabled: state.inspectionEnabled,
        },
      });
      return;
    }
    const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as Record<string, unknown>;
    state.createPosts.push(body);
    await state.answerCreate(route, body);
  });
  await page.route(/\/api\/admin\/returns\/[^/]+\/[a-z-]+$/, async (route) => {
    const match = /\/api\/admin\/returns\/([^/]+)\/([a-z-]+)$/.exec(new URL(route.request().url()).pathname);
    const action = match?.[2] as ReturnAction | undefined;
    if (!match || !action || !RETURN_ACTIONS.includes(action)) {
      await route.fallback();
      return;
    }
    const post: ReturnPost = { returnId: match[1], body: (route.request().postDataJSON() ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown> };
    state.posts[action].push(post);
    await state.answerAction(route, action, post);
  });
}

/** 窓口に届いた受け取りの本文の units から、返品の行と状態ごとの数を合わせた数を読む（1行にまとめて送る作りでも、1点ずつ送る作りでも同じ値になる） */
export function unitTotal(body: Record<string, unknown>, lineId: string, disposition: ReceiptDisposition): number {
  const units = (body.units ?? []) as Array<{ returnLineId: string; disposition: string; quantity: number }>;
  return units
    .filter((unit) => unit.returnLineId === lineId && unit.disposition === disposition)
    .reduce((sum, unit) => sum + unit.quantity, 0);
}

// ---- 画面の操作と読み方（画面の作りへの頼り方はここにまとめる） ----

export const returnsDialogName = (orderId: string) => `返品（${orderNumberOf(orderId)}）`;
export const createDialogName = (orderId: string) => `返品を作る（${orderNumberOf(orderId)}）`;

/** 一覧のその注文の行の「返品」系のボタンを押して、返品の画面を開く。ボタンの名前は次にすること（返品・受け取る・額を決めて返金する・申し込みを確かめる） */
export async function openReturnsDialog(page: Page, orderId: string, buttonName = '返品'): Promise<Locator> {
  await page.getByRole('row', { name: new RegExp(orderId) }).getByRole('button', { name: buttonName, exact: true }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(orderId), exact: true });
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  await expect(dialog.getByText('読み込み中です...')).toHaveCount(0);
  return dialog;
}

/** 返品の画面の、その返品の欄（名前は返品の番号 ORD-XXXXXXXX-R1） */
export function returnCard(dialog: Locator, label: string): Locator {

}

/** 返品の画面の「返品を作る」を押して、返品を作る画面を開く（材料を読み終えるまで待つ） */
export async function openCreateDialog(page: Page, orderId: string): Promise<Locator> {
  const returns = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(orderId), exact: true });
  await returns.getByRole('button', { name: '返品を作る', exact: true }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: createDialogName(orderId), exact: true });
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  await expect(dialog.getByText('読み込み中です...')).toHaveCount(0);
  return dialog;

/** 返品を作る画面の、品の欄（名前は 品名（色 / サイズ）。交換の品の行は末尾に（交換の品）） */
export function createLineGroup(dialog: Locator, label: string): Locator {
  return dialog.getByRole('group', { name: label, exact: true });
}

/** 返品の画面の、その返品の欄のボタンを押して、操作の画面（受け取り・額を決めて返金・検品など）を開く */
export async function openOperationDialog(
  page: Page,
  orderId: string,
  label: string,
  buttonName: string,
  dialogTitle: string,
): Promise<Locator> {
  const returns = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(orderId), exact: true });

export const openReceiveDialog = (page: Page, orderId: string, label: string) =>
  openOperationDialog(page, orderId, label, '受け取る', RETURN_TEXT.receiveTitle(label));

export const openReturnRefundDialog = (page: Page, orderId: string, label: string) =>
  openOperationDialog(page, orderId, label, '額を決めて返金する', RETURN_TEXT.refundTitle(label));

/**
 * 受け取りの画面の、まだ処理していない i 番目（0 始まり）の点に、「届いた」のチェックを入れて、状態を選ぶ。
 * 点は list（名前 受け取る品）の listitem で、前の受け取りで処理した点は選びの無い固定の行なので、選び（品の状態）の順で数える。
 */
export async function setUnitState(dialog: Locator, index: number, state: UnitState): Promise<void> {
  const select = dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: '品の状態', exact: true }).nth(index);
  const row = select.locator('xpath=ancestor::*[self::li or @role="listitem"][1]');
  await row.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '届いた', exact: true }).check();
  await select.selectOption({ label: state });
}

/** 受け取りの画面の、点の行（前の受け取りで処理した固定の行も含む） */
export function unitRows(dialog: Locator): Locator {
  return dialog.getByRole('list', { name: '受け取る品' }).getByRole('listitem');
}

/** 受け取りの画面の返金の選び（計算どおり・相談） */
export async function chooseRefundChoice(dialog: Locator, choice: 'now' | 'consult'): Promise<void> {
  const radio = dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: choice === 'now' ? RETURN_TEXT.nowOption : RETURN_TEXT.consultOption });
  await radio.check();
}

/** 受け取りの画面の確定のボタン（名前は中身で変わる） */
export function confirmButton(dialog: Locator, name: string): Locator {
  return dialog.getByRole('button', { name, exact: true });
}

/** 操作の画面の内訳（group 返金の内訳。商品・返送料・返品の手数料・返金額など）を、項目名 → 金額の文字で読む。項目名は dt、金額は次の dd（E-2 の返金の画面と同じ作り） */
export async function readReturnBreakdown(dialog: Locator): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  return dialog.getByRole('group', { name: '返金の内訳', exact: true }).evaluate((node) => {
    const rows: Record<string, string> = {};
    node.querySelectorAll('dt').forEach((term) => {
      rows[(term.textContent ?? '').trim()] = (term.nextElementSibling?.textContent ?? '').trim();
    });
    return rows;
  });
}

export { formatYen };
```

- [ ] **Step 2: `FR-ADMIN-084` 返品を作る**

`e2e/FR-ADMIN-084-return-create.spec.ts`（新規。11件。FREQ-462-AC-01〜07・09・10、FREQ-469-AC-01。573行）。11件×3画面幅。返品が無い注文の空の欄と「返品できる品: あと{n}点」、作る画面の発送ごとの見出しと受付の期限（過ぎていても作れる）、交換の色・サイズと「在庫: {n}」と送り方、「交換にする数」で同じ発送の行を返金と交換の2行に分けて窓口へ送ること、円の欄の上限と返品の手数料（%）の誤り、返送先が無い時の文、作った後の知らせと読み直し、窓口の断りと新しい二重防止の番号を、窓口を差し替えて確かめる。作る DB の関数（二重防止・返品できる数・交換の色・サイズ・理由「その他」のメモ・2行に分けた作り方・R2 の番号）と、受付のお知らせのメール（Mailpit）は、手元の DB で確かめる。

```ts
    test('窓口が断った時は、断りの文が画面の中に出て入力が残り、送り直しは新しい二重防止の番号で送られる', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-462-AC-06
      const state = newReturnRouteState({ orderId: ORDER_ID, returnableUnits: 3, materials: twoShipmentMaterials() });
      const refusal = '返品できる数を超えています。画面を開き直してください。';

        attempts += 1;
        if (attempts === 1) {
          await fulfillJson(route, { error: refusal, code: 'RETURN_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS' }, 409);
          return;
        }
        await fulfillJson(route, { data: { returnId: randomUUID(), number: 1, status: 'open', replayed: false } });
      };
      await openReturns(page, state);
      const create = await openCreateDialog(page, ORDER_ID);
      const quantity = createLineGroup(create, 'シルクブラウス（ホワイト / M）').getByLabel('返品する数', { exact: true });

      await quantity.fill('2');
      await create.getByRole('button', { name: '返品を作る', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(create.getByRole('alert')).toContainText(refusal);
      // 画面は閉じず、入力は残る
      await expect(quantity).toHaveValue('2');
      await expect(create.getByRole('button', { name: '返品を作る', exact: true })).toBeEnabled();

      await create.getByRole('button', { name: '返品を作る', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: `返品を作る（${orderNumberOf(ORDER_ID)}）` })).toHaveCount(0);
      expect(state.createPosts).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(state.createPosts[1].requestKey).not.toBe(state.createPosts[0].requestKey);
      expect(state.createPosts[1].lines).toEqual(state.createPosts[0].lines);
    });

    test('作る DB の関数は、返品（R1・受付中）と行を記録し、二重防止・返品できる数・交換の色・サイズ・理由「その他」のメモを守る。2件目は R2 になる（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-462-AC-07
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `create-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const [shirt, skirt] = fx.orderItemIds;
        const key = randomUUID();

        // 作る: R1・受付中。行は返金で、理由は入れた物
        const first = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { requestKey: key, lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }] });
        expect(first).toMatchObject({ number: 1, status: 'open', replayed: false });
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, first.returnId)).toMatchObject({
          number: 1,
          source: 'shop',
          status: 'open',
          return_method: 'customer_ships',
          notify_customer: true,
        });
        expect(await returnLineRowOf(db, first.lineIds[shirt])).toMatchObject({
          quantity: 1,
          reason: 'size_too_small',
          resolution: 'refund',
          exchange_variant_id: null,
          exchange_method: null,
        });
        expect(await returnableByItem(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual({ [shirt]: 1, [skirt]: 1 });

        // 二重防止: 同じ番号で同じ中身は前の結果、違う中身は断る
        expect(await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { requestKey: key, lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }] })).toMatchObject({
          returnId: first.returnId,
          number: 1,
          replayed: true,
        });
        await expectDbError(createReturnInDb(db, fx, { requestKey: key, lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }] }), 'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH');

        // 断り: 返品できる数の超過・「その他」のメモ・交換の色・サイズ（別の商品の物）
        await expectDbError(createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }] }), 'RETURN_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS');
        await expectDbError(
          createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: skirt, quantity: 1, reason: 'other' }] }),
          'RETURN_REASON_NOTE_REQUIRED',
        );
        const otherItem = await createCatalogFixture(db, { stock: 1, itemStatus: 'private' });
        await expectDbError(
          createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: skirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: otherItem.variantId, method: 'stock' } }] }),
          'RETURN_EXCHANGE_VARIANT_INVALID',
        );
        // 断られた操作は何も残さない
        expect(await returnCountOf(db, fx.orderId)).toBe(1);

        // 2件目: 同じ商品の別の色・サイズへの交換。番号は R2
        const variantId = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ブラック', size: 'L', stock: 2 });
        const second = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: skirt, quantity: 1, reason: 'other', reasonNote: '色味が違う', exchange: { variantId, method: 'stock' } }],
        });
        expect(second).toMatchObject({ number: 2, status: 'open', replayed: false });
        expect(await returnLineRowOf(db, second.lineIds[skirt])).toMatchObject({
          reason: 'other',
          reason_note: '色味が違う',
          resolution: 'exchange',
          exchange_method: 'stock',
        });
        expect(Number((await returnLineRowOf(db, second.lineIds[skirt])).exchange_variant_id)).toBe(variantId);
        expect(await returnableByItem(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual({ [shirt]: 1, [skirt]: 0 });
        // 交換の品の行は、受け取るまで足されない
        expect(await exchangeItemRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test('同じ発送の同じ商品を、返金の行と交換の行の2つに分けて、1つの返品に作れる。2行の合計が返品できる数を超えると断る（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-462-AC-09
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `create-split-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 3, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantId = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ブラック', size: 'L', stock: 2 });
        const split = (): Parameters<typeof createReturnInDb>[2] => ({
          lines: [
            { orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 },
            { orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId, method: 'stock' } },
          ],
        });

        // 3点のうち、返金1点と交換1点。返品は1つ、行は2つ（返金の行と交換の行）
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, split());
        expect(created).toMatchObject({ number: 1, status: 'open', replayed: false });
        expect(created.lineRows.map((line) => [line.resolution, line.quantity])).toEqual([
          ['exchange', 1],
          ['refund', 1],
        ]);
        const exchangeLine = created.lineRows.find((line) => line.resolution === 'exchange');
        expect(exchangeLine && (await returnLineRowOf(db, exchangeLine.id))).toMatchObject({ exchange_method: 'stock' });
        // 返品できる数は、2行の合計（2点）だけ減る
        expect(await returnableByItem(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual({ [shirt]: 1 });

        // 1行ずつなら残り（1点）に収まるが、2行の合計（2点）は超える。合計で確かめて断り、何も残さない
        await expectDbError(createReturnInDb(db, fx, split()), 'RETURN_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS');
        expect(await returnCountOf(db, fx.orderId)).toBe(1);
        expect(await returnableByItem(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual({ [shirt]: 1 });
      });
    });

    test('お知らせを入れて作ると、返品の受付のお知らせが1通届き、返品番号・返送する品・返送のしかた・返送先が載る（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-01
      // worker の入口は Stripe の知らせの処理と注文のメールの送信を続けて動かすので、既定の30秒では足りないことがある
      test.setTimeout(180_000);
      const { fx, created } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `create-mail-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: fx.orderItemIds[0], quantity: 1 }], notify: true });
        return { fx, created };
      });
      const orderNumber = orderNumberOf(fx.orderId);
      const label = returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, 1);

      const mails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.accepted);
      await runWorkerUntil(
        request,
        async () => (await sentReturnMailCount(fx.orderId, 'return_accepted')) >= 1,
        '返品の受付のお知らせが送信済みになること',
      );
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(mails[0].Subject).toBe(`【Le Fil des Heures】${RETURN_MAIL.accepted}（${orderNumber}）`);
      const text = mails[0].Text;
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.accepted1(orderNumber, label));
      expect(text).toContain('ご返送いただく商品:');
      expect(text).toContain('・E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / M） × 1');
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.sendTo);
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.customerPays);
      expect(text).toContain('返送先:');
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_ADDRESS.name);
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_ADDRESS.address);
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_ADDRESS.phone);
      // 受付のお知らせの予定は、この返品に結び付いた1行だけ
      const rows = await withLocalDb(async (db) =>
        (await db.query(`select return_id from private.order_email_outbox where order_id = $1 and kind = 'return_accepted'`, [fx.orderId])).rows,
      );
      expect(rows).toEqual([{ return_id: created.returnId }]);
    });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: `FR-ADMIN-085` 受け取りと、受け取りと一緒の返金**

`e2e/FR-ADMIN-085-return-receive-refund.spec.ts`（新規。13件。FREQ-463-AC-01・02、FREQ-464-AC-01〜05・15、FREQ-467-AC-01・02、FREQ-469-AC-02・03。531行）。13件×3画面幅。受け取りの画面（1点ずつ1行・状態・進み具合・「計算どおり」が最初に選ばれる・見込みの内訳・返送料は最初の受け取りだけ・店長が直した額・答えが分からない時の確かめ直し・0円の言葉）は窓口を差し替えて確かめる。受け取りの DB の動き（受け取りの行・在庫の台帳・返金の記録の道 `return`・手数料の引き方・二重防止・0円の `waived`）と、メール（返金のお知らせの返品の書き分け、0円と Stripe に受け付けられずエラーの時の「返品をお受け取りしました」）は手元の DB と Mailpit で確かめる。

```ts
/**
 * FR-ADMIN-085 受け取りと、受け取りと一緒の返金（今返金）
 * 対応 FREQ: FREQ-463（AC-01・AC-02）、FREQ-464（AC-01〜AC-05・AC-15）、FREQ-467（AC-01・AC-02）、FREQ-469（AC-02・AC-03）
 *
 * 受け取りの画面は窓口の答えを差し替えて確かめ（窓口に届く本文と、答えが分からない時の確かめ直し）、受け取りが DB に書くもの
 * （受け取りの行・在庫の台帳・返金の記録・返品の状態・メールの予定）は、窓口が呼ぶのと同じ DB の関数を手元の DB に直に呼んで確かめる
 * （実装計画 P11）。Stripe には頼まず、返金の結果はこちらで書く（Stripe に頼む部分は単体の試験と DB 結合が確かめる）。
 */
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  expectDbError,
  markRefundError,
  recordRefundResult,
  refundLineRows,
  runWorkerUntil,
  sentOutboxCount,
  variantStockState,
  withLocalDb,
} from './order-email-test-utils';
import {
  UUID_PATTERN,
  fulfillJson,
  mockOrderList,
  openOrderTab,
  orderNumberOf,
  viewports,
} from './order-fulfillment-test-utils';
import { MINUS, mockAdminSessionAs } from './refund-test-utils';
import {
  RETURN_MAIL,
  RETURN_TEXT,
  UNIT_STATES,
  chooseRefundChoice,
  confirmButton,
  createReturnInDb,
  createShippedOrder,
  formatYen,
  mockReturnRoutes,
  newReturnRouteState,
  openReceiveDialog,
  openReturnsDialog,
  orderWithReturns,
  readReturnBreakdown,
  receiptRows,
  receiptUnitRows,
  receiveData,
  receiveReturnInDb,
  returnDetailOf,
  returnEmailRows,
  returnLabelOf,
  returnLedger,
  returnLineOf,
  returnRefundRows,
  returnRowOf,
  returnSummaryOf,
  returnSummaryRow,
  returnsDialogName,
  setUnitState,
  unitTotal,
  waitForMails,
} from './return-test-utils';
import type { OrderReturnDetail, ReturnMethod } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

const ORDER_ID = 'a5b2c3d4-0085-4000-8000-000000000085';
const SHIRT = 'c5b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LINE = 'd5b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const RETURN_ID = 'b5b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 1);

type ReceiveSetup = {
  /** 返品の数（既定 2） */
  quantity?: number;
  /** すでに受け取って処理した数（その分は未処理から外れる） */
  processed?: number;
  returnMethod?: ReturnMethod;
  fees?: Partial<OrderReturnDetail['fees']>;
  firstReceiptDone?: boolean;
};

/** 一覧の「受け取る」→ 返品の画面 → 受け取りの画面まで開く。窓口は差し替える（単価は5,000円、返せる額は20,000円） */
async function openReceive(page: Page, options: ReceiveSetup = {}) {
  const line = returnLineOf({
    id: LINE,
    orderItemId: SHIRT,
    quantity: options.quantity ?? 2,
    itemName: 'E2Eシャツ',
    progress: options.processed ? { restocked: options.processed } : undefined,
  });
  const detail = returnDetailOf({
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    id: RETURN_ID,
    lines: [line],
    returnMethod: options.returnMethod,
    fees: options.fees,
    firstReceiptDone: options.firstReceiptDone,
    marks: options.processed ? ['partially_received'] : ['awaiting_items'],
  });
  const state = newReturnRouteState({ orderId: ORDER_ID, returns: [detail], returnableUnits: 0, refundableAmount: 20_000 });
  await mockAdminSessionAs(page, 'admin');
  await mockOrderList(page, () => [
    orderWithReturns({
      id: ORDER_ID,
      summary: returnSummaryOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        displayStatus: 'in_progress',
        marks: detail.marks,
        nextAction: 'receive',
        hasReturnable: false,
      }),
    }),
  ]);
  await mockReturnRoutes(page, ORDER_ID, state);
  await openOrderTab(page);
  await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');
  const dialog = await openReceiveDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL);
  return { state, dialog };
}

for (const viewport of viewports) {
  test.describe(`FR-ADMIN-085 return receive and refund (${viewport.name})`, () => {
    test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
    });

    test('受け取りの画面は品を1点ずつ1行に出し、状態を選ぶと進み具合とボタンの言葉が変わる。返金は「計算どおり」が最初に選ばれ、窓口へ「今返金」が届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-01, FREQ-464-AC-01
      const { state, dialog } = await openReceive(page);
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: '品の状態', exact: true })).toHaveCount(2);
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.progress(2, 0))).toBeVisible();

      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.progress(2, 1))).toBeVisible();
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receivePart(1, formatYen(5_000)))).toBeVisible();
      await setUnitState(dialog, 1, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.progress(2, 2))).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: `計算どおり ${formatYen(10_000)} を返金する`, exact: true })).toBeChecked();

      state.answerAction = (route) =>
        fulfillJson(route, {
          data: receiveData({ returnStatus: 'closed', refundId: randomUUID(), refundAmount: 10_000, refundStatus: 'succeeded' }),
        });
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(10_000))).click();

      const returns = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true });
      await expect(returns.getByRole('status')).toContainText(RETURN_TEXT.noticeRefunded);
      expect(state.posts.receive).toHaveLength(1);
      const post = state.posts.receive[0];
      expect(post.returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      expect(post.body).toMatchObject({ refundChoice: 'now', notifyCustomer: true });
      expect(post.body.refundAmount ?? null).toBeNull();
      expect(String(post.body.requestKey)).toMatch(UUID_PATTERN);
      expect(unitTotal(post.body, LINE, 'restocked')).toBe(2);
    });

    test('見込みの内訳に、返送料と返品の手数料が出て、返金額とボタンの額が一致する。返送料は最初の受け取りだけに付く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-467-AC-01
      const first = await openReceive(page, { returnMethod: 'shop_label', fees: { returnShippingFee: 800, restockingFeePercent: 10 } });
      await setUnitState(first.dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await setUnitState(first.dialog, 1, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      expect(await readReturnBreakdown(first.dialog)).toMatchObject({
        '商品': formatYen(10_000),
        '返送料': `${MINUS}${formatYen(800)}`,
        '返品の手数料': `${MINUS}${formatYen(1_000)}`,
        '返金額': formatYen(8_200),
      });
      await expect(confirmButton(first.dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(8_200)))).toBeVisible();

      // 1点を受け取った後の2回目: 返送料は引かず、返品の手数料だけを引く（画面を開き直す）
      const second = await openReceive(page, {
        returnMethod: 'shop_label',
        fees: { returnShippingFee: 800, restockingFeePercent: 10 },
        processed: 1,
        firstReceiptDone: true,
      });
      await setUnitState(second.dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      const breakdown = await readReturnBreakdown(second.dialog);
      expect(breakdown).toMatchObject({ '商品': formatYen(5_000), '返品の手数料': `${MINUS}${formatYen(500)}`, '返金額': formatYen(4_500) });
      expect(Object.keys(breakdown)).not.toContain('返送料');
      await expect(confirmButton(second.dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(4_500)))).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('店長は返金額を直せて、その額が窓口へ届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-02
      const { state, dialog } = await openReceive(page);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 1, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await dialog.getByLabel(RETURN_TEXT.refundAmountLabel(formatYen(20_000)), { exact: true }).fill('7000');
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(7_000)))).toBeVisible();

      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(7_000))).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({ refundChoice: 'now', refundAmount: 7_000 });
    });

    test('答えが分からない時（通信の切れ）は入力を止め、「もう一度確かめる」と「閉じる」だけを出し、同じ二重防止の番号・同じ中身で確かめ直す', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-03
      // ここで確かめるのは通信の切れ。窓口が 500・502 を返した時の同じ動きは、単体の試験（OrderReturnReceiveDialog）が確かめる
      const { state, dialog } = await openReceive(page, { quantity: 1 });
      let attempt = 0;
      state.answerAction = async (route) => {
        attempt += 1;
        if (attempt === 1) {
          await route.abort('failed');
          return;
        }
        await fulfillJson(route, {
          data: receiveData({
            returnStatus: 'closed',
            refundId: randomUUID(),
            refundAmount: 5_000,
            refundStatus: 'succeeded',
            replayed: true,
          }),
        });
      };
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(5_000))).click();

      await expect(dialog.getByRole('alert')).toContainText(RETURN_TEXT.unknownReceive);
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(5_000)))).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'もう一度確かめる', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '閉じる', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: '品の状態', exact: true })).toBeDisabled();

      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'もう一度確かめる', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true }).getByRole('status')).toContainText(
        RETURN_TEXT.noticeRefunded,
      );
      expect(state.posts.receive).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(state.posts.receive[1].body.requestKey).toBe(state.posts.receive[0].body.requestKey);
      expect(state.posts.receive[1].body).toEqual(state.posts.receive[0].body);
    });

    test('今返金の額が0円になる時（手数料が商品の額以上）は、確定のボタンが「…、返金なしで記録する」になり、窓口へ今返金が届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-15
      const { state, dialog } = await openReceive(page, { quantity: 1, fees: { restockingFeePercent: 100 } });
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllWaived())).toBeVisible();
      expect(await readReturnBreakdown(dialog)).toMatchObject({ '返金額': formatYen(0) });

      state.answerAction = (route) =>
        fulfillJson(route, {
          data: receiveData({ returnStatus: 'closed', refundId: null, refundAmount: 0, refundStatus: 'waived' }),
        });
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllWaived()).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({ refundChoice: 'now' });
      expect(unitTotal(state.posts.receive[0].body, LINE, 'restocked')).toBe(1);
    });

    test('返金の選びを「相談」に替えると、確定のボタンの言葉が替わる（受け取りの画面の選びが動くこと）', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-01
      const { dialog } = await openReceive(page, { quantity: 1 });
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: RETURN_TEXT.nowOption })).toBeChecked();
      await chooseRefundChoice(dialog, 'consult');
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.consultButton)).toBeVisible();
      await chooseRefundChoice(dialog, 'now');
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAll(formatYen(5_000)))).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('今返金の受け取りは、受け取りの行・在庫の台帳（返品の受け取り）・返金の記録（道 return・返品の番号つき）を1回で書き、品が全部処理されると返品が完了する（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-02, FREQ-464-AC-04
      // ここで確かめるのは、在庫に戻した品の台帳と受け取りの行。戻さない・お返しの品が在庫を動かさないことは、088・089 の試験が確かめる
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `now-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const [shirt] = fx.orderItemIds;
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }] });
        const lineId = created.lineIds[shirt];
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(0);

        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 2 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });
        expect(received).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 10_000, returnStatus: 'closed', replayed: false });
        expect(received.refundId).not.toBeNull();
        const refundId = received.refundId as string;

        // 返金の記録: 道 return・返品の番号つき・商品の行の在庫の戻し方は return（在庫は受け取りで動かすので、返金では動かさない）
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([
          { id: refundId, return_id: created.returnId, source: 'return', status: 'awaiting_response', amount: 10_000 },
        ]);
        expect(await refundLineRows(db, refundId)).toEqual([
          expect.objectContaining({ order_item_id: shirt, quantity: 2, before_shipment: false, restock_type: 'return' }),
        ]);
        // 受け取りの記録と行（品ごとの扱い）
        expect(await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).toEqual([
          expect.objectContaining({ id: received.receiptId, kind: 'receive', refund_choice: 'now', refund_id: refundId }),
        ]);
        expect(await receiptUnitRows(db, received.receiptId)).toEqual([
          { disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 2, resolution: 'refund', exchange_method: null },
        ]);
        // 在庫の台帳: 返品の受け取り（return）の +2 が、返品の番号つきで1行。すぐ出せる数が増える
        expect(await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([
          { reason: 'return', delta: 2, return_id: created.returnId, variant_id: fx.variantId },
        ]);
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(2);

        // Stripe が受け付けた結果を書いても、在庫はもう一度動かず、返品は完了のまま
        expect(await recordRefundResult(db, refundId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded' });
        expect((await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => row.delta)).toEqual([2]);
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).status).toBe('closed');
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'returned', next_action: 'none' });
      });
    });

    test('今返金は返金額から手数料を引き、返送料は最初の受け取りにだけ付く。返品の手数料は受け取った品の額に対して毎回計算する（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-467-AC-02
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `fees-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }],
          method: 'shop_label',
          returnShippingFee: 800,
          restockingFeePercent: 10,
        });
        const lineId = created.lineIds[shirt];
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).toMatchObject({
          return_method: 'shop_label',
          return_shipping_fee: 800,
          restocking_fee_percent: 10,
        });

        // 1回目: 5,000円 − 返送料 800円 − 返品の手数料 500円（5,000円の10%）
        const first = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });
        expect(first).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 3_700, returnStatus: 'open', feeDueAmount: 0 });
        await recordRefundResult(db, first.refundId as string);

        // 2回目: 返送料は引かない。5,000円 − 返品の手数料 500円
        const second = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });
        expect(second).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 4_500, returnStatus: 'closed', feeDueAmount: 0 });
        expect((await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => row.amount)).toEqual([3_700, 4_500]);
      });
    });

    test('同じ二重防止の番号の送り直しは、受け取り・在庫・返金の記録を増やさず前の結果を返し、違う中身は断る（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-05
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `replay-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }] });
        const units = [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked' as const, quantity: 1 }];
        const requestKey = randomUUID();

        const first = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { requestKey, units, choice: 'now' });
        const again = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { requestKey, units, choice: 'now' });
        expect(again).toMatchObject({ receiptId: first.receiptId, refundId: first.refundId, replayed: true });
        expect(await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).toHaveLength(1);
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(1);

        // Stripe の結果を書いた後の送り直しは、結果の状態を返す（もう一度頼まない）
        await recordRefundResult(db, first.refundId as string);
        expect((await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { requestKey, units, choice: 'now' })).refundStatus).toBe('succeeded');

        await expectDbError(
          receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { requestKey, units, choice: 'consult' }),
          'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH',
        );
        expect(await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).toHaveLength(1);
      });
    });

    test('今返金の額が0円になる時は、返金の記録を作らず「返金しない」数として受け取りに残し、在庫は戻す。手数料が商品の額に収まる時は返品が完了し、超える時は引けなかった手数料がお支払い待ちに残る（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-15
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `waived-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        // 返品の手数料が100%なので、商品の額と同じ手数料が付き、返金は0円になる（引けなかった手数料は残らない）
        // メールの予定を種類で完全一致に比べるので、作る時の受付のお知らせ（return_accepted）は入れない
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], restockingFeePercent: 100, notify: false });
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });

        expect(received).toMatchObject({
          refundId: null,
          refundAmount: 0,
          refundStatus: 'waived',
          feeDueAmount: 0,
          returnStatus: 'closed',
        });
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await receiptUnitRows(db, received.receiptId)).toEqual([
          { disposition: 'refund_waived', quantity: 1, resolution: null, exchange_method: null },
          { disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1, resolution: 'refund', exchange_method: null },
        ]);
        expect((await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => row.delta)).toEqual([1]);
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'returned', next_action: 'none' });
        // お客様へのメールの予定は、返金のお知らせではなく「返品をお受け取りしました」が1行（実装計画 P20・P24）
        expect((await returnEmailRows(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['return_received']);

        // 手数料が商品の額を超える時（返送料 800円 + 返品の手数料 100%）も、返金は0円で記録を作らず、引けなかった手数料 800円は
        // お支払い待ち（fee_due_amount）に残り、返品は完了しない（シャツは2点なので、残りの1点で2つ目の返品を作る）
        const over = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }],
          method: 'shop_label',
          returnShippingFee: 800,
          restockingFeePercent: 100,
          notify: false,
        });
        const overReceived = await receiveReturnInDb(db, over.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: over.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
          notify: false,
        });
        expect(overReceived).toMatchObject({ refundId: null, refundAmount: 0, refundStatus: 'waived', feeDueAmount: 800, returnStatus: 'open' });
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, over.returnId)).toMatchObject({ fee_due_amount: 800, fee_received_at: null });
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test('今返金の額が0円になる受け取りは、返金のお知らせを送らず、「返品をお受け取りしました」を1通送って「ご返金の額が0円のため、ご返金はございません。」と伝える（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-03
      test.setTimeout(180_000);
      const { fx, label } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `waived-mail-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        // メールの予定を種類で完全一致に比べるので、作る時の受付のお知らせ（return_accepted）は入れない
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], restockingFeePercent: 100, notify: false });
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
          notify: true,
        });
        return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
      });

      const mails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.received);
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(mails[0].Subject).toBe(`【Le Fil des Heures】${RETURN_MAIL.received}（${orderNumberOf(fx.orderId)}）`);
      expect(mails[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(label));
      expect(mails[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.refundZero);
      // 相談の文は入らず、返金のお知らせの予定も書かれない（返金の記録が無いため）
      expect(mails[0].Text).not.toContain(RETURN_MAIL.consult);
      const rows = await withLocalDb((db) => returnEmailRows(db, fx.orderId));
      expect(rows.map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['return_received']);
    });

    test('今返金が Stripe に受け付けられずエラーになった受け取りは、返金のお知らせが出ないので、「返品をお受け取りしました」が1通届き、相談の文が入る（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-03（実装計画 P25）
      test.setTimeout(180_000);
      const { fx, label } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `error-mail-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        // メールの予定を種類で完全一致に比べるので、作る時の受付のお知らせ（return_accepted）は入れない
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], notify: false });
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
          notify: true,
        });
        // Stripe の返事を待つ間は、お客様へのメールの予定は何も書かない
        expect(await returnEmailRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        // Stripe が受け付けなかった（その場で断られた、または答えが分からないまま見回りがエラーにした）
        await markRefundError(db, received.refundId as string, 'stripe_rejected');
        return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
      });

      const mails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.received);
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(mails[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(label));
      expect(mails[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.consult);
      expect(mails[0].Text).not.toContain(RETURN_MAIL.refundZero);
      const rows = await withLocalDb((db) => returnEmailRows(db, fx.orderId));
      expect(rows.map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['return_received']);
    });

    test('受け取りと一緒に返金したお知らせに、返品の受け取りの文が入り、「返金した商品はお送りしません。」は入らない（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-02
      test.setTimeout(180_000);
      const { fx, label } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `refund-mail-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }] });
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
          notify: true,
        });
        // Stripe が受け付けた時に、返金のお知らせの予定が1行書かれる
        expect(await recordRefundResult(db, received.refundId as string)).toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded', emailEnqueued: true });
        return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
      });
      const orderNumber = orderNumberOf(fx.orderId);

      await runWorkerUntil(request, async () => (await sentOutboxCount(fx.orderId, 'refund')) >= 1, '返金のお知らせが送信済みになること');
      const mails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.refund);
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(mails[0].Subject).toBe(`【Le Fil des Heures】${RETURN_MAIL.refund}（${orderNumber}）`);
      const text = mails[0].Text;
      const lead = text.indexOf(RETURN_MAIL.refundLead(orderNumber));
      const receivedLine = text.indexOf(RETURN_MAIL.received1(label));
      expect(lead).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      expect(receivedLine).toBeGreaterThan(lead);
      expect(text).not.toContain(RETURN_MAIL.notShipping);
    });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: `FR-ADMIN-086` 一部の受け取り・届かない・開き直し・取消・検品**

`e2e/FR-ADMIN-086-return-partial-missing-cancel.spec.ts`（新規。8件。FREQ-463-AC-03〜09。351行）。8件×3画面幅。一部だけ届いた時の確かめ、「残りは届かないものとして返品を終える」、開き直し、取消、検品の画面を、窓口を差し替えて確かめる。一部の受け取り → 届かないで終える → 開き直し → 残りの受け取りで数・状態・在庫の台帳が合うこと、受け取り後の取消の断りと取消後にまた返品できること、検品で決めた分だけ在庫が増えて返金待ちになることを、手元の DB で確かめる。

```ts
/**
 * FR-ADMIN-086 一部の受け取り・届かないで終える・開き直し・取消・検品
 * 対応 FREQ: FREQ-463（AC-03〜AC-09）
 *
 * 画面（受け取りの確かめ・届かないで終える・開き直し・取消・検品の画面）は窓口の答えを差し替えて確かめ、数・状態・在庫の台帳は、
 * 窓口が呼ぶのと同じ DB の関数を手元の DB に直に呼んで確かめる（実装計画 P11）。返金は「相談」で受け取るので Stripe には関わらない。
 */
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { expectDbError, recordRefundResult, variantStockState, withLocalDb } from './order-email-test-utils';
import { UUID_PATTERN, fulfillJson, mockOrderList, openOrderTab, viewports } from './order-fulfillment-test-utils';
import { mockAdminSessionAs } from './refund-test-utils';
import {
  RETURN_TEXT,
  UNIT_STATES,
  cancelReturnInDb,
  closeMissingInDb,
  confirmButton,
  createReturnInDb,
  createShippedOrder,
  formatYen,
  inspectReturnInDb,
  lineProgressOf,
  mockReturnRoutes,
  newReturnRouteState,
  openOperationDialog,
  openReceiveDialog,
  openReturnsDialog,
  orderWithReturns,
  receiptRows,
  receiveReturnInDb,
  reopenReturnInDb,
  returnCard,
  returnDetailOf,
  returnLabelOf,
  returnLedger,
  returnLineOf,
  returnRowOf,
  returnSummaryOf,
  returnSummaryRow,
  returnableByItem,
  returnsDialogName,
  setUnitState,
  unitTotal,
  type ReturnRouteState,
} from './return-test-utils';
import type { OrderReturnDetail } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

const ORDER_ID = 'a6b2c3d4-0086-4000-8000-000000000086';
const SHIRT = 'c6b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LINE = 'd6b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const SECOND_LINE = 'd6b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const RETURN_ID = 'b6b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const SECOND_RETURN_ID = 'b6b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 1);
const SECOND_LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 2);

/** 一覧の窓口と返品の窓口を差し替えて、ORDER タブを開く。返品の欄に出す返品を渡す */
async function openList(page: Page, returns: OrderReturnDetail[], summary: Parameters<typeof returnSummaryOf>[0]) {
  const state: ReturnRouteState = newReturnRouteState({ orderId: ORDER_ID, returns, returnableUnits: 0, refundableAmount: 20_000 });
  await mockAdminSessionAs(page, 'admin');
  await mockOrderList(page, () => [orderWithReturns({ id: ORDER_ID, summary: returnSummaryOf(summary) })]);
  await mockReturnRoutes(page, ORDER_ID, state);
  await openOrderTab(page);
  return state;
}

/** 受け付け中の返品1つ（シャツ2点・受け取り待ち）の受け取りの画面まで開く */
async function openReceive(page: Page) {
  const detail = returnDetailOf({
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    id: RETURN_ID,
    lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 2, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ' })],
  });
  const state = await openList(page, [detail], {
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    displayStatus: 'in_progress',
    marks: ['awaiting_items'],
    nextAction: 'receive',
    hasReturnable: false,
  });
  await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');
  const dialog = await openReceiveDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL);
  return { state, dialog };
}

for (const viewport of viewports) {
  test.describe(`FR-ADMIN-086 return partial, missing, cancel (${viewport.name})`, () => {
    test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
    });

    test('一部だけ届いた時は、押す前に確かめが出る。「戻る」では何も送らず、「記録する」で届いた分だけが窓口へ届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-03
      const { state, dialog } = await openReceive(page);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receivePart(1, formatYen(5_000))).click();

      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.partialConfirm(1))).toBeVisible();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '戻る', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.partialConfirm(1))).toHaveCount(0);
      expect(state.posts.receive).toHaveLength(0);

      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receivePart(1, formatYen(5_000))).click();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '記録する', exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      expect(unitTotal(state.posts.receive[0].body, LINE, 'restocked')).toBe(1);
    });

    test('「残りは届かないものとして返品を終える」は、確かめの文が出て、「返品を終える」で窓口へ届く。「戻る」では何も送らない', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-04
      const { state, dialog } = await openReceive(page);
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.missingOption, exact: true }).click();

      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.missingConfirm(2))).toBeVisible();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '戻る', exact: true }).click();
      expect(state.posts['close-missing']).toHaveLength(0);

      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.missingOption, exact: true }).click();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '返品を終える', exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts['close-missing'].length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts['close-missing'][0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      expect(String(state.posts['close-missing'][0].body.requestKey)).toMatch(UUID_PATTERN);
      await expect(
        page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true }).getByRole('status'),
      ).toContainText(RETURN_TEXT.noticeClosedMissing);
    });

    test('届かない品がある完了した返品だけに「開き直す」が出て、確かめの文の後に窓口へ届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-05
      const withMissing = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: RETURN_ID,
        status: 'closed',
        displayStatus: 'returned',
        marks: [],
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 2, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { restocked: 1, missing: 1 } })],
      });
      const complete = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: SECOND_RETURN_ID,
        number: 2,
        status: 'closed',
        displayStatus: 'returned',
        marks: [],
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: SECOND_LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { restocked: 1 } })],
      });
      const state = await openList(page, [withMissing, complete], { orderId: ORDER_ID, displayStatus: 'returned', hasReturnable: false });
      const returns = await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID);

      await expect(returnCard(returns, LABEL).getByRole('button', { name: '開き直す', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(returnCard(returns, SECOND_LABEL).getByRole('button', { name: '開き直す', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);

      const dialog = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, '開き直す', RETURN_TEXT.reopenTitle);
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.reopenBody(1))).toBeVisible();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '戻る', exact: true }).click();
      expect(state.posts.reopen).toHaveLength(0);

      const again = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, '開き直す', RETURN_TEXT.reopenTitle);
      await again.getByRole('button', { name: '開き直す', exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.reopen.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.reopen[0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
    });

    test('何も受け取っていない返品だけに「返品を取り消す」が出て、確かめの後に取り消せる。取り消した返品は返品の欄から消える', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-06
      const untouched = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: RETURN_ID,
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ' })],
      });
      const received = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: SECOND_RETURN_ID,
        number: 2,
        marks: ['partially_received'],
        firstReceiptDone: true,
        receipts: [{ id: randomUUID(), kind: 'receive', refundChoice: 'consult', createdAt: '2026-10-11T01:00:00.000Z', actorEmail: 'admin@example.com' }],
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: SECOND_LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 2, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { restocked: 1, refundWaiting: 1 } })],
      });
      const state = await openList(page, [untouched, received], {
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        displayStatus: 'in_progress',
        marks: ['awaiting_items'],
        nextAction: 'receive',
        hasReturnable: false,
      });
      state.answerAction = async (route, action, post) => {
        state.returns = state.returns.filter((item) => item.id !== post.returnId);
        await fulfillJson(route, { data: { returnStatus: 'cancelled' } });
      };
      const returns = await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');

      await expect(returnCard(returns, LABEL).getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.cancelTitle, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(returnCard(returns, SECOND_LABEL).getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.cancelTitle, exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);

      const dialog = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, RETURN_TEXT.cancelTitle, RETURN_TEXT.cancelTitle);
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.cancelBody)).toBeVisible();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.cancelTitle, exact: true }).click();

      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.cancel.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.cancel[0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      const reopened = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true });
      await expect(reopened).toBeVisible();
      await expect(reopened.getByRole('group', { name: LABEL, exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(reopened.getByRole('group', { name: SECOND_LABEL, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('検品待ちの品がある返品に「検品を終える」が出て、戻す・戻さないを選んで窓口へ届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-07
      const pending = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: RETURN_ID,
        marks: ['pending_inspection'],
        firstReceiptDone: true,
        receipts: [{ id: randomUUID(), kind: 'receive', refundChoice: 'consult', createdAt: '2026-10-11T01:00:00.000Z', actorEmail: 'admin@example.com' }],
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 2, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { pendingInspection: 2, refundWaiting: 2 } })],
      });
      const state = await openList(page, [pending], {
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        displayStatus: 'in_progress',
        marks: ['pending_inspection'],
        hasReturnable: false,
      });
      const returns = await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID);
      await expect(returnCard(returns, LABEL).getByText('検品待ち 2点')).toBeVisible();

      const dialog = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, '検品を終える', RETURN_TEXT.inspectTitle(LABEL));
      const choices = dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: '品の状態', exact: true });
      await expect(choices).toHaveCount(2);
      await choices.nth(0).selectOption({ label: UNIT_STATES.restock });
      await choices.nth(1).selectOption({ label: UNIT_STATES.keep });
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '検品を終える', exact: true }).click();

      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.inspect.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.inspect[0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      expect(state.posts.inspect[0].body).toMatchObject({ lines: [{ returnLineId: LINE, restocked: 1, notRestocked: 1 }] });
      expect(String(state.posts.inspect[0].body.requestKey)).toMatch(UUID_PATTERN);
    });

    test('一部を受け取り、残りを届かないで終え、開き直して残りを受け取ると、数・状態・在庫の台帳が合う（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-08
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `flow-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 3, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 3 }] });
        const lineId = created.lineIds[shirt];
        const progress = async () => (await lineProgressOf(db, created.returnId))[lineId];

        // 1) 3点のうち1点だけ、今返金で受け取る。返金の記録が覆うので返金待ちは残らず、返品は受付中のまま（2点が未処理）
        const first = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });
        expect(first).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 5_000, returnStatus: 'open' });
        await recordRefundResult(db, first.refundId as string);
        expect(await progress()).toMatchObject({ restocked: 1, unprocessed: 2, missing: 0, refund_waiting: 0 });

        // 2) 残りの2点は届かないものとして終える。全部が処理され、返金待ちなども無いので、返品は完了する
        await closeMissingInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId);
        expect(await progress()).toMatchObject({ restocked: 1, missing: 2, unprocessed: 0, refund_waiting: 0 });
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).status).toBe('closed');
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'returned', next_action: 'none' });
        expect((await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['receive', 'close_missing']);

        // 3) 開き直す（完了した返品で、届かないにした品が残っている時だけ）と、届かないにした2点がまた受け取れる
        await reopenReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId);
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).status).toBe('open');
        expect(await progress()).toMatchObject({ restocked: 1, missing: 0, unprocessed: 2 });

        // 4) 残りの2点を、今返金で受け取る。品が全部処理され、返品は完了する
        const second = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 2 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });
        expect(second).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 10_000, returnStatus: 'closed' });
        await recordRefundResult(db, second.refundId as string);
        expect(await progress()).toMatchObject({ restocked: 3, unprocessed: 0, missing: 0, refund_waiting: 0 });
        // 在庫の台帳は、受け取りごとに1行（+1、+2）。すぐ出せる数は合わせて +3
        expect((await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => [row.reason, row.delta])).toEqual([
          ['return', 1],
          ['return', 2],
        ]);
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(3);
        expect((await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['receive', 'close_missing', 'reopen', 'receive']);
      });
    });

    test('受け取った後の取消は断られ、何も受け取る前の取消は通って、取り消した品はまた返品できる（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-06
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `cancel-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const [shirt, skirt] = fx.orderItemIds;
        const untouched = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }] });
        const touched = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: skirt, quantity: 1 }] });
        expect(await returnableByItem(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual({ [shirt]: 0, [skirt]: 0 });

        await receiveReturnInDb(db, touched.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: touched.lineIds[skirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'consult',
        });
        await expectDbError(cancelReturnInDb(db, touched.returnId, fx.actorId), 'RETURN_STATE_CONFLICT');
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, touched.returnId)).status).not.toBe('cancelled');

        expect(await cancelReturnInDb(db, untouched.returnId, fx.actorId)).toBe('cancelled');
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, untouched.returnId)).status).toBe('cancelled');
        // 取り消した返品の品は、またどの返品にも入れられる
        expect(await returnableByItem(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual({ [shirt]: 2, [skirt]: 0 });
        const again = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }] });
        expect(again).toMatchObject({ number: 3, status: 'open' });
      });
    });

    test('検品待ちで受け取った品を検品で決めると、戻す分だけ在庫が増え、返品が返金待ちになる（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-463-AC-09
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `inspect-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }] });
        const lineId = created.lineIds[shirt];

        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId, disposition: 'pending_inspection', quantity: 2 }],
          choice: 'consult',
        });
        // 検品待ちの間は在庫を動かさず、返金待ちにもならない（検品待ちの印が付いた返品中）
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(0);
        expect((await lineProgressOf(db, created.returnId))[lineId]).toMatchObject({ pending_inspection: 2, unprocessed: 0 });
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'in_progress' });
        expect((await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).marks).toContain('pending_inspection');

        // 検品で、1点は戻し、1点は戻さない
        await inspectReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, [{ lineId, restocked: 1, notRestocked: 1 }]);
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(1);
        expect((await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => [row.reason, row.delta])).toEqual([['return', 1]]);
        expect((await lineProgressOf(db, created.returnId))[lineId]).toMatchObject({ pending_inspection: 0, processed: 2, unprocessed: 0 });
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'refund_waiting', next_action: 'refund' });
      });
    });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: `FR-ADMIN-087` 相談・返金待ち・額を決めて返金・返金しないで終える・返金が失敗した後**

`e2e/FR-ADMIN-087-return-consult-refund.spec.ts`（新規。11件。FREQ-464-AC-06〜10・16・17、FREQ-467-AC-03、FREQ-469-AC-03・07。496行）。11件×3画面幅。相談の受け取りのボタンの言葉、返金待ちの返品の「額を決めて返金する」（店長だけ）、要対応の「もう一度返金する」が返品の画面を開くこと、額を決めて返金の画面（内訳・返せる額・送料・メモ・知らせ・注意）、窓口の断りが画面の中に出ること、額0の「返金しないで終える」を、窓口を差し替えて確かめる。相談の手数料の持ち越し、返金がエラーか失敗になった時に手数料が戻って返し直しでもう一度引くこと、0円の返金の二重防止、返金が失敗した後の返金待ち、相談の受け取りと後で返した返金のメールを、手元の DB と Mailpit で確かめる。

```ts
/**
 * FR-ADMIN-087 額を相談して受け取り、あとで額を決めて返金する（返金しないで終える・失敗の後の返し直しを含む）
 * 対応 FREQ: FREQ-464（AC-06〜AC-10・AC-16・AC-17）、FREQ-467（AC-03）、FREQ-469（AC-03・AC-07）
 *
 * 画面（受け取りの「相談」・返品の欄の「額を決めて返金する」・その画面）は窓口の答えを差し替えて確かめ、返金待ち・手数料・返金の記録・
 * 返金しないで終える・メールは、窓口が呼ぶのと同じ DB の関数を手元の DB に直に呼んで確かめる（実装計画 P11）。
 * Stripe には頼まず、返金の結果はこちらで書く。
 */
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  expectDbError,
  markRefundError,
  recordRefundResult,
  runWorkerUntil,
  sentOutboxCount,
  withLocalDb,
} from './order-email-test-utils';
import { UUID_PATTERN, fulfillJson, mockOrderList, openOrderTab, orderNumberOf, viewports } from './order-fulfillment-test-utils';
import { mockAdminSessionAs } from './refund-test-utils';
import {
  RETURN_MAIL,
  RETURN_TEXT,
  UNIT_STATES,
  chooseRefundChoice,
  confirmButton,
  createReturnInDb,
  createShippedOrder,
  formatYen,
  mockReturnRoutes,
  newReturnRouteState,
  openReceiveDialog,
  openReturnRefundDialog,
  openReturnsDialog,
  orderWithReturns,
  readReturnBreakdown,
  receiptRows,
  receiptUnitRows,
  receiveReturnInDb,
  refundData,
  refundReturnInDb,
  returnCard,
  returnDetailOf,
  returnEmailRows,
  returnLabelOf,
  returnLineOf,
  returnRefundRows,
  returnRowOf,
  returnSummaryOf,
  returnSummaryRow,
  returnsDialogName,
  setUnitState,
  waitForMails,
  type ReturnRouteState,
} from './return-test-utils';
import type { AttentionException } from '@/lib/orders/order-payment-types';
import type { OrderReturnDetail } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

const ORDER_ID = 'a7b2c3d4-0087-4000-8000-000000000087';
const SHIRT = 'c7b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LINE = 'd7b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const SECOND_LINE = 'd7b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const THIRD_LINE = 'd7b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
const RETURN_ID = 'b7b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const SECOND_RETURN_ID = 'b7b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const THIRD_RETURN_ID = 'b7b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
const LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 1);
const SECOND_LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 2);
const THIRD_LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 3);
const RECEIVED_RECEIPT = {
  id: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1',
  kind: 'receive' as const,
  refundChoice: 'consult' as const,
  createdAt: '2026-10-11T01:00:00.000Z',
  actorEmail: 'admin@example.com',
};

/** 受け取り済みで返金待ち（額は相談）の返品。シャツ1点・単価5,000円 */
function waitingReturn(overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof returnDetailOf>[0]> = {}): OrderReturnDetail {
  return returnDetailOf({
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    id: RETURN_ID,
    displayStatus: 'refund_waiting',
    marks: [],
    firstReceiptDone: true,
    receipts: [RECEIVED_RECEIPT],
    lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { restocked: 1, refundWaiting: 1 } })],
    ...overrides,
  });
}

/** 要対応の欄の「返金の失敗」。失敗した返金が返品の返金なので、窓口は返品の番号（refundFailure.returnId）を付ける（実装計画 P21、Task 8） */
const RETURN_REFUND_FAILURE: AttentionException & { refundFailure: { returnId: string } } = {
  id: 'f7b2c3d4-0087-4000-8000-000000000001',
  reason: 'refund_failed',
  reasonLabel: '返金の失敗',
  detail: 'declined',
  orderId: ORDER_ID,
  orderNumber: orderNumberOf(ORDER_ID),
  orderStatus: 'paid',
  paymentRef: 're_e2eReturnFail1',
  firstDetectedAt: '2026-10-12T01:00:00.000Z',
  lastDetectedAt: '2026-10-12T01:00:00.000Z',
  detectionCount: 1,
  canCancelOrder: false,
  canRetryRefund: true,
  refundFailure: { amount: 5_000, failureReasonLabel: 'カードが使えません', shortages: [], returnId: RETURN_ID },
};

type ListOptions = {
  role?: 'admin' | 'supporter';
  summary?: Parameters<typeof returnSummaryOf>[0];
  state?: Partial<Parameters<typeof newReturnRouteState>[0]>;
  /** 要対応の欄に出す「返金の失敗」（省くと要対応は空のまま） */
  failures?: AttentionException[];
};

/** 一覧の窓口と返品の窓口を差し替えて、ORDER タブを開く */
async function openList(page: Page, returns: OrderReturnDetail[], options: ListOptions = {}): Promise<ReturnRouteState> {
  const state = newReturnRouteState({
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    returns,
    returnableUnits: 0,
    refundableAmount: 20_000,
    refundableShipping: 800,
    canRefund: options.role !== 'supporter',
    ...options.state,
  });
  await mockAdminSessionAs(page, options.role ?? 'admin');
  await mockOrderList(page, () => [
    orderWithReturns({
      id: ORDER_ID,
      summary: returnSummaryOf(
        options.summary ?? { orderId: ORDER_ID, displayStatus: 'refund_waiting', nextAction: 'refund', hasReturnable: false, refundWaitingReturns: 1 },
      ),
      canRefund: options.role !== 'supporter',
    }),
  ]);
  await mockReturnRoutes(page, ORDER_ID, state);
  const failures = options.failures;
  if (failures) {
    // 後から登録した窓口が先に効く。管理画面が裏で読む要対応の空の答えを、この試験の答えで上書きする
    await page.route('**/api/admin/order-attention', (route) =>
      fulfillJson(route, { data: { exceptions: failures, reviews: [], counts: { exceptions: failures.length, reviews: 0 } } }));
  }
  await openOrderTab(page);
  return state;
}

/** 返金待ちの返品1つの「額を決めて返金する」の画面まで開く */
async function openRefund(page: Page) {
  const state = await openList(page, [waitingReturn()]);
  await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '額を決めて返金する');
  const dialog = await openReturnRefundDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL);
  return { state, dialog };
}

for (const viewport of viewports) {
  test.describe(`FR-ADMIN-087 return consult and refund (${viewport.name})`, () => {
    test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
    });

    test('受け取りで「額を相談してから返金する」を選ぶと、確定のボタンが「受け取りだけ記録する（返金は額を決めてから）」になり、窓口へ相談が届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-06
      const detail = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: RETURN_ID,
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ' })],
      });
      const state = await openList(page, [detail], {
        summary: { orderId: ORDER_ID, displayStatus: 'in_progress', marks: ['awaiting_items'], nextAction: 'receive', hasReturnable: false },
      });
      await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');
      const dialog = await openReceiveDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL);

      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.consultOption)).toBeVisible();
      await chooseRefundChoice(dialog, 'consult');
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.consultButton)).toBeVisible();
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.consultButton).click();

      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({ refundChoice: 'consult' });
      await expect(
        page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true }).getByRole('status'),
      ).toContainText(RETURN_TEXT.noticeRecorded);
    });

    test('返金待ちの返品（失敗の後に返金待ちへ戻った完了の返品を含む）の欄に、店長だけ「額を決めて返金する」が出る。サポートの人には出ない', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-07, FREQ-464-AC-17
      const waiting = waitingReturn();
      const failedAfterClose = waitingReturn({
        id: SECOND_RETURN_ID,
        number: 2,
        status: 'closed',
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: SECOND_LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { restocked: 1, refundWaiting: 1 } })],
        refunds: [{ id: randomUUID(), amount: 5_000, status: 'failed', createdAt: '2026-10-11T02:00:00.000Z' }],
      });
      const done = waitingReturn({
        id: THIRD_RETURN_ID,
        number: 3,
        status: 'closed',
        displayStatus: 'returned',
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: THIRD_LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { restocked: 1, refundCovered: 1 } })],
        refunds: [{ id: randomUUID(), amount: 5_000, status: 'succeeded', createdAt: '2026-10-11T03:00:00.000Z' }],
      });
      const state = await openList(page, [waiting, failedAfterClose, done]);
      const returns = await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '額を決めて返金する');
      const refundButton = (label: string) => returnCard(returns, label).getByRole('button', { name: '額を決めて返金する', exact: true });

      await expect(refundButton(LABEL)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(refundButton(SECOND_LABEL)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(refundButton(THIRD_LABEL)).toHaveCount(0);
      // 失敗した返金は「失敗」と出て、返品の状態は返金待ちのまま。返し直しは、同じ画面の「額を決めて返金する」
      await expect(returnCard(returns, SECOND_LABEL).getByText('返金待ち', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(returnCard(returns, SECOND_LABEL).getByText(`返金 ${formatYen(5_000)}（失敗）`)).toBeVisible();
      await refundButton(SECOND_LABEL).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: RETURN_TEXT.refundTitle(SECOND_LABEL), exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      expect(state.posts.refund).toHaveLength(0);

      // サポートの人の画面には、返金に関わるボタンが出ない（一覧のボタンも「返品」になる）
      await openList(page, [waiting, failedAfterClose, done], { role: 'supporter' });
      const supporterReturns = await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '返品');
      await expect(supporterReturns.getByRole('group', { name: LABEL, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
```
