```ts
      await expect(supporterReturns.getByRole('button', { name: '額を決めて返金する', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    });

    test('要対応の「返金の失敗」が返品の返金なら、店長の「もう一度返金する」はふつうの返金の画面ではなく返品の画面を開く。サポートの人には出ない', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-17
      await openList(page, [waitingReturn()], { failures: [RETURN_REFUND_FAILURE] });
      await expect(page.getByText(`返金の失敗（${orderNumberOf(ORDER_ID)}）`)).toBeVisible();

      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'もう一度返金する', exact: true }).click();

      const returns = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true });
      await expect(returns).toBeVisible();
      await expect(returnCard(returns, LABEL).getByRole('button', { name: '額を決めて返金する', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByRole('dialog', { name: '返金', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);

      // サポートの人には返金の権限が無いので、返品の返金の失敗にも「もう一度返金する」を出さない（「解決済みにする」は出る）
      await openList(page, [waitingReturn()], { role: 'supporter', failures: [RETURN_REFUND_FAILURE] });
      await expect(page.getByText(`返金の失敗（${orderNumberOf(ORDER_ID)}）`)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'もう一度返金する', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: '解決済みにする', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('「額を決めて返金する」の画面に、内訳・返せる額・送料・メモ・知らせ・注意が出て、ボタンの額と窓口へ届く額が一致する', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-08
      const { state, dialog } = await openRefund(page);
      expect(await readReturnBreakdown(dialog)).toMatchObject({ '商品': formatYen(5_000), '返金額': formatYen(5_000) });
      await expect(dialog.getByLabel(RETURN_TEXT.refundAmountLabel(formatYen(20_000)), { exact: true })).toHaveValue('5000');
      await expect(dialog.getByLabel(RETURN_TEXT.shippingAmountLabel(formatYen(800)), { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.memoLabel, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('checkbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.refundMailLabel, exact: true })).toBeChecked();
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.refundNoUndo)).toBeVisible();

      state.answerAction = (route) => fulfillJson(route, { data: refundData({ amount: 5_000 }) });
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.refundButton(formatYen(5_000))).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.refund.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.refund[0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      // 見込みどおりの額は送らない（DB が同じ式で計算し直す。Task 9 の額を決めて返金の画面）
      expect(state.posts.refund[0].body).toMatchObject({ amount: null, shippingAmount: 0, note: null, notifyCustomer: true });
      expect(String(state.posts.refund[0].body.requestKey)).toMatch(UUID_PATTERN);
    });

    test('窓口が「返金額は返せる額までにしてください。」と断った時は、その文が画面の中に出て、画面は閉じない', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-09
      const { state, dialog } = await openRefund(page);
      const refusal = '返金額は、返せる額までにしてください。';
      state.answerAction = (route) => fulfillJson(route, { error: refusal, code: 'RETURN_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID' }, 400);

      await dialog.getByLabel(RETURN_TEXT.refundAmountLabel(formatYen(20_000)), { exact: true }).fill('19000');
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.refundButton(formatYen(19_000))).click();

      await expect(dialog.getByRole('alert')).toContainText(refusal);
      await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
      expect(state.posts.refund).toHaveLength(1);
      // 手で直した額は、ボタンの額のまま窓口へ届く（ボタンの額と窓口へ届く額が一致する）
      expect(state.posts.refund[0].body).toMatchObject({ amount: 19_000, shippingAmount: 0 });
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.refundButton(formatYen(19_000)))).toBeEnabled();
    });

    test('返金額を0にすると、ボタンが「返金しないで終える」・注意が「返金しないで終えます。…」になり、窓口へ金額0が届いて「返金しないで終えました。」が出る', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-16
      const { state, dialog } = await openRefund(page);
      state.answerAction = (route) => fulfillJson(route, { data: refundData({ amount: 0, status: 'waived', refundId: null }) });

      await dialog.getByLabel(RETURN_TEXT.refundAmountLabel(formatYen(20_000)), { exact: true }).fill('0');
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.refundWaiveButton)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.refundWaiveNote)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.refundNoUndo)).toHaveCount(0);
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.refundWaiveButton).click();

      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.refund.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.refund[0].body).toMatchObject({ amount: 0 });
      await expect(
        page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true }).getByRole('status'),
      ).toContainText(RETURN_TEXT.noticeWaived);
    });

    test('相談で受け取ると返金待ちになり、手数料は引くまで残る。額を決めて返金すると手数料を引いた額になり、Stripe が受け付けると返品が完了する（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-10, FREQ-467-AC-03
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `consult-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }], restockingFeePercent: 10 });

        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 2 }],
          choice: 'consult',
        });
        // 受け取りだけ記録する: 返金の記録は作らず、手数料（10,000円の10%）は引くまで残す
        expect(received).toMatchObject({ refundId: null, returnStatus: 'open', replayed: false });
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).toMatchObject({ fee_pending_deduction: 1_000, fee_due_amount: 0 });
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'refund_waiting', next_action: 'refund' });

        // 額を決めて返金（計算どおり）: 10,000円 − 手数料 1,000円。引いた手数料は0に戻る。返金は返品の返金として記録され、
        // 返金の品が返金の記録に覆われるので、返品は完了する（返事待ちの間も「返品済み」）
        const refund = await refundReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId);
        expect(refund).toMatchObject({ amount: 9_000, status: 'awaiting_response', replayed: false });
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'closed', fee_pending_deduction: 0, fee_due_amount: 0 });
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([
          { id: refund.refundId, return_id: created.returnId, source: 'return', status: 'awaiting_response', amount: 9_000 },
        ]);
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'returned', next_action: 'none' });

        // 結果が成功になっても、返品は完了のまま
        await recordRefundResult(db, refund.refundId as string);
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).status).toBe('closed');
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'returned', next_action: 'none' });
      });
    });

    test('返品の返金がエラーか失敗になると、その返金で引いた手数料が戻り、返し直しの「計算どおり」でもう一度引く。手数料が二重に引かれることも、引き忘れることもない（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-467-AC-03（実装計画 P26）
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `fee-restore-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }], restockingFeePercent: 10 });

        // 今返金の受け取り: 10,000円 − 手数料 1,000円 = 9,000円
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 2 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });
        expect(received).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 9_000, returnStatus: 'closed' });

        // Stripe が受け付けなかった（エラー）。返金待ちに戻り、返し直しの計算どおりの額は、また 9,000円（手数料を引き忘れない）
        await markRefundError(db, received.refundId as string, 'stripe_rejected');
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'refund_waiting', next_action: 'refund' });
        const retry = await refundReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId);
        expect(retry).toMatchObject({ amount: 9_000, status: 'awaiting_response' });

        // こんどは受け付けた後に失敗（銀行から戻されたなど）。もう一度返し直しても 9,000円で、手数料は二重に引かれない
        await recordRefundResult(db, retry.refundId as string, { stripeStatus: 'failed', failureReason: 'declined' });
        const second = await refundReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId);
        expect(second).toMatchObject({ amount: 9_000, status: 'awaiting_response' });
        await recordRefundResult(db, second.refundId as string);
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'returned', next_action: 'none' });
        expect((await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => [row.status, row.amount])).toEqual([
          ['error', 9_000],
          ['failed', 9_000],
          ['succeeded', 9_000],
        ]);
      });
    });

    test('額を決めて返金で0円にすると、返金の記録も返金のメールも作らず、返品が完了する。同じ番号の送り直しは同じ結果で、違う額は断る（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-16
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `waive-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        // メールの予定を種類で完全一致に比べるので、作る時の受付のお知らせ（return_accepted）は入れない
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], restockingFeePercent: 10, notify: false });
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'consult',
        });
        const key = randomUUID();

        expect(await refundReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { requestKey: key, amount: 0 })).toEqual({
          refundId: null,
          amount: 0,
          status: 'waived',
          replayed: false,
        });
        expect(await refundReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { requestKey: key, amount: 0 })).toMatchObject({
          refundId: null,
          status: 'waived',
          replayed: true,
        });
        await expectDbError(refundReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { requestKey: key, amount: 1 }), 'RETURN_REQUEST_MISMATCH');

        // 返金の記録は作らず、返金しないことにした数を「返金しない」の受け取りとして残す。返品は完了する
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        const receipts = await receiptRows(db, created.returnId);
        expect(receipts.map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['receive', 'waive_refund']);
        expect(await receiptUnitRows(db, receipts[1].id)).toEqual([
          { disposition: 'refund_waived', quantity: 1, resolution: null, exchange_method: null },
        ]);
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'closed', fee_pending_deduction: 0, fee_due_amount: 0 });
        // お客様に返金のメールの予定は書かない（書かれるのは、相談で受け取った時の「返品をお受け取りしました」だけ）
        expect((await returnEmailRows(db, fx.orderId)).map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['return_received']);
      });
    });

    test('返品の返金が失敗した後は、完了した返品でも返金待ちになり、同じ返品の画面から返し直せる。返し直しも返品の返金として記録される（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-17
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `retry-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }] });
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'now',
        });
        expect(received.returnStatus).toBe('closed');

        // Stripe が受け付けた後に失敗した（銀行から戻されたなど）。返品の記録の状態は戻さないが、画面の状態は返金待ちに戻る
        const accepted = await recordRefundResult(db, received.refundId as string, { stripeStatus: 'pending', pendingReason: 'processing' });
        await recordRefundResult(db, received.refundId as string, {
          stripeRefundId: accepted.stripeRefundId,
          stripeStatus: 'failed',
          failureReason: 'declined',
        });
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).status).toBe('closed');
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'refund_waiting', next_action: 'refund' });

        // 同じ返品の「額を決めて返金する」で返し直す。道は return のまま、返品とのつながりを保つ
        const retry = await refundReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId);
        expect(retry).toMatchObject({ amount: 5_000, status: 'awaiting_response' });
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([
          expect.objectContaining({ id: received.refundId, return_id: created.returnId, source: 'return', status: 'failed' }),
          expect.objectContaining({ id: retry.refundId, return_id: created.returnId, source: 'return', status: 'awaiting_response' }),
        ]);
        await recordRefundResult(db, retry.refundId as string);
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'returned', next_action: 'none' });
      });
    });

    test('相談で受け取ると「返品をお受け取りしました」が1通届き、あとで額を決めて返金すると、返金のお知らせに「ご返品いただいた商品のご返金です」が入る（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-03, FREQ-469-AC-07
      test.setTimeout(240_000);
      const { fx, label, returnId } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `consult-mail-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }] });
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'consult',
          notify: true,
        });
        return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number), returnId: created.returnId };
      });
      const orderNumber = orderNumberOf(fx.orderId);

      const received = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.received);
      expect(received).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(received[0].Subject).toBe(`【Le Fil des Heures】${RETURN_MAIL.received}（${orderNumber}）`);
      expect(received[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(label));
      expect(received[0].Text).toContain('お受け取りした商品:');
      expect(received[0].Text).toContain('・E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / M） × 1');
      expect(received[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.consult);

      // あとで店長が額を決めて返金する。Stripe が受け付けると、返金のお知らせの予定が書かれる
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const refund = await refundReturnInDb(db, returnId, fx.actorId);
        await recordRefundResult(db, refund.refundId as string);
      });
      await runWorkerUntil(request, async () => (await sentOutboxCount(fx.orderId, 'refund')) >= 1, '返金のお知らせが送信済みになること');
      const refundMails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.refund);
      expect(refundMails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(refundMails[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.refundLead(orderNumber));
      expect(refundMails[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.refundLater(label));
      expect(refundMails[0].Text).not.toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(label));
      expect(refundMails[0].Text).not.toContain(RETURN_MAIL.notShipping);
    });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: `FR-ADMIN-088` 交換の品・手数料のお支払い待ち・支払いを待たずに送る・いただかないで終える**

`e2e/FR-ADMIN-088-return-exchange.spec.ts`（新規。13件。FREQ-465-AC-01〜07、FREQ-467-AC-04・05、FREQ-469-AC-03・05。663行）。13件×3画面幅。受け取りの画面の「交換の品」の欄、お支払い待ちの見込み、在庫が足りない時の選び（作って送る・返金に変える）、発送の画面の印と手数料待ちの知らせ、手数料の受け取りの記録・「いただかないで終える」・支払いを待たずに送るの画面を、窓口を差し替えて確かめる。交換の品の行（値段0・元の支払額）・台帳 `exchange`・注文が支払い済みに戻って送ると発送済みに進むこと、作って送るは仕上がりまで送れないこと、在庫不足の自動の切り替えと店長の選び、手数料待ちで送れない・記録か支払いを待たずに送るで送れる・いただかないで終えると完了して額が履歴に残ること、メール（交換の品・お支払い待ち・お届けの目安・発送のお知らせの交換の一文）を、手元の DB と Mailpit で確かめる。

```ts
/**
 * FR-ADMIN-088 交換の品（在庫から・作って送る・在庫不足・手数料のお支払い待ち・支払いを待たずに送る・発送）
 * 対応 FREQ: FREQ-465（AC-01〜AC-07）、FREQ-467（AC-04・AC-05）、FREQ-469（AC-03・AC-05）
 *
 * 画面（受け取りの画面の交換の品・手数料の画面・発送の画面の交換の印）は窓口の答えを差し替えて確かめ、交換の品の行・在庫の台帳・注文の状態・
 * 手数料のお支払い待ち・メールは、窓口が呼ぶのと同じ DB の関数を手元の DB に直に呼んで確かめる（実装計画 P11）。
 * 交換の色・サイズは、同じ商品の別の色・サイズを手元の DB に足して使う（addVariant）。理由は、その理由の設定の「在庫の無い交換」で選ぶ
 * （最初の値: 破損・不良は作って送る、サイズが小さいは受けない。試験は設定を書き換えない）。
 */
import { expect, test, type Page, type Route } from '@playwright/test';
import { PRICE } from '../tests/integration/db/helpers/order-fixtures';
import {
  createFulfillment,
  expectDbError,
  orderState,
  recordCompletion,
  runWorkerUntil,
  variantStockState,
  withLocalDb,
} from './order-email-test-utils';
import {
  adminOrder,
  fulfillJson,
  mockOrderList,
  openOrderTab,
  orderNumberOf,
  shipMaterials,
  viewports,
} from './order-fulfillment-test-utils';
import { mockAdminSessionAs } from './refund-test-utils';
import {
  RETURN_MAIL,
  RETURN_TEXT,
  UNIT_STATES,
  addVariant,
  chooseRefundChoice,
  confirmButton,
  createReturnInDb,
  createShippedOrder,
  exchangeItemRows,
  exchangeMaterialLine,
  exchangeOf,
  exchangeOrderLine,
  formatYen,
  lineProgressOf,
  mockReturnRoutes,
  newReturnRouteState,
  openOperationDialog,
  openReceiveDialog,
  openReturnsDialog,
  orderWithReturns,
  receiptUnitRows,
  receiveReturnInDb,
  recordFeePaymentInDb,
  releaseExchangeInDb,
  returnCard,
  returnDetailOf,
  returnLabelOf,
  returnLedger,
  returnLineOf,
  returnRowOf,
  returnSummaryOf,
  returnSummaryRow,
  returnsDialogName,
  sentReturnMailCount,
  setUnitState,
  waitForMails,
  type ReturnRouteState,
} from './return-test-utils';
import type { OrderReturnLineDetail } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

const ORDER_ID = 'a8b2c3d4-0088-4000-8000-000000000088';
const SHIRT = 'c8b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const SKIRT = 'c8b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const EXCHANGE_ITEM = 'e8b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LINE_A = 'd8b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LINE_B = 'd8b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const RETURN_ID = 'b8b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 1);
const RECEIPT = {
  id: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e8',
  kind: 'receive' as const,
  refundChoice: 'none' as const,
  createdAt: '2026-10-11T01:00:00.000Z',
  actorEmail: 'admin@example.com',
};

/** 一覧の窓口と返品の窓口を差し替えて、ORDER タブを開く */
async function openList(page: Page, returns: ReturnType<typeof returnDetailOf>[], summary: Parameters<typeof returnSummaryOf>[0]): Promise<ReturnRouteState> {
  const state = newReturnRouteState({ orderId: ORDER_ID, returns, returnableUnits: 0, refundableAmount: 20_000 });
  await mockAdminSessionAs(page, 'admin');
  await mockOrderList(page, () => [orderWithReturns({ id: ORDER_ID, summary: returnSummaryOf(summary) })]);
  await mockReturnRoutes(page, ORDER_ID, state);
  await openOrderTab(page);
  return state;
}

/** 受け取り待ちの返品1つ（交換の行を渡す。手数料を使う時は fees）の受け取りの画面まで開く */
async function openExchangeReceive(page: Page, lines: OrderReturnLineDetail[], fees?: { exchangeFee: number; exchangeShippingFee: number }) {
  const detail = returnDetailOf({ orderId: ORDER_ID, id: RETURN_ID, lines, fees });
  const state = await openList(page, [detail], {
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    displayStatus: 'in_progress',
    marks: ['awaiting_items'],
    nextAction: 'receive',
    hasReturnable: false,
  });
  await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');
  const dialog = await openReceiveDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL);
  return { state, dialog };
}

for (const viewport of viewports) {
  test.describe(`FR-ADMIN-088 return exchange (${viewport.name})`, () => {
    test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
    });

    test('受け取りの画面の「交換の品」の欄に、交換の色・サイズ・数と「在庫から（在庫 n）」「作って送る（お届けの目安 n日）」が出て、確定のボタンが交換の言葉になる', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-01
      const stockLine = returnLineOf({
        id: LINE_A,
        orderItemId: SHIRT,
        itemName: 'E2Eシャツ',
        exchange: exchangeOf({ variantId: 9102, size: 'L', method: 'stock', stockQuantity: 3, outOfStockExchange: 'decline' }),
      });
      const makeLine = returnLineOf({
        id: LINE_B,
        orderItemId: SKIRT,
        itemName: 'E2Eスカート',
        exchange: exchangeOf({ variantId: 9103, size: 'XL', method: 'make', stockQuantity: 0, madeToOrderLeadDays: 5, outOfStockExchange: 'make' }),
      });
      const { state, dialog } = await openExchangeReceive(page, [stockLine, makeLine]);

      // 届いた品を選ぶと、「交換の品」の欄に、交換先の色・サイズと数と方法が出る
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.keep);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 1, UNIT_STATES.keep);
      const exchange = dialog.getByRole('region', { name: RETURN_TEXT.exchangeHeading, exact: true });
      await expect(
        exchange.getByRole('group', { name: 'E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / L） × 1', exact: true }).getByText(RETURN_TEXT.stockOf(3)),
      ).toBeVisible();
      await expect(
        exchange.getByRole('group', { name: 'E2Eスカート（ホワイト / XL） × 1', exact: true }).getByText(RETURN_TEXT.makeOf(5)),
      ).toBeVisible();
      // 返金の品が無いので、返金の欄は出ない。手数料も付かないので、お支払い待ちの見込みも出ない
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('group', { name: '返金', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(dialog.getByText('お支払い待ち', { exact: false })).toHaveCount(0);

      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllExchange).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      // 返金の品が無い受け取りなので、返金の選びは「なし」
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({ refundChoice: 'none' });
    });

    test('交換だけの受け取りで手数料が付く時は、押す前に「お支払い待ち ￥n（交換の品は、お支払いを確かめてから送ります）」が出る', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-467-AC-04
      const line = returnLineOf({
        id: LINE_A,
        orderItemId: SHIRT,
        itemName: 'E2Eシャツ',
        exchange: exchangeOf({ variantId: 9102, size: 'L', method: 'stock', stockQuantity: 3 }),
      });
      const { state, dialog } = await openExchangeReceive(page, [line], { exchangeFee: 500, exchangeShippingFee: 300 });

      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.keep);
      // 返金の品が無いので、付く手数料の合計（交換の手数料 500円 + 交換の送料 300円）がお支払い待ちになる
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.awaitingPayment(formatYen(800)))).toBeVisible();

      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllExchange).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({ refundChoice: 'none' });
    });

    test('在庫が足りない交換は、設定が「作って送る」なら理由の文が出て、「受けない」なら店長が「作って送る」を選べて、窓口へ届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-02
      const declined = returnLineOf({
        id: LINE_A,
        orderItemId: SHIRT,
        itemName: 'E2Eシャツ',
        exchange: exchangeOf({ variantId: 9102, size: 'L', method: 'stock', stockQuantity: 0, outOfStockExchange: 'decline' }),
      });
      const automatic = returnLineOf({
        id: LINE_B,
        orderItemId: SKIRT,
        itemName: 'E2Eスカート',
        exchange: exchangeOf({ variantId: 9103, size: 'XL', method: 'stock', stockQuantity: 0, madeToOrderLeadDays: 4, outOfStockExchange: 'make' }),
      });
      const { state, dialog } = await openExchangeReceive(page, [declined, automatic]);

      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.keep);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 1, UNIT_STATES.keep);
      // 設定が「作って送る」の品は、自動で作って送るに変わる旨が出て、選びは「作って送る」が最初の値（店長には「返金に変える」も出る。
      // 仕様書 6-5「店長は返金に変えることもできる」）。「受けない」の品は、店長が選ぶまで確定できない
      const exchange = dialog.getByRole('region', { name: RETURN_TEXT.exchangeHeading, exact: true });
      const automaticRow = exchange.getByRole('group', { name: 'E2Eスカート（ホワイト / XL） × 1', exact: true });
      const declinedRow = exchange.getByRole('group', { name: 'E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / L） × 1', exact: true });
      await expect(automaticRow.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.stockMake)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(automaticRow.getByRole('radio', { name: '作って送る', exact: true })).toBeChecked();
      await expect(automaticRow.getByRole('radio', { name: '返金に変える', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(declinedRow.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.stockDeclineManager)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(declinedRow.getByRole('radio', { name: '作って送る', exact: true })).not.toBeChecked();
      // 選ぶまでは確定できない
      await expect(dialog.locator('button[type="submit"]')).toBeDisabled();
      await declinedRow.getByRole('radio', { name: '作って送る', exact: true }).check();
      await expect(dialog.locator('button[type="submit"]')).toBeEnabled();

      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllExchange).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      // 自動で作って送るの品は最初の値のままなので、選びは届かない（make の理由の行に送れるのは「返金に変える」だけ）
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({ exchangeOverrides: [{ returnLineId: LINE_A, action: 'make' }] });
    });

    test('在庫が足りず自動で作って送るになる品も、店長は「返金に変える」を選べて、その品は返金の品になり、窓口へ返金に変える選びと相談が届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-02
      const automatic = returnLineOf({
        id: LINE_B,
        orderItemId: SKIRT,
        itemName: 'E2Eスカート',
        exchange: exchangeOf({ variantId: 9103, size: 'XL', method: 'stock', stockQuantity: 0, madeToOrderLeadDays: 4, outOfStockExchange: 'make' }),
      });
      const { state, dialog } = await openExchangeReceive(page, [automatic]);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.keep);
      const row = dialog
        .getByRole('region', { name: RETURN_TEXT.exchangeHeading, exact: true })
        .getByRole('group', { name: 'E2Eスカート（ホワイト / XL） × 1', exact: true });
      await expect(row.getByRole('radio', { name: '作って送る', exact: true })).toBeChecked();

      await row.getByRole('radio', { name: '返金に変える', exact: true }).check();
      // 返金の品になったので、返金の欄が出る。額は相談してから決める
      await chooseRefundChoice(dialog, 'consult');
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.consultButton).click();

      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({
        refundChoice: 'consult',
        exchangeOverrides: [{ returnLineId: LINE_B, action: 'refund' }],
      });
    });

    test('発送の画面で交換の品に「交換の品」の印と手数料待ちの知らせが出て、手数料待ちの断りの文は発送の画面の中に出る', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-03
      const state = { onHold: 1, posts: 0 };
      await mockAdminSessionAs(page, 'admin');
      await mockOrderList(page, () => [
        adminOrder({
          id: ORDER_ID,
          status: '発送準備中',
          orderStatus: 'paid',
          items: [exchangeOrderLine({ id: EXCHANGE_ITEM, name: 'E2Eシャツ', color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', quantity: 1, readyUnshipped: 1 })],
        }),
      ]);
      await page.route(`**/api/admin/orders/${ORDER_ID}/fulfillments`, async (route: Route) => {
        if (route.request().method() === 'GET') {
          await fulfillJson(
            route,
            shipMaterials({ orderId: ORDER_ID, lines: [exchangeMaterialLine({ orderItemId: EXCHANGE_ITEM, onHold: state.onHold })] }),
          );
          return;
        }
        state.posts += 1;
        await fulfillJson(route, { error: RETURN_TEXT.shipHoldRefusal, code: 'fulfillment_exchange_on_hold' }, 409);
      });
      await openOrderTab(page);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: '発送済みにする' }).click();
      const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: '発送済みにする' });

      // 手数料のお支払いを待っている交換の品: 印と知らせが出て、送れる数は0
      await expect(dialog.getByText('交換の品', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.shipHold(1))).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByLabel('今回送る数')).toHaveValue('0');
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'キャンセル', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0);

      // お支払い待ちが始まる前に開いた画面で押した時: 窓口の断りの文が画面の中に出る
      state.onHold = 0;
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: '発送済みにする' }).click();
      const again = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: '発送済みにする' });
      await expect(again.getByText('交換の品', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(again.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.shipHold(1))).toHaveCount(0);
      await again.getByLabel('追跡番号').fill('E2E-HOLD');
      await again.getByRole('button', { name: '発送する' }).click();
      await expect(again.getByRole('alert').filter({ hasText: RETURN_TEXT.shipHoldRefusal })).toBeVisible();
      expect(state.posts).toBe(1);
      await expect(again).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('手数料のお支払い待ちの返品に、店長だけの「手数料の受け取りを記録する」と「支払いを待たずに送る」が出て、それぞれの画面から窓口へ届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-06
      const detail = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: RETURN_ID,
        marks: ['awaiting_fee'],
        firstReceiptDone: true,
        firstExchangeReceiptDone: true,
        fees: { exchangeFee: 500, exchangeShippingFee: 300, feeDueAmount: 800 },
        receipts: [RECEIPT],
        lines: [
          returnLineOf({
            id: LINE_A,
            orderItemId: SHIRT,
            itemName: 'E2Eシャツ',
            exchange: exchangeOf({ method: 'stock' }),
            progress: { notRestocked: 1, exchanged: 1 },
          }),
        ],
        exchangeItems: [
          { orderItemId: EXCHANGE_ITEM, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock', shipped: 0 },
        ],
      });
      const state = await openList(page, [detail], { orderId: ORDER_ID, displayStatus: 'in_progress', marks: ['awaiting_fee'], hasReturnable: false });
      const returns = await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID);
      await expect(returnCard(returns, LABEL).getByText(`お支払い待ち ${formatYen(800)}`)).toBeVisible();

      // 手数料の受け取りを記録する: 確かめの文・メモの欄。「戻る」では何も送らない
      const fee = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, '手数料の受け取りを記録する', RETURN_TEXT.feeTitle);
      await expect(fee.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.feeBody(formatYen(800)))).toBeVisible();
      await fee.getByRole('button', { name: '戻る', exact: true }).click();
      expect(state.posts['fee-payment']).toHaveLength(0);
      const feeAgain = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, '手数料の受け取りを記録する', RETURN_TEXT.feeTitle);
      await expect(feeAgain.getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.feeWaiveButton, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await feeAgain.getByRole('textbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.feeMemoLabel, exact: true }).fill('銀行振込');
      await feeAgain.getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.feeRecordButton, exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts['fee-payment'].length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts['fee-payment'][0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      expect(state.posts['fee-payment'][0].body).toMatchObject({ note: '銀行振込', waive: false });

      // いただかないで終える（実装計画 P27。仕様書 6-4「額を0に直す」）: 同じ画面のもう1つのボタン。窓口へ waive: true が届き、知らせが出る
      const feeWaive = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, '手数料の受け取りを記録する', RETURN_TEXT.feeTitle);
      await feeWaive.getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.feeWaiveButton, exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts['fee-payment'].length).toBe(2);
      expect(state.posts['fee-payment'][1].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      expect(state.posts['fee-payment'][1].body).toMatchObject({ waive: true });
      await expect(
        page.getByRole('dialog', { name: returnsDialogName(ORDER_ID), exact: true }).getByRole('status'),
      ).toContainText(RETURN_TEXT.feeWaivedNotice);

      // 支払いを待たずに送る: 確かめの文
      const release = await openOperationDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL, '支払いを待たずに送る', RETURN_TEXT.releaseTitle);
      await expect(release.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.releaseBody)).toBeVisible();
      await release.getByRole('button', { name: '支払いを待たずに送る', exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts['release-exchange'].length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts['release-exchange'][0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
    });

    test('在庫から交換する受け取りは、交換の品の行（値段0・元の支払額つき）を足して在庫を確保し、注文を支払い済みに戻す。送ると発送済みに進む（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-04
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `exch-stock-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 2 });
        expect((await orderState(db, fx.orderId)).status).toBe('shipped');
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }] });

        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
        });
        expect(received).toMatchObject({ returnStatus: 'closed', feeDueAmount: 0, refundId: null });
        expect(received.exchangeOrderItemIds).toHaveLength(1);

        // 交換の品の行: 値段0・元の品の支払額を持つ・在庫から
        const [exchange] = await exchangeItemRows(db, fx.orderId);
        expect(exchange).toMatchObject({
          id: received.exchangeOrderItemIds[0],
          quantity: 1,
          item_price: 0,
          line_total: 0,
          line_kind: 'exchange',
          fulfillment_type: 'stock',
          exchange_paid_amount: PRICE,
        });
        expect(Number(exchange.variant_id)).toBe(variantL);
        // 在庫の台帳 exchange の −1 で確保し、元の品は戻さない（台帳に return は無い）
        expect(await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([
          { reason: 'exchange', delta: -1, return_id: created.returnId, variant_id: variantL },
        ]);
        expect((await variantStockState(db, variantL)).stock).toBe(1);
        // 発送済みの注文に未発送ができたので、支払い済みに戻る。全部を送った時の値は空になる
        expect(await orderState(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'paid', shipped_at: null, shipping_carrier: null, tracking_number: null });

        // 交換の品を送ると、発送済みに進む
        const shipped = await createFulfillment(db, fx.orderId, fx.actorId, {
          trackingNumber: 'E2E-EXCH-1',
          notify: false,
          lines: [{ orderItemId: exchange.id, quantity: 1 }],
        });
        expect(shipped).toMatchObject({ completesOrder: true, orderStatus: 'shipped' });
        expect((await orderState(db, fx.orderId)).status).toBe('shipped');
      });
    });

    test('作って送る交換は台帳を動かさず、仕上がりを記録するまで送れない。在庫不足で設定が「作って送る」なら自動で作って送るに変わる（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-05
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `exch-make-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 0 });

        // 最初から「作って送る」: 台帳は動かず、受注生産の行になる。仕上がりを記録してから送れる
        const planned = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'make' } }],
        });
        const first = await receiveReturnInDb(db, planned.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: planned.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
        });
        const [made] = await exchangeItemRows(db, fx.orderId);
        expect(made).toMatchObject({ id: first.exchangeOrderItemIds[0], fulfillment_type: 'backorder', line_kind: 'exchange' });
        expect(await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        await expectDbError(
          createFulfillment(db, fx.orderId, fx.actorId, { trackingNumber: 'E2E-MAKE-0', notify: false, lines: [{ orderItemId: made.id, quantity: 1 }] }),
          'QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_READY',
        );
        await recordCompletion(db, fx.orderId, fx.actorId, [{ orderItemId: made.id, quantity: 1 }]);
        expect(
          await createFulfillment(db, fx.orderId, fx.actorId, { trackingNumber: 'E2E-MAKE-1', notify: false, lines: [{ orderItemId: made.id, quantity: 1 }] }),
        ).toMatchObject({ completesOrder: true, orderStatus: 'shipped' });

        // 「在庫から」の予定でも、在庫が足りず、理由（破損・不良）の設定が「作って送る」なら、自動で作って送るに変わる
        const automatic = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, reason: 'defective', exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
        });
        const second = await receiveReturnInDb(db, automatic.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: automatic.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
        });
        const rows = await exchangeItemRows(db, fx.orderId);
        expect(rows.find((row) => row.id === second.exchangeOrderItemIds[0])).toMatchObject({ fulfillment_type: 'backorder' });
        expect(await receiptUnitRows(db, second.receiptId)).toEqual([
          { disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1, resolution: 'exchange', exchange_method: 'make' },
        ]);
        expect(await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test('在庫が足りず設定が「受けない」の交換は、店長の選びが無いと断られ、「作って送る」か「返金に変える」を選んだ時だけ受け取れる（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-05
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `exch-decline-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 0 });
        // サイズが小さい: 在庫の無い交換は受けない（最初の値）
        const first = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
        });
        const units = [{ lineId: first.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked' as const, quantity: 1 }];

        await expectDbError(receiveReturnInDb(db, first.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, choice: 'none' }), 'RETURN_EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK');
        expect(await exchangeItemRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        // 店長が「作って送る」を選ぶと受けられる
        const made = await receiveReturnInDb(db, first.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units,
          choice: 'none',
          exchangeOverrides: [{ lineId: first.lineIds[shirt], action: 'make' }],
        });
        expect(made.exchangeOrderItemIds).toHaveLength(1);
        expect((await exchangeItemRows(db, fx.orderId))[0]).toMatchObject({ fulfillment_type: 'backorder' });

        // 「返金に変える」を選ぶと、交換の品は足さず、返金の品として相談の受け取りになる
        const second = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
        });
        const changed = await receiveReturnInDb(db, second.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: second.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'consult',
          exchangeOverrides: [{ lineId: second.lineIds[shirt], action: 'refund' }],
        });
        expect(changed.exchangeOrderItemIds).toEqual([]);
        expect(await exchangeItemRows(db, fx.orderId)).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(await receiptUnitRows(db, changed.receiptId)).toEqual([
          { disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1, resolution: 'refund', exchange_method: null },
        ]);
        expect((await lineProgressOf(db, second.returnId))[second.lineIds[shirt]]).toMatchObject({ refund_waiting: 1 });
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ has_returnable: false });
      });
    });

    test('手数料のお支払い待ちの交換の品は送れず、手数料の受け取りを記録すると送れて返品が完了する。支払いを待たずに送ると送れるが、手数料は残って返品は完了しない。いただかないで終えると、返品が完了し送れて、手数料の額は履歴のために残る（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-07, FREQ-467-AC-04, FREQ-467-AC-05
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `exch-fee-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 3, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 4 });
        const exchangeFee = { exchangeFee: 500, exchangeShippingFee: 300 };
        const ship = (itemId: string, tracking: string) =>
          createFulfillment(db, fx.orderId, fx.actorId, { trackingNumber: tracking, notify: false, lines: [{ orderItemId: itemId, quantity: 1 }] });

        // 返品A: 交換だけの受け取り。手数料（500円 + 300円）は引く返金が無いので、そのままお支払い待ちになる
        const a = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
          ...exchangeFee,
        });
        const receivedA = await receiveReturnInDb(db, a.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: a.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
        });
        expect(receivedA).toMatchObject({ feeDueAmount: 800, returnStatus: 'open' });
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, a.returnId)).toMatchObject({ fee_due_amount: 800, fee_received_at: null, exchange_released_at: null });
        expect((await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).marks).toContain('awaiting_fee');
        const itemA = receivedA.exchangeOrderItemIds[0];
        await expectDbError(ship(itemA, 'E2E-HOLD-A'), 'FULFILLMENT_EXCHANGE_ON_HOLD');

        // 手数料の受け取りを記録すると、送れて、返品は完了する
        await recordFeePaymentInDb(db, a.returnId, fx.actorId, '銀行振込');
        expect(await returnRowOf(db, a.returnId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'closed' });
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, a.returnId)).fee_received_at).not.toBeNull();
        expect(await ship(itemA, 'E2E-HOLD-A')).toMatchObject({ completesOrder: true, orderStatus: 'shipped' });

        // 返品B: 同じ形。支払いを待たずに送ると送れるが、手数料は残り、返品は完了しない
        const b = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
          ...exchangeFee,
        });
        const receivedB = await receiveReturnInDb(db, b.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: b.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
        });
        const itemB = receivedB.exchangeOrderItemIds[0];
        await expectDbError(ship(itemB, 'E2E-HOLD-B'), 'FULFILLMENT_EXCHANGE_ON_HOLD');
        await releaseExchangeInDb(db, b.returnId, fx.actorId);
        expect(await ship(itemB, 'E2E-HOLD-B')).toMatchObject({ completesOrder: true, orderStatus: 'shipped' });
        const rowB = await returnRowOf(db, b.returnId);
        expect(rowB).toMatchObject({ status: 'open', fee_due_amount: 800, fee_received_at: null });
        expect(rowB.exchange_released_at).not.toBeNull();
        // 手数料の受け取りを記録するまで、返品Bは完了にならない
        await recordFeePaymentInDb(db, b.returnId, fx.actorId, null);
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, b.returnId)).status).toBe('closed');
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, b.returnId)).fee_waived).toBe(false);

        // 返品C: 同じ形。「いただかないで終える」（実装計画 P27）と、返品は完了し、交換の品を送れる。
        // 手数料の額（800円）は履歴のために残り、受け取った物ではなく「いただかないことにした」印（fee_waived）が付く
        const c = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
          ...exchangeFee,
        });
        const receivedC = await receiveReturnInDb(db, c.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: c.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
        });
        const itemC = receivedC.exchangeOrderItemIds[0];
        await expectDbError(ship(itemC, 'E2E-HOLD-C'), 'FULFILLMENT_EXCHANGE_ON_HOLD');
        expect(await recordFeePaymentInDb(db, c.returnId, fx.actorId, '常連のお客様のため', true)).toBe('closed');
        const rowC = await returnRowOf(db, c.returnId);
        expect(rowC).toMatchObject({ status: 'closed', fee_due_amount: 800, fee_waived: true });
        expect(rowC.fee_received_at).not.toBeNull();
        expect((await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).marks).not.toContain('awaiting_fee');
        expect(await ship(itemC, 'E2E-HOLD-C')).toMatchObject({ completesOrder: true, orderStatus: 'shipped' });
      });
    });

    test('交換の品を受け取ったお知らせに、交換の品・手数料のお支払い待ちの文が入る（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-03
      test.setTimeout(180_000);
      const { fx, label } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `exch-mail-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 2 });
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
          exchangeFee: 500,
          exchangeShippingFee: 300,
        });
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
          notify: true,
        });
        return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
      });

      const mails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.received);
      await runWorkerUntil(request, async () => (await sentReturnMailCount(fx.orderId, 'return_received')) >= 1, '返品をお受け取りしましたが送信済みになること');
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(mails[0].Subject).toBe(`【Le Fil des Heures】${RETURN_MAIL.received}（${orderNumberOf(fx.orderId)}）`);
      const text = mails[0].Text;
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(label));
      expect(text).toContain('交換の品をお送りします:');
      expect(text).toContain('・E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / L） × 1');
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.payLater(formatYen(800)));
      // 返金は無いので、返金の額の案内（相談の文）は入らない
      expect(text).not.toContain(RETURN_MAIL.consult);
    });

    test('作って送る交換の品がある受け取りのお知らせに「お作りしてお送りします。」が入り、商品に目安の日数がある時だけ「お届けの目安は n日ほどです。」が続く（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-03
      test.setTimeout(240_000);
      const leadDays = 12;
      // 作って送る交換の受け取りを、目安の日数がある商品と、無い商品（空）で1つずつ作る
      const receiveMake = (tag: string, days: number | null) =>
        withLocalDb(async (db) => {
          const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `exch-make-${tag}-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
          const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
          const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 0 });
          if (days !== null) await db.query('update public.items set made_to_order_lead_days = $2 where id = $1', [fx.itemId, days]);
          const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
            lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'make' } }],
          });
          await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
            units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
            choice: 'none',
            notify: true,
          });
          return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
        });
      const withDays = await receiveMake('days', leadDays);
      const withoutDays = await receiveMake('nodays', null);

      const [daysMail] = await waitForMails(request, withDays.fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.received);
      const row = daysMail.Text.indexOf('・E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / L） × 1');
      expect(daysMail.Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(withDays.label));
      expect(daysMail.Text).toContain('交換の品をお送りします:');
      expect(row).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      // 目安の一文は、作って送る品の行の後に入る。手数料は無いので、お支払い待ちの文は入らない
      expect(daysMail.Text.indexOf(RETURN_MAIL.makeNote(leadDays))).toBeGreaterThan(row);
      expect(daysMail.Text).not.toContain('のお支払いを確かめてからお送りします');

      // 目安の日数が無い商品は「お作りしてお送りします。」だけで、日数は書かない（実装計画 C-6）
      const [plainMail] = await waitForMails(request, withoutDays.fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.received);
      expect(plainMail.Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(withoutDays.label));
      expect(plainMail.Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.makeShort);
      expect(plainMail.Text).not.toContain('お届けの目安');
    });

    test('交換の品を送った発送のお知らせに、交換の一文が入り、交換の品の行の末尾に「（交換の品）」が付く（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-05
      test.setTimeout(180_000);
      const fx = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `exch-ship-mail-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        // 交換の品の行の品名は、受け取りの時に商品の名前（items.name）を写す（Task 3）。道具が作る商品の名前は fx-… なので、
        // 発送のお知らせの行を品名で探せるよう、元の品と同じ名前にしておく（商品の名前に一意の決まりは無い）
        await db.query('update public.items set name = $2 where id = $1', [fx.itemId, 'E2Eシャツ']);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 2 });
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
          notify: false,
        });
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
          notify: false,
        });
        // お知らせを入れて、交換の品だけを送る
        await createFulfillment(db, fx.orderId, fx.actorId, {
          trackingNumber: 'E2E-EXCH-MAIL',
          notify: true,
          lines: [{ orderItemId: received.exchangeOrderItemIds[0], quantity: 1 }],
        });
        return fx;
      });

      const mails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.shipped);
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      const text = mails[0].Text;
      expect(text).toContain('E2E-EXCH-MAIL');
      const sentence = text.indexOf(RETURN_MAIL.exchangeShipped);
      expect(sentence).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      // 交換の一文は、発送の品の行より前に入る。その行の末尾に「（交換の品）」が付く
      expect(text.indexOf('E2Eシャツ')).toBeGreaterThan(sentence);
      expect(text).toMatch(/E2Eシャツ[^\n]*x1[^\n]*（交換の品）/);
    });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: `FR-ADMIN-089` お返し**

`e2e/FR-ADMIN-089-return-sent-back.spec.ts`（新規。6件。FREQ-466-AC-01〜05、FREQ-469-AC-04。258行）。6件×3画面幅。お返しの欄（メッセージ・配送業者・伝票番号）と確かめ、「お客様に知らせる」が外せないことを、窓口を差し替えて確かめる。お返しが返金も交換もせず在庫を動かさないこと、メッセージが無いと断られること、お返しした品はまた返品できないこと、一部をお返しして残りを返金した時の返金のお知らせのお返しの節、全部をお返しした時の「品物をお返しします」を、手元の DB と Mailpit で確かめる。

```ts
/**
 * FR-ADMIN-089 お返し（条件に合わない品を、返金も交換もせずにお客様へお返しする）
 * 対応 FREQ: FREQ-466（AC-01〜AC-05）、FREQ-469（AC-04）
 *
 * 画面（受け取りの「お返し」の欄・確かめ）は窓口の答えを差し替えて確かめ、お返しの DB の動き（返金・在庫・数え方）とメールは、
 * 窓口が呼ぶのと同じ DB の関数を手元の DB に直に呼んで確かめる（実装計画 P11）。
 */
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  expectDbError,
  mailBodies,
  recordRefundResult,
  runWorkerUntil,
  sentOutboxCount,
  variantStockState,
  withLocalDb,
} from './order-email-test-utils';
import { UUID_PATTERN, mockOrderList, openOrderTab, orderNumberOf, viewports } from './order-fulfillment-test-utils';
import { mockAdminSessionAs } from './refund-test-utils';
import {
  RETURN_MAIL,
  RETURN_TEXT,
  UNIT_STATES,
  confirmButton,
  createReturnInDb,
  createShippedOrder,
  lineProgressOf,
  mockReturnRoutes,
  newReturnRouteState,
  openReceiveDialog,
  openReturnsDialog,
  orderWithReturns,
  receiveReturnInDb,
  returnEmailRows,
  returnLabelOf,
  returnLedger,
  returnLineOf,
  returnDetailOf,
  returnRefundRows,
  returnRowOf,
  returnSummaryOf,
  returnableByItem,
  sentReturnMailCount,
  setUnitState,
  unitTotal,
  waitForMails,
} from './return-test-utils';

const ORDER_ID = 'a9b2c3d4-0089-4000-8000-000000000089';
const SHIRT = 'c9b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LINE = 'd9b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const RETURN_ID = 'b9b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 1);
const MESSAGE = 'タグが外れ、着用の跡があったため、お返しします。';

/** 受け取り待ちの返品（シャツ1点）の受け取りの画面まで開く */
async function openReceive(page: Page) {
  const detail = returnDetailOf({
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    id: RETURN_ID,
    lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ' })],
  });
  const state = newReturnRouteState({ orderId: ORDER_ID, returns: [detail], returnableUnits: 0, refundableAmount: 20_000 });
  await mockAdminSessionAs(page, 'admin');
  await mockOrderList(page, () => [
    orderWithReturns({
      id: ORDER_ID,
      summary: returnSummaryOf({ orderId: ORDER_ID, displayStatus: 'in_progress', marks: ['awaiting_items'], nextAction: 'receive', hasReturnable: false }),
    }),
  ]);
  await mockReturnRoutes(page, ORDER_ID, state);
  await openOrderTab(page);
  await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');
  const dialog = await openReceiveDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL);
  return { state, dialog };
}

for (const viewport of viewports) {
  test.describe(`FR-ADMIN-089 return sent back (${viewport.name})`, () => {
    test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
    });

    test('「条件に合わないのでお返しする」を選ぶとお返しの欄が出て、押す前に確かめが出る。確かめの後に、メッセージ・配送業者・伝票番号が窓口へ届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-466-AC-01
      const { state, dialog } = await openReceive(page);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.sentBack);

      await expect(dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.sentBackMessageLabel, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.sentBackCarrierLabel, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.sentBackTrackingLabel, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllSentBack)).toBeVisible();
      await dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.sentBackMessageLabel, exact: true }).fill(MESSAGE);
      await dialog.getByRole('combobox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.sentBackCarrierLabel, exact: true }).selectOption({ label: 'ヤマト運輸' });
      await dialog.getByRole('textbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.sentBackTrackingLabel, exact: true }).fill('ABC-123');

      // 押す前の確かめ。「戻る」では何も送らない
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllSentBack).click();
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.sentBackConfirm)).toBeVisible();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: '戻る', exact: true }).click();
      expect(state.posts.receive).toHaveLength(0);

      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.receiveAllSentBack).click();
      await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'お返しする', exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].returnId).toBe(RETURN_ID);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({
        refundChoice: 'none',
        notifyCustomer: true,
        sentBackMessage: MESSAGE,
        sentBackCarrier: 'yamato',
        sentBackTrackingNumber: 'ABC-123',
      });
      expect(unitTotal(state.posts.receive[0].body, LINE, 'sent_back')).toBe(1);
      expect(String(state.posts.receive[0].body.requestKey)).toMatch(UUID_PATTERN);
    });

    test('お返しを含む時は、「お客様に知らせる」が入ったまま外せない', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-466-AC-02
      const { dialog } = await openReceive(page);
      const notify = dialog.getByRole('checkbox', { name: RETURN_TEXT.notifyLabel, exact: true });
      await expect(notify).toBeChecked();
      await expect(notify).toBeEnabled();

      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.sentBack);
      await expect(notify).toBeChecked();
      await expect(notify).toBeDisabled();

      // お返しをやめて「在庫に戻す」に替えると、外せるようになる
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);
      await expect(notify).toBeEnabled();
    });

    test('お返しは返金も交換もせず、在庫を動かさない。メッセージが無いと断られ、断られた操作は何も残さない（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-466-AC-03
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `sent-back-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], notify: false });
        const lineId = created.lineIds[shirt];
        const units = [{ lineId, disposition: 'sent_back' as const, quantity: 1 }];

        await expectDbError(
          receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, choice: 'none', notify: true }),
          'RETURN_SENT_BACK_MESSAGE_REQUIRED',
        );
        expect((await lineProgressOf(db, created.returnId))[lineId]).toMatchObject({ sent_back: 0, unprocessed: 1 });

        const sent = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units,
          choice: 'none',
          notify: true,
          sentBack: { message: MESSAGE, carrier: 'yamato', trackingNumber: 'ABC-123' },
        });
        // 返金の記録も交換の品も作らず、在庫の台帳も動かさない。品は「お返し」の数になり、返品は完了する
        expect(sent).toMatchObject({ refundId: null, refundAmount: null, exchangeOrderItemIds: [], returnStatus: 'closed', feeDueAmount: 0 });
        expect(await returnRefundRows(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(0);
        expect((await lineProgressOf(db, created.returnId))[lineId]).toMatchObject({ sent_back: 1, unprocessed: 0, refund_waiting: 0 });
        expect((await returnRowOf(db, created.returnId)).status).toBe('closed');
      });
    });

    test('お返しした品は、同じ品でもう一度返品できない（返品できる数から外れる）（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-466-AC-04
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `sent-back-again-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], notify: false });
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'sent_back', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
          notify: true,
          sentBack: { message: MESSAGE },
        });

        // 完了した返品でも、お返しした1点は数え続ける。返品できるのは残りの1点だけ
        expect(await returnableByItem(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual({ [shirt]: 1 });
        await expectDbError(createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }] }), 'RETURN_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS');
        expect(await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }] })).toMatchObject({ number: 2, status: 'open' });
      });
    });

    test('一部をお返しして残りを返金すると、返金のお知らせにお返しの節が入り、お客様へのメールは返金のお知らせの1通だけになる（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-466-AC-05
      test.setTimeout(240_000);
      const { fx, label } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `sent-back-mix-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 2 }], notify: false });
        const lineId = created.lineIds[shirt];
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [
            { lineId, disposition: 'sent_back', quantity: 1 },
            { lineId, disposition: 'restocked', quantity: 1 },
          ],
          choice: 'now',
          notify: true,
          sentBack: { message: MESSAGE, carrier: 'yamato', trackingNumber: 'ABC-123' },
        });
        // 返金は、戻した1点の分だけ（お返しの1点は返金しない）
        expect(received).toMatchObject({ refundAmount: 5_000, returnStatus: 'closed' });
        await recordRefundResult(db, received.refundId as string);
        return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
      });

      await runWorkerUntil(request, async () => (await sentOutboxCount(fx.orderId, 'refund')) >= 1, '返金のお知らせが送信済みになること');
      const refundMails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.refund);
      expect(refundMails).toHaveLength(1);
      const text = refundMails[0].Text;
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.received1(label));
      expect(text).toContain('お返しする商品:');
      expect(text).toContain('当店より:');
      expect(text).toContain(MESSAGE);
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.sentBackTracking('ヤマト運輸', 'ABC-123'));
      // お返しだけのメールや、受け取りのお知らせは、別に届かない
      expect(await mailBodies(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.sentBack)).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(await mailBodies(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.received)).toHaveLength(0);
      expect((await withLocalDb((db) => returnEmailRows(db, fx.orderId))).map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['refund']);
    });

    test('全部をお返しすると「品物をお返しします」が1通届き、お店のメッセージと伝票番号が入る（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-469-AC-04
      test.setTimeout(180_000);
      const { fx, label } = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `sent-back-mail-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], notify: false });
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
          units: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'sent_back', quantity: 1 }],
          choice: 'none',
          notify: true,
          sentBack: { message: MESSAGE, carrier: 'yamato', trackingNumber: 'ABC-123' },
        });
        return { fx, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
      });

      const mails = await waitForMails(request, fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.sentBack);
      await runWorkerUntil(request, async () => (await sentReturnMailCount(fx.orderId, 'return_sent_back')) >= 1, '品物をお返ししますが送信済みになること');
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(mails[0].Subject).toBe(`【Le Fil des Heures】${RETURN_MAIL.sentBack}（${orderNumberOf(fx.orderId)}）`);
      const text = mails[0].Text;
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.sentBackLead(label));
      expect(text).toContain('お返しする商品:');
      expect(text).toContain('・E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / M） × 1');
      expect(text).toContain('当店より:');
      expect(text).toContain(MESSAGE);
      expect(text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.sentBackTracking('ヤマト運輸', 'ABC-123'));
    });
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: `FR-ADMIN-090` サポートの受け取りと、店への知らせ**

`e2e/FR-ADMIN-090-return-support-receive.spec.ts`（新規。6件。FREQ-464-AC-11〜13、FREQ-465-AC-02、FREQ-469-AC-06、FREQ-471-AC-06。330行）。6件×3画面幅。サポートの受け取りの画面（返金の欄は文だけ・「受けない」の品は受け取れない・「作って送る」になる品は文だけ）とサポートの一覧・返品の画面に返金に関わるボタンが出ないことを、窓口を差し替えて確かめる。サポートの受け取りが今返金と額の直しを `RETURN_FORBIDDEN` で断り、相談なら受け取れて返金待ちになること、店への知らせが1通届き同じ番号で送り直しても2通にならないこと、店長が額を直して返金するとお客様に返金のお知らせが1通届くことを、手元の DB と Mailpit で確かめる。

```ts
/**
 * FR-ADMIN-090 サポートの人の受け取り
 * 対応 FREQ: FREQ-464（AC-11〜AC-13）、FREQ-465（AC-02 のサポートの分）、FREQ-469（AC-06）、FREQ-471（AC-06）
 *
 * サポートの人（役割 supporter）は、返品の受け取りはできるが、返金に関わる操作（今返金・額を直す・額を決めて返金・手数料の受け取りの記録・
 * 支払いを待たずに送る）はできない。画面は窓口の答えを差し替えて確かめ、DB の関数の断り・店への知らせ・店長の返金は、
 * 窓口が呼ぶのと同じ DB の関数を手元の DB に直に呼んで確かめる（実装計画 P11）。窓口の権限の組合せは単体の試験（return-routes）が確かめる。
 */
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  expectDbError,
  recordRefundResult,
  runWorkerUntil,
  runWorkerOnce,
  sentOutboxCount,
  variantStockState,
  withLocalDb,
} from './order-email-test-utils';
import { mockOrderList, openOrderTab, orderNumberOf, viewports } from './order-fulfillment-test-utils';
import { mockAdminSessionAs } from './refund-test-utils';
import {
  RETURN_MAIL,
  RETURN_TEXT,
  UNIT_STATES,
  addVariant,
  confirmButton,
  createReturnInDb,
  createShippedOrder,
  exchangeOf,
  formatYen,
  mockReturnRoutes,
  newReturnRouteState,
  openReceiveDialog,
  openReturnsDialog,
  orderWithReturns,
  receiptRows,
  receiveReturnInDb,
  refundReturnInDb,
  returnCard,
  returnDetailOf,
  returnEmailRows,
  returnLabelOf,
  returnLedger,
  returnLineOf,
  returnSummaryOf,
  returnSummaryRow,
  setUnitState,
  shopAlertsFor,
  waitForMails,
} from './return-test-utils';
import type { OrderReturnDetail, OrderReturnLineDetail } from '@/lib/orders/returns/return-types';

const ORDER_ID = 'a0b2c3d4-0090-4000-8000-000000000090';
const SHIRT = 'c0b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const LINE = 'd0b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const SECOND_LINE = 'd0b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const THIRD_LINE = 'd0b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
const RETURN_ID = 'b0b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const SECOND_RETURN_ID = 'b0b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
const THIRD_RETURN_ID = 'b0b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
const LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 1);
const SECOND_LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 2);
const THIRD_LABEL = returnLabelOf(ORDER_ID, 3);

/** サポートの人として、受け取り待ちの返品（渡した行）の受け取りの画面まで開く */
async function openSupportReceive(page: Page, lines: OrderReturnLineDetail[]) {
  const detail = returnDetailOf({ orderId: ORDER_ID, id: RETURN_ID, lines });
  const state = newReturnRouteState({ orderId: ORDER_ID, returns: [detail], returnableUnits: 0, refundableAmount: 20_000, canRefund: false });
  await mockAdminSessionAs(page, 'supporter');
  await mockOrderList(page, () => [
    orderWithReturns({
      id: ORDER_ID,
      canRefund: false,
      summary: returnSummaryOf({ orderId: ORDER_ID, displayStatus: 'in_progress', marks: ['awaiting_items'], nextAction: 'receive', hasReturnable: false }),
    }),
  ]);
  await mockReturnRoutes(page, ORDER_ID, state);
  await openOrderTab(page);
  await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');
  const dialog = await openReceiveDialog(page, ORDER_ID, LABEL);
  return { state, dialog };
}

for (const viewport of viewports) {
  test.describe(`FR-ADMIN-090 return support receive (${viewport.name})`, () => {
    test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height });
    });

    test('サポートの人の受け取りの画面は、返金の欄が文だけで、確定のボタンが「受け取りだけ記録する（額は店長が決める）」になり、窓口へ相談が届く', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-11
      const { state, dialog } = await openSupportReceive(page, [
        returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ' }),
      ]);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 0, UNIT_STATES.restock);

      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.supportRefundNote)).toBeVisible();
      // 返金額の入力も、「計算どおり」の選びも出ない
      await expect(dialog.getByLabel(/^返金額（返せる額/)).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: RETURN_TEXT.nowOption })).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.supportConsultButton)).toBeVisible();
      await confirmButton(dialog, RETURN_TEXT.supportConsultButton).click();

      await expect.poll(() => state.posts.receive.length).toBe(1);
      expect(state.posts.receive[0].body).toMatchObject({ refundChoice: 'consult' });
      await expect(
        page.getByRole('dialog', { name: `返品（${orderNumberOf(ORDER_ID)}）`, exact: true }).getByRole('status'),
      ).toContainText(RETURN_TEXT.noticeRecorded);
    });

    test('在庫が足りない交換の品は、サポートの人には「この品は店長が受け取ります。」と出て、受け取りに選べない。自動で作って送るになる品は文だけで、選びは出ない', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-02
      const { dialog } = await openSupportReceive(page, [
        returnLineOf({
          id: LINE,
          orderItemId: SHIRT,
          quantity: 1,
          itemName: 'E2Eシャツ',
          exchange: exchangeOf({ method: 'stock', stockQuantity: 0, outOfStockExchange: 'decline' }),
        }),
        returnLineOf({
          id: SECOND_LINE,
          orderItemId: SHIRT,
          quantity: 1,
          itemName: 'E2Eスカート',
          exchange: exchangeOf({ method: 'stock', size: 'XL', stockQuantity: 0, outOfStockExchange: 'make' }),
        }),
      ]);

      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.stockDeclineSupport)).toBeVisible();
      // 在庫を超える交換の品の点は、「届いた」にできない。「作って送る」「返金に変える」の選びも出ない（店長だけ）
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '届いた', exact: true })).toHaveCount(2);
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '届いた', exact: true }).first()).toBeDisabled();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: '作って送る', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: '返金に変える', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      // 自動で作って送るになる品は、サポートの人も「届いた」にできる（選ぶ物が無い）。届いた点の状態を選ぶと、「交換の品」の欄に
      // 文だけが出る（Task 9: 在庫の足りなさは今回受け取る点で数え、交換の品の欄は受け取る点がある行だけに出す）
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('checkbox', { name: '届いた', exact: true }).nth(1)).toBeEnabled();
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.stockMake)).toHaveCount(0);
      await setUnitState(dialog, 1, UNIT_STATES.keep);
      await expect(dialog.getByText(RETURN_TEXT.stockMake)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: '作って送る', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(dialog.getByRole('radio', { name: '返金に変える', exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    });

    test('サポートの人には、額を決めて返金する・手数料の受け取りの記録・支払いを待たずに送るが出ない。受け取り・取消は出る', async ({ page }) => {
      // FREQ-471-AC-06
      const waiting: OrderReturnDetail = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: RETURN_ID,
        displayStatus: 'refund_waiting',
        marks: [],
        firstReceiptDone: true,
        receipts: [{ id: randomUUID(), kind: 'receive', refundChoice: 'consult', createdAt: '2026-10-11T01:00:00.000Z', actorEmail: 'support@example.com' }],
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', progress: { restocked: 1, refundWaiting: 1 } })],
      });
      const awaitingFee: OrderReturnDetail = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: SECOND_RETURN_ID,
        number: 2,
        marks: ['awaiting_fee'],
        firstReceiptDone: true,
        firstExchangeReceiptDone: true,
        fees: { exchangeFee: 500, exchangeShippingFee: 300, feeDueAmount: 800 },
        receipts: [{ id: randomUUID(), kind: 'receive', refundChoice: 'none', createdAt: '2026-10-11T02:00:00.000Z', actorEmail: 'support@example.com' }],
        lines: [
          returnLineOf({
            id: SECOND_LINE,
            orderItemId: SHIRT,
            quantity: 1,
            itemName: 'E2Eシャツ',
            exchange: exchangeOf({ method: 'stock' }),
            progress: { notRestocked: 1, exchanged: 1 },
          }),
        ],
        exchangeItems: [
          { orderItemId: SHIRT, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ', color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock', shipped: 0 },
        ],
      });
      const untouched: OrderReturnDetail = returnDetailOf({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        id: THIRD_RETURN_ID,
        number: 3,
        lines: [returnLineOf({ id: THIRD_LINE, orderItemId: SHIRT, quantity: 1, itemName: 'E2Eシャツ' })],
      });
      const state = newReturnRouteState({
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        returns: [waiting, awaitingFee, untouched],
        returnableUnits: 0,
        canRefund: false,
      });
      await mockAdminSessionAs(page, 'supporter');
      await mockOrderList(page, () => [
        orderWithReturns({
          id: ORDER_ID,
          canRefund: false,
          summary: returnSummaryOf({ orderId: ORDER_ID, displayStatus: 'in_progress', marks: ['awaiting_items'], nextAction: 'receive', hasReturnable: false }),
        }),
      ]);
      await mockReturnRoutes(page, ORDER_ID, state);
      await openOrderTab(page);
      const returns = await openReturnsDialog(page, ORDER_ID, '受け取る');

      for (const label of [LABEL, SECOND_LABEL, THIRD_LABEL]) {
        await expect(returnCard(returns, label)).toBeVisible();
        for (const name of ['額を決めて返金する', '手数料の受け取りを記録する', '支払いを待たずに送る']) {
          await expect(returnCard(returns, label).getByRole('button', { name, exact: true }), `${label} の「${name}」`).toHaveCount(0);
        }
      }
      // サポートの人にも出る操作: 受け取る・何も受け取っていない返品の取消
      await expect(returnCard(returns, THIRD_LABEL).getByRole('button', { name: '受け取る', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(returnCard(returns, THIRD_LABEL).getByRole('button', { name: RETURN_TEXT.cancelTitle, exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      // お支払い待ちの手数料の額は見える
      await expect(returnCard(returns, SECOND_LABEL).getByText(`お支払い待ち ${formatYen(800)}`)).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('サポートの人の受け取りは、今返金と額の直しを DB の関数が断り、相談なら受け取れて返金待ちになる。店への知らせは1通で、同じ番号の送り直しでも増えない（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-12, FREQ-471-AC-06
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `support-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], notify: false });
        const units = [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked' as const, quantity: 1 }];

        // 今返金も、額を直すことも、サポートの人はできない。断られた受け取りは何も残さない
        await expectDbError(receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, canRefund: false, choice: 'now' }), 'RETURN_FORBIDDEN');
        await expectDbError(
          receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, canRefund: false, choice: 'consult', amount: 1_000 }),
          'RETURN_FORBIDDEN',
        );
        expect(await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await returnLedger(db, fx.orderId)).toEqual([]);
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(0);

        // 相談なら受け取れる。返金の記録は作らず、返金待ちになり、店への知らせの予定が1つ書かれる
        const key = randomUUID();
        const received = await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, canRefund: false, choice: 'consult', requestKey: key });
        expect(received).toMatchObject({ refundId: null, returnStatus: 'open', shopNoticeEnqueued: true, replayed: false });
        expect((await receiptRows(db, created.returnId))[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'receive', refund_choice: 'consult', actor_can_refund: false });
        expect(await returnSummaryRow(db, fx.orderId)).toMatchObject({ display_status: 'refund_waiting', next_action: 'refund' });
        expect((await variantStockState(db, fx.variantId)).stock).toBe(1);

        // 同じ番号で送り直しても、受け取りも店への知らせも増えない
        expect(await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, canRefund: false, choice: 'consult', requestKey: key })).toMatchObject({
          receiptId: received.receiptId,
          replayed: true,
        });
        expect(await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).toHaveLength(1);
        expect((await returnEmailRows(db, fx.orderId)).filter((row) => row.kind === 'return_refund_pending_shop')).toHaveLength(1);
      });
    });

    test('サポートの人の交換の受け取りは、在庫が足りず設定が「受けない」なら断られ、「作って送る」の選びも店長だけができる（手元の DB）', async () => {
      // FREQ-465-AC-02
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `support-exch-${viewport.name}`, [{ name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' }]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const variantL = await addVariant(db, fx.itemId, { color: 'ホワイト', size: 'L', stock: 0 });
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, {
          lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1, exchange: { variantId: variantL, method: 'stock' } }],
          notify: false,
        });
        const units = [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'not_restocked' as const, quantity: 1 }];

        await expectDbError(
          receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, canRefund: false, choice: 'none' }),
          'RETURN_EXCHANGE_OUT_OF_STOCK',
        );
        await expectDbError(
          receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, {
            units,
            canRefund: false,
            choice: 'none',
            exchangeOverrides: [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], action: 'make' }],
          }),
          'RETURN_FORBIDDEN',
        );
        expect(await receiptRows(db, created.returnId)).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test('店への知らせ「返金待ちの返品があります」が1通届き、同じ番号の送り直しでも増えない。店長が額を直して返金すると、お客様に返金のお知らせが1通届く（手元の DB・Mailpit）', async ({ request }) => {
      // FREQ-464-AC-13, FREQ-469-AC-06
      test.setTimeout(240_000);
      const context = await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const fx = await createShippedOrder(db, `support-mail-${viewport.name}`, [
          { name: 'E2Eシャツ', quantity: 2, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
          { name: 'E2Eスカート', quantity: 1, fulfillmentType: 'stock' },
        ]);
        const shirt = fx.orderItemIds[0];
        const created = await createReturnInDb(db, fx, { lines: [{ orderItemId: shirt, quantity: 1 }], notify: false });
        const units = [{ lineId: created.lineIds[shirt], disposition: 'restocked' as const, quantity: 1 }];
        const key = randomUUID();
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, canRefund: false, choice: 'consult', requestKey: key, notify: true });
        await receiveReturnInDb(db, created.returnId, fx.actorId, { units, canRefund: false, choice: 'consult', requestKey: key, notify: true });
        return { fx, returnId: created.returnId, label: returnLabelOf(fx.orderId, created.number) };
      });
      const orderNumber = orderNumberOf(context.fx.orderId);

      // 店への知らせ: 1通。もう一度 worker を動かしても増えない
      await runWorkerUntil(request, async () => (await shopAlertsFor(request, orderNumber)).length >= 1, '店への知らせが届くこと');
      await runWorkerOnce(request);
      const alerts = await shopAlertsFor(request, orderNumber);
      expect(alerts).toHaveLength(1);
      // 店への知らせの件名には店の名前を付けない（C-6・Task 6 の composeReturnRefundPendingShop）
      expect(alerts[0].Subject).toBe(`${RETURN_MAIL.shopAlert}（${orderNumber}）`);
      expect(alerts[0].Text).toContain(`返品 ${context.label} の品を受け取りました（受け取った人: サポート）。`);
      expect(alerts[0].Text).toContain('受け取った返金の品:');
      expect(alerts[0].Text).toContain('・E2Eシャツ（ホワイト / M） × 1');
      expect(alerts[0].Text).toContain(`計算どおりの額: ${formatYen(5_000)}`);
      expect(alerts[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.shopAlertNext);

      // 店長が額を直して返金する。Stripe が受け付けると、お客様に返金のお知らせが1通届く（返品の書き分け）
      await withLocalDb(async (db) => {
        const refund = await refundReturnInDb(db, context.returnId, context.fx.actorId, { amount: 4_000, notify: true });
        expect(refund).toMatchObject({ amount: 4_000, status: 'awaiting_response' });
        await recordRefundResult(db, refund.refundId as string);
      });
      await runWorkerUntil(request, async () => (await sentOutboxCount(context.fx.orderId, 'refund')) >= 1, '返金のお知らせが送信済みになること');
      const mails = await waitForMails(request, context.fx.email, RETURN_MAIL.refund);
      expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(mails[0].Text).toContain(RETURN_MAIL.refundLater(context.label));
```
